docs.text: The specification of the Additional Representation that may be applicable to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: additionalRepresentations
docs.text: The specification Additional Representations that may be applicable to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: additionalRightsEvent
docs.text: The Additional Rights Event election.

docs.title: Slot: additionalTerm
docs.text: This attribute is used for representing information contained in the Additional Terms field of the 2003 Master Credit Derivatives confirm.

docs.title: Slot: additionalTerminationEvent
docs.text: Specifies events that may lead to the early termination of the Master Agreement, including suspension of the affected party's rights to rehypothecate, transfer, or substitute collateral.

docs.title: Slot: additionalTerms
docs.text: The bespoke Additional Type for the purposes of Covered Transactions (IM).

docs.title: Slot: address
docs.text: The street/postal address.

docs.title: Slot: addressForNotices
docs.text: Specification of the address and other details for notices.

docs.title: Slot: addressesForTransfer
docs.text: The optional specification of address for transfer as specified by the respective parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: adjustableDate
docs.text: A date that shall be subject to adjustment if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business centers, together with the convention for adjusting the date.

docs.title: Slot: adjustableDates
docs.text: A series of dates that shall be subject to adjustment if they would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business centers, together with the convention for adjusting the date.

docs.title: Slot: adjustableOrRelativeDate
docs.text: A single settlement date subject to adjustment or specified as relative to another date (e.g. the trade date). This attribute was formerly part of 'SettlementTerms', which is now being harmonised to include a common 'SettlementDate', as inherited from 'SettlementBase'.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedCashSettlementPaymentDate
docs.text: The date on which the cash settlement amount is paid. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedCashSettlementValuationDate
docs.text: The date by which the cash settlement amount must be agreed. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedDate
docs.text: The date once the adjustment has been performed. (Note that this date may change if the business center holidays change).

docs.title: Slot: adjustedEarlyTerminationDate
docs.text: The early termination date that is applicable if an early termination provision is exercised. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedEndDate
docs.text: The calculation period end date, adjusted according to any relevant business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedExerciseDate
docs.text: The date on which the option exercise takes place. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedExerciseFeePaymentDate
docs.text: The date on which the exercise fee amount is paid. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedExtendedTerminationDate
docs.text: The termination date if an extendible provision is exercised. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedFixingDate
docs.text: The adjusted fixing date, i.e. the actual date the rate is observed. The date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedFxSpotFixingDate
docs.text: The date on which the FX spot rate is observed. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedPaymentDate
docs.text: The adjusted payment date. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention. This component is not intended for use in trade confirmation but may be specified to allow the fee structure to also serve as a cashflow type component.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedRelevantSwapEffectiveDate
docs.text: The effective date of the underlying swap associated with a given exercise date. This date should already be adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustedStartDate
docs.text: The calculation period start date, adjusted according to any relevant business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: adjustmentFactor
docs.text: Specifies any additional details e.g. further descriptions depending on the particular type of Corporate Action, adjustmentFactor, calculations

docs.title: Slot: adjustmentRatio
docs.text: The number that denotes the cumulative quantity of post-split shares issued to shareholders versus the quantity of pre-split shares previously issued to shareholders. This number will be multiplied by existing shares in an equity derivative contract or other positions to determine the post-split number of shares. With regard to any reference to price, the pre-split reference price will be divided by this number to determine the post-split reference price.

docs.title: Slot: after
docs.text: Specifies the after trade state(s) created.

docs.title: Slot: agency
docs.text: Specifies The credit agency to which the other variables (notation, scale, debt type) refer to.

docs.title: Slot: agencyRating
docs.text: The agency rating based on default risk and creditors claim in event of default associated with specific instrument.

docs.title: Slot: aggregateValue
docs.text: Represents the aggregate value of the portfolio in base currency.

docs.title: Slot: aggregateWeight
docs.text: The total weight of all the terms that went into the calculated rate.

docs.title: Slot: aggregation
docs.text: How does paragraph 5.4 (aggregation) apply to the GMSLA?

docs.title: Slot: aggregationParameters
docs.text: Describes the portfolio by describing how to aggregate all its relevant Events.

docs.title: Slot: aggregationType
docs.text: How is the mark to market value determined?

docs.title: Slot: agreedAmountBaseCurrency
docs.text: Indicates the amount that posting entity agrees to remit in response to margin call (in base currency).

docs.title: Slot: agreedDiscountRate
docs.text: This may be used to indicate the discount rate to be used for cash collateral for cash settlement purposes.

docs.title: Slot: agreement
docs.text: Specification of the standard set of terms that define a legal agreement.

docs.title: Slot: agreementDate
docs.text: The date on which the legal agreement has been agreed between the parties. This corresponds to the Date of Deed in an English Law document.

docs.title: Slot: agreementMinimumTransferAmount
docs.text: Specifies the collateral legal agreement minimum transfer amount in base currency.

docs.title: Slot: agreementName
docs.text: The legal agreement name, e.g. Credit Support Annex for Variation Margin.

docs.title: Slot: agreementRounding
docs.text: Specifies the collateral legal agreement rounding in base currency.

docs.title: Slot: agreementSet
docs.text: The language associated with the umbrella agreement, and which applies to all the parties to the umbrella agreement.

docs.title: Slot: agreementTerms
docs.text: Specification of the content of the legal agreement.

docs.title: Slot: agreementThreshold
docs.text: Specifies the collateral legal agreement threshold amount in base currency.

docs.title: Slot: agreementType
docs.text: Specification of the legal agreement type.

docs.title: Slot: agreementsRegardingHedging
docs.text: If true, then agreements regarding hedging are applicable.

docs.title: Slot: allDividends
docs.text: Represents the European Master Confirmation value of 'All Dividends' which, when applicable, signifies that, for a given Ex-Date, the daily observed Share Price for that day is adjusted (reduced) by the cash dividend and/or the cash value of any non cash dividend per Share (including Extraordinary Dividends) declared by the Issuer. All Dividends in accordance with the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions.

docs.title: Slot: allGuarantees
docs.text: Indicates whether an obligation of the Reference Entity, guaranteed by the Reference Entity on behalf of a non-Affiliate, is to be considered an Obligation for the purpose of the transaction. It will be considered an obligation if allGuarantees is applicable (true) and not if allGuarantees is inapplicable (false). ISDA 2003 Term: All Guarantees.

docs.title: Slot: alphaContract
docs.text: The contract that will be submitted to the clearing house for clearing. The contract should indicate that it should be cleared by assigning a clearing organisation as a party role.

docs.title: Slot: alternativeProvision
docs.text: Specifies an alternative to interest amount, when the alternative provision clause is specified.

docs.title: Slot: alternativeTerms
docs.text: The alternative dispute resolution procedure if specified.

docs.title: Slot: alternativeToInterestAmount
docs.text: Specifies the alternative to interest amounts.

docs.title: Slot: amendmentsToJapaneseProvisions
docs.text: Additional Amendments to Japanese Securities Provisions are specified when True, and not specified when False.

docs.title: Slot: amendmentsToJapaneseProvisionsTerms
docs.text: Specific terms applicable to Additional Amendments to Japanese Securities Provisions.

docs.title: Slot: amount
docs.text: Current value of the outstanding contract

docs.title: Slot: amountBaseCurrency
docs.text: Specifies the collateral balance amount in base currency determined within a collateral legal agreement, or defined for reporting purposes.

docs.title: Slot: amountIsInfinity
docs.text: A flag that defines the Minimum Transfer Amount (MTA) as Infinity.

docs.title: Slot: amountOfNetCapital
docs.text: The amount of net capital.

docs.title: Slot: amountRemaining
docs.text: The limit remaining for the limit level and limit type. This does not take into account any pending trades. While the attribute is of type integer in FpML and the CME schema, it has been specified to be of type number in the CDM to take into consideration java size limits as well as for consistency purposes with the way most monetary amounts are expressed.

docs.title: Slot: amountUtilized
docs.text: The limit utilised by all the cleared trades for the limit level and limit type. While the attribute is of type integer in FpML and the CME schema, it has been specified to be of type number in the CDM to take into consideration java size limits as well as for consistency purposes with the way most monetary amounts are expressed.

docs.title: Slot: ancillaryParty
docs.text: Identifies a party via its ancillary role on a transaction (e.g. CCP or DCO through which the trade should be cleared.)

docs.title: Slot: announcementDate
docs.text: The date on which the corporate action is announced by the issuer.

docs.title: Slot: annualizationFactor
docs.text: This specifies the numerator of an annualization factor. Frequently this number is equal to the number of observations of prices in a year e.g. 252.

docs.title: Slot: applicable
docs.text: Indicates whether the Not Domestic Currency provision is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: applicableBusinessDays
docs.text: the business days that are applicable for the calculation.

docs.title: Slot: applicableCsa
docs.text: This may be used to specify what type of CSA (credit support annex/agreement) is to be used for cash settlement purposes.

docs.title: Slot: applicableParty
docs.text: Whether the additional termination event is applicable for the relevant party.

docs.title: Slot: applicableRegime
docs.text: A class to specify the regime(s) that parties to a legal agreement, such as the ISDA 2016 and 2018 CSA for Initial Margin, might agree to apply to one or both parties when acting as collateral taker, and specific terms associated with that application.

docs.title: Slot: applicableTransfer
docs.text: The definition of 'Transfer' with respect to Other Eligible Support and Other Posted Support.

docs.title: Slot: applicableValue
docs.text: The definition of 'Value' with respect to Other Eligible Support and Other Posted Support.

docs.title: Slot: appliedRate
docs.text: The rate that was actually applied, after all calculations and treatments.

docs.title: Slot: appliesTo
docs.text: Specifies which of the two counterparties the criteria applies to (either one or both counterparties). This attribute is optional, in case the applicable party is already specified elsewhere within a party election.

docs.title: Slot: appropriatedCollateralValuation
docs.text: The election for the Valuation of Appropriate Collateral.

docs.title: Slot: approval
docs.text: Optional party approvals for the current workflow step. A workflow step can have any number of parties associated to it, thus this object is represented as a list. All parties that are expected to provide approval should have an item in this list that references them.

docs.title: Slot: approved
docs.text: Flag denoting whether the workflow step is approved or not

docs.title: Slot: arithmeticOperator
docs.text: Specifies the arithmetic operator via an enumeration.

docs.title: Slot: asCalculationAgent
docs.text: If set to True, the Calculation Time for Initial Margin is the time as of which the Calculation Agent (IM) computes its end of day valuations of derivatives transactions.

docs.title: Slot: asPermitted
docs.text: If set to True, the Control Agreement is a Credit Support Document with respect to the party(ies).

docs.title: Slot: asSpecified
docs.text: The bespoke party specific Regime term elections applicable when specified.

docs.title: Slot: asset
docs.text: The asset that underlies the position.

docs.title: Slot: assetAgencyRating
docs.text: Represents an agency rating based on default risk and creditors claim in event of default associated with specific instrument.

docs.title: Slot: assetBacked
docs.text: Specifies the type of Asset Backed Security.

docs.title: Slot: assetCountryOfOrigin
docs.text: The asset country of origin.

docs.title: Slot: assetFlowType
docs.text: Type of asset flow corresponding to a scheduled event.

docs.title: Slot: assetLeg
docs.text: Defines each asset movement as a buy/sell at different dates, typically 1 near leg and 1 far leg in a securities financing transaction.

docs.title: Slot: assetType
docs.text: Specifies the type of asset.

docs.title: Slot: assignableLoan
docs.text: A deliverable obligation characteristic. A loan that is freely assignable to a bank or financial institution without the consent of the Reference Entity or the guarantor, if any, of the loan (or the consent of the applicable borrower if a Reference Entity is guaranteeing the loan) or any agent. ISDA 2003 Term: Assignable Loan.

docs.title: Slot: assignedIdentifier
docs.text: The identifier value. This level of indirection between the issuer and the identifier and its version provides the ability to associate multiple identifiers to one issuer, consistently with the FpML PartyTradeIdentifier.

docs.title: Slot: attachment
docs.text: A human readable document, for example a confirmation.

docs.title: Slot: attachmentPoint
docs.text: Lower bound percentage of the loss that the Tranche can endure, expressed as a decimal. An attachment point of 5% would be represented as 0.05. The difference between Attachment and Exhaustion points is called the width of the Tranche.

docs.title: Slot: auctionDate
docs.text: The date on which the auction is scheduled to occur.

docs.title: Slot: automaticEarlyTermination
docs.text: The specification of whether there is an automatic occurrence of an Early Termination Date in respect of Transactions upon the occurrence of certain bankruptcy / insolvency related events.

docs.title: Slot: automaticEarlyTerminationApplies
docs.text: Does automatic early termination apply to the specified party?

docs.title: Slot: automaticEarlyTerminationInModifiedForm
docs.text: Automatic early termination applies in a modified form only.

docs.title: Slot: automaticEarlyTerminationOther
docs.text: Optional string to capture any further information regarding the automatic early termination even of default.

docs.title: Slot: automaticEarlyTerminationRequiredDueToSystemOfLaw
docs.text: Automatic early termination only applies if required due to system of law, otherwise it is not applicable.

docs.title: Slot: automaticEarlyTerminationSpecifiedSeparatelyForEachPrinciple
docs.text: In the case where party is acting as an agent, is automatic early termination specified on a per principle basis?

docs.title: Slot: automaticExercise
docs.text: If automatic is specified, then the notional amount of the underlying swap not previously exercised under the swaption will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than the specified threshold rate. The term in-the-money is assumed to have the meaning defining in the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 17.4 In-the-money.

docs.title: Slot: automaticSetOff
docs.text: The Automatic Set-Off provision applies when the value is set to True.

docs.title: Slot: automation
docs.text: Are third party vendors allowed to automate the processing of loans in the event of default (Only relevant to 2010 GMSLAs)?

docs.title: Slot: availableInventoryRecord
docs.text: An array holding the list of inventory being described. Each element in the inventoryRecord array represents an individual piece of inventory i.e. a security.

docs.title: Slot: availableInventoryType
docs.text: Defines the purpose of this inventory.

docs.title: Slot: averageTradingVolume
docs.text: Specifies an average trading volume on an exchange in relation to Equity products.

docs.title: Slot: averagingCalculation
docs.text: Defines parameters for use in cases when a valuation or other term is based on an average of market observations.

docs.title: Slot: averagingDateTimes
docs.text: An unweighted list of averaging observation date and times.

docs.title: Slot: averagingFeature
docs.text: Indicates if the averaging calculation, when applicable, is weighted or unweighted.

docs.title: Slot: averagingMethod
docs.text: Specifies enumerations for the type of averaging calculation.

docs.title: Slot: averagingMethodology
docs.text: Identifies the aggregation method to use in the case where multiple observations are used to compute the reset value and the method is not defined in a payout.

docs.title: Slot: averagingObservation
docs.text: A single weighted averaging observation.

docs.title: Slot: averagingObservations
docs.text: A weighted list of averaging observation date and times.

docs.title: Slot: averagingPeriodFrequency
docs.text: The frequency at which averaging period occurs with the regular part of the valuation schedule and their roll date convention.

docs.title: Slot: averagingPeriodIn
docs.text: The averaging in period.

docs.title: Slot: averagingPeriodOut
docs.text: The averaging out period.

docs.title: Slot: averagingStrikeFeature
docs.text: Defines an option strike that is calculated from an average of observed market prices.

docs.title: Slot: balanceOfFirstPeriod
docs.text: Indicates, when true, that that the first Calculation Period should run from the Effective Date to the end of the calendar period in which the Effective Date falls, e.g. Jan 15 - Jan 31 if the calculation periods are one month long and Effective Date is Jan 15. If false, the first Calculation Period should run from the Effective Date for one whole period, e.g. Jan 15 to Feb 14 if the calculation periods are one month long and Effective Date is Jan 15. Mostly used in Commmodity Swaps.

docs.title: Slot: bankHolidaysTreatment
docs.text: Specifies whether the dates defined include holidays or not.

docs.title: Slot: bankruptcy
docs.text: A credit event. The reference entity has been dissolved or has become insolvent. It also covers events that may be a precursor to insolvency such as instigation of bankruptcy or insolvency proceedings. Sovereign trades are not subject to Bankruptcy as 'technically' a Sovereign cannot become bankrupt. ISDA 2003 Term: Bankruptcy.

docs.title: Slot: barrier
docs.text: Specifies a barrier feature.

docs.title: Slot: baseAndEligibleCurrency
docs.text: The base and eligible currency(ies) for the document as specified by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: baseCurrency
docs.text: The common agreed currency into which relevant amounts of all collateral arrangements between the parties are converted, or if not an actual currency, the process through which this is determined. Where hardcoded (e.g. under the 1994 ISDA Credit Support Annex (Security Interest NY Law)), the currency that effectively performs this function.

docs.title: Slot: baseCurrencyExposure
docs.text: Represents the current mark to market value or IM calculation value of the trade portfolio as recorded by the principle (in base currency), to be referenced in a margin call.

docs.title: Slot: baseCurrencyIfOriginalNotFreelyConvertible
docs.text: If the base currency is not freely convertible, the fallback currency can be defined here.

docs.title: Slot: baseCurrencyMustBeFreelyConvertible
docs.text: The base currency that is defined must be freely convertible.

docs.title: Slot: baseCurrencyOther
docs.text: Utilised where the clause data structure is not able to capture a material aspect of the clause.

docs.title: Slot: baseCurrencyTerminationCurrency
docs.text: A flag detailing whether the Base Currency is set to the Termination Currency as defined in the related Master Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: baseValue
docs.text: The 1st value in the arithmetic operation, which may be non-commutative in some cases: Subtract, Divide). This 1st operand is called 'baseValue' as it refers to the price anchor in the arithmetic operation: e.g. the clean price (Bond) or the spot rate (FX).

docs.title: Slot: basketConstituent
docs.text: Identifies the constituents of the basket

docs.title: Slot: basketId
docs.text: A CDS basket identifier.

docs.title: Slot: basketName
docs.text: The name of the basket expressed as a free format string. FpML does not define usage rules for this element.

docs.title: Slot: basketPercentage
docs.text: The relative weight of each respective basket constituent, expressed in percentage. A basket percentage of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: basketReferenceInformation
docs.text: This attribute contains all the terms relevant to defining the Credit Default Swap Basket.

docs.title: Slot: before
docs.text: Specifies the trade state that will be acted on by the primitive event functions.

docs.title: Slot: belgianLawSecurityAgreement
docs.text: The qualification of whether the Belgian Law Security Agreement Addendum is deemed applicable by the parties (True) or not (False).

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCalculationAgentTerms
docs.text: The Calculation Agent (IM) terms when specified.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCalculationDate
docs.text: The specification of bespoke Calculation Date terms for the purposes of Initial or Variation Margin by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCalculationFormula
docs.text: To describe the formula used to calculate the Adjustment Factor.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCalculationTime
docs.text: Bespoke terms to describe the time as of which such party (or the Calculation Agent (IM) (if applicale)) computes its end of day valuations of derivatives transactions.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCalculationTimeTerms
docs.text: Additional Terms applicable to Calculation Time for Initial Margin.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCoveredTransactions
docs.text: Covered Transactions when not expressed using the ISDA taxonomy.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeCreditSuppportDocument
docs.text: Specification of a document when not captured under RelatedAgreement.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeEventDescription
docs.text: Corporate action triggered by the occurrence of an event which description is seperatly agreed between the parties and/or described in any referenced agreement (for instance bespoke term described in any string type objects present in most root attributes of Agreement type).

docs.title: Slot: bespokeTransferTiming
docs.text: The time by which the transfer of collateral must take place when different from the Regular Settlement Day as a result of parties' election.

docs.title: Slot: bespokeTransferTimingTerms
docs.text: The bespoke transfer timing terms applicable to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: billingEndDate
docs.text: The ending date of the period described by this invoice

docs.title: Slot: billingRecord
docs.text: The billing records contained within the invoice

docs.title: Slot: billingRecordInstruction
docs.text: Instructions for creating the billing records contained within the invoice

docs.title: Slot: billingStartDate
docs.text: The starting date of the period described by this invoice

docs.title: Slot: billingSummary
docs.text: The billing summaries contained within the invoice

docs.title: Slot: block
docs.text: Defines a delivery profile block, including start and end time, days of the week, duration, delivery capacity and price time interval quantity.

docs.title: Slot: bond
docs.text: Reference to a bond underlier.

docs.title: Slot: bondReference
docs.text: Reference to a bond underlier to represent an asset swap or Condition Precedent Bond.

docs.title: Slot: borrower
docs.text: Specifies the borrower. There can be more than one borrower. It is meant to be used in the event that there is no Bloomberg Id or the Secured List isn't applicable.

docs.title: Slot: bothAffected
docs.text: Specifies fallback Termination Currency where both parties are Affected Parties.

docs.title: Slot: bothAffectedTermCurrencyOption
docs.text: Specifies termination currency where there are two Affected Parties and they cannot agree on the termination currency.

docs.title: Slot: boundary
docs.text: Indicates the boundary of a credit agency rating i.e minimum or maximum.

docs.title: Slot: boundedCorrelation
docs.text: Describes correlation bounds, which form a cap and a floor on the realized correlation.

docs.title: Slot: boundedVariance
docs.text: Conditions which bound variance. The contract specifies one or more boundary levels. These levels are expressed as prices for confirmation purposes Underlyer price must be equal to or higher than Lower Barrier is known as Up Conditional Swap Underlyer price must be equal to or lower than Upper Barrier is known as Down Conditional Swap Underlyer price must be equal to or higher than Lower Barrier and must be equal to or lower than Upper Barrier is known as Barrier Conditional Swap.

docs.title: Slot: branch
docs.text: Description of the specific branch entered into by the relevant party.

docs.title: Slot: breakdown
docs.text: Each split breakdown specifies the set of primitive instructions to be applied to a single branch of that split. N split breakdowns result in N output trades, which include the original trade. Instructions for how to handle the original trade (e.g. if it must be closed) must be specified in one of the breakdowns.

docs.title: Slot: businessCenter
docs.text: A code identifying one or several business day calendar location(s). The set of business day calendar locations are specified by the business day calendar location enumeration which is maintained by the FpML standard.

docs.title: Slot: businessCenters
docs.text: The business center(s), specified either explicitly or by reference to those specified somewhere else in the instance document.

docs.title: Slot: businessCentersReference
docs.text: A reference to a financial business center location specified elsewhere in the instance document.

docs.title: Slot: businessDateRange
docs.text: A range of contiguous business days. This attribute is meant to be merged with the 'settlementDate' at some future point once we refactor 'Date' to use a single complex type across the model. This attributes was formerly part of 'CashSettlementPaymentDate', as included into 'OptionCashSettlement' (which is now merged into a unique 'CashSettlementTerms' data type.

docs.title: Slot: businessDayConvention
docs.text: The convention for adjusting a date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day, as specified by an ISDA convention (e.g. Following, Precedent).

docs.title: Slot: businessDays
docs.text: A number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used. ISDA 2003 Term: Business Day.

docs.title: Slot: businessDaysNotSpecified
docs.text: An explicit indication that a number of business days are not specified and therefore ISDA fallback provisions should apply.

docs.title: Slot: businessDaysThereafter
docs.text: The number of business days between successive valuation dates when multiple valuation dates are applicable for cash settlement. ISDA 2003 Term: Business Days thereafter.

docs.title: Slot: businessEvent
docs.text: Life cycle event for the step.

docs.title: Slot: businessUnit
docs.text: Optional organization unit information used to describe the organization units (e.g. trading desks) involved in a transaction or business process, incl. the contact information (when relevant).

docs.title: Slot: buyer
docs.text: Buyer party that can be resolved as one of the two principal parties to the transaction. The party that buys this instrument, i.e. pays for this instrument and receives the rights defined by it. ISDA 2002 Equity Definitions section 1.18: Buyer means the party specified as such in the related Confirmation. | ISDA 2006 Definitions article 12.1 (b)(i) relating to a Swaption: 'Buyer' means the party that will, on each Premium Payment Date, pay to Seller the Premium | ISDA 2006 Definitions article 12.1 (b)(ii) relating to Swap Transactions with applicable Early Termination: the party specified as such in the related Confirmation, or the Exercising Party if neither party is specified | ISDA 2006 Definitions article 12.1 (b)(iii) relating to any other Option Transaction: the party specified as such in the related Confirmation. | ISDA 2014 Credit Definition article 1.4: Buyer means the Fixed Rate Payer.

docs.title: Slot: cabEndDate
docs.text: The business days following the related Collateral Access Breach when the additional terms end.

docs.title: Slot: cabEndDateElection
docs.text: Determination of whether the Collateral Access Breach end date is a number of days (True) or specified (False).

docs.title: Slot: cabEndDateTerms
docs.text: Specific terms for when Collateral Access Breach terms end.

docs.title: Slot: calculatedAmount
docs.text: The amount of the cash flow that was computed, including any spreads and other processing.

docs.title: Slot: calculatedRate
docs.text: The resulting calculated weight.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAgent
docs.text: The ISDA calculation agent responsible for performing duties as defined in the applicable product definitions.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAgentBusinessCenter
docs.text: The city in which the office through which ISDA Calculation Agent is acting for purposes of the transaction is located The short-form confirm for a trade that is executed under a Sovereign or Asia Pacific Master Confirmation Agreement ( MCA ), does not need to specify the Calculation Agent. However, the confirm does need to specify the Calculation Agent City. This is due to the fact that the MCA sets the value for Calculation Agent but does not set the value for Calculation Agent City.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAgentDetermination
docs.text: The calculation agent will decide the rate.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAgentParty
docs.text: Specifies the party which is the ISDA Calculation Agent for the trade. If more than one party is referenced then the parties are assumed to be co-calculation agents, i.e. they have joint responsibility.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAgentPartyEnum
docs.text: Specifies the ISDA calculation agent responsible for performing duties as defined in the applicable product definitions. For example, the Calculation Agent may be defined as being the Non-exercising Party.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAgentTerms
docs.text: Details of the party calculating the value of collateral to be delivered or returned.

docs.title: Slot: calculationAndTiming
docs.text: The set of elections for determining Valuation and Timing terms specific to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: calculationBase
docs.text: Whether the rate is calculated in advance, in arrears, or relative to a reset date.

docs.title: Slot: calculationDateImTerms
docs.text: The Additional Calculation Date terms for the purposes of Initial Margin.

docs.title: Slot: calculationDateLocation
docs.text: The specified location where the credit exposure will be calculated by the respective parties.

docs.title: Slot: calculationDateTime
docs.text: Indicates the date when the exposure is calculated if different from valuation date.

docs.title: Slot: calculationDefaults
docs.text: Any calculation default values.

docs.title: Slot: calculationDetails
docs.text: Calculated rate details (observation dates, values, and weights).

docs.title: Slot: calculationMethod
docs.text: Identifies which of the Pythagorean means is being used to compute an average value.

docs.title: Slot: calculationParameters
docs.text: Support for modular calculated rates, such such as lockout compound calculations.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriod
docs.text: The calculation period for which the floating calculation was performed.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriodDates
docs.text: Defines the calculation period dates schedule.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments
docs.text: The specification of the business day convention and financial business centers used for adjusting any calculation period date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business center.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriodDatesReference
docs.text: A pointer style reference to the associated calculation period dates component defined elsewhere in the document.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriodFrequency
docs.text: The frequency at which calculation period end dates occur with the regular part of the calculation period schedule and their roll date convention.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriodNotionalAmount
docs.text: The notional in effect during the calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: calculationPeriodNumberOfDays
docs.text: The number of days from the adjusted calculation period start date to the adjusted value date, calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction.

docs.title: Slot: calculationStyle
docs.text: Indicates the style of how the inflation index calculates the payment (e.g. YearOnYear, ZeroCoupon).

docs.title: Slot: calculationTerms
docs.text: Describes the input terms involved in the calculation of the adjustment factor applied to the price of the underlier impacted by a Corporate Action.

docs.title: Slot: calendarDay
docs.text: Defines the day of the calendar if this is specified for in the ValuationDateDateEnum.

docs.title: Slot: calendarSpread
docs.text: Definition of the later expiration date in a calendar spread.

docs.title: Slot: callAgreementType
docs.text: Specifies the legal agreement type the margin call is generated from and governed by.

docs.title: Slot: callAmountInBaseCurrency
docs.text: Specifies the amount of margin being called for which accounts for margin calculation inclusive of exposure, independent amount,threshold,collateral balance, MTA, rounding increments (in base currency detailed in supporting collateral agreement).

docs.title: Slot: callIdentifier
docs.text: Represents a unique Identifier for a margin call message, that can be referenced throughout all points of the process.

docs.title: Slot: callType
docs.text: Indicates the status of the call message type, such as expected call, notification of a call or an actionable margin call.

docs.title: Slot: callingParty
docs.text: The party with right to exercise a cancellation. Allows for buyer, seller or either.

docs.title: Slot: cancelableProvision
docs.text: A provision that allows the specification of an embedded option within a swap giving the buyer of the option the right to terminate the swap, in whole or in part, on the early termination date.

docs.title: Slot: cancelableProvisionAdjustedDates
docs.text: The adjusted dates associated with a cancelable provision. These dates have been adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: cancellationEvent
docs.text: The adjusted dates for an individual cancellation date.

docs.title: Slot: canonicalUri
docs.text: Canonical URI which uniquely identifies all versions (collectively) of the referenced code list. Must be an absolute URI. Must not be used as a de facto location URI.

docs.title: Slot: canonicalVersionUri
docs.text: Canonical URI which uniquely identifies a specific version of the referenced code list. Must be an absolute URI. Must not be used as a de facto location URI.

docs.title: Slot: capRate
docs.text: The cap rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate for the calculation period. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain strike level. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: capRateSchedule
docs.text: The cap rate or cap rate schedule, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The cap rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is capped at a certain level. A cap rate schedule is expressed as explicit cap rates and dates and the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The cap rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A cap rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: capacityUnit
docs.text: Provides an enumerated value for a capacity unit, generally used in the context of defining quantities for commodities.

docs.title: Slot: cash
docs.text: Details of how cash collateral is valued when resolving disputes.

docs.title: Slot: cashBalance
docs.text: The aggregate cost of proceeds.

docs.title: Slot: cashCollateral
docs.text: Details of how cash collateral is valued.

docs.title: Slot: cashCollateralCurrency
docs.text: This may be used to indicate the currency of cash collateral for cash settlement purposes.

docs.title: Slot: cashCollateralInterestRate
docs.text: This may be used to indicate the interest rate to be used for cash collateral for cash settlement purposes.

docs.title: Slot: cashCollateralTransferSettlementTime
docs.text: Details the day on which collateral is required to be transferred relative to the Notification Time.

docs.title: Slot: cashCollateralValuationMethod
docs.text: Specifies the parameters representing several mid-market valuation and replacement value methods.

docs.title: Slot: cashOrSecurityValue
docs.text: The Base Currency Equivalent of Cash or Security.

docs.title: Slot: cashRatio
docs.text: Specifies the cash actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity underlier. A ratio of 90% should be expressed at 0.90.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlement
docs.text: If specified, this means that cash settlement is applicable to the transaction and defines the parameters associated with the cash settlement procedure. If not specified, then physical settlement is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlementAmount
docs.text: The amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. If not otherwise specified, would typically be calculated as 100 (or the Reference Price) minus the price of the Reference Obligation (all expressed as a percentage) times Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Amount.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlementBusinessDays
docs.text: The number of business days used in the determination of the cash settlement payment date. If a cash settlement amount is specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days following the calculation of the final price. If a cash settlement amount is not specified, the cash settlement payment date will be this number of business days after all conditions to settlement are satisfied. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Date. This attribute was formerly part of 'CashSettlementTerms' as used for credit event settlement, which now includes a common 'SettlementDate' attribute.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlementMethod
docs.text: Specifies the type of cash settlement method: cash price, yield curve etc.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlementOnly
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Defined in the ISDA published Standard Terms Supplement for use with CDS Transactions on Leveraged Loans. ISDA 2003 Term: Cash Settlement Only.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlementTerms
docs.text: Specifies the parameters associated with the cash settlement procedure.

docs.title: Slot: cashSettlementTermsReference
docs.text: Reference to the cash settlement terms applicable to this item.

docs.title: Slot: cashTransfer
docs.text: Specifies the cash transfer that can optionally be tied to an index transition event.

docs.title: Slot: cashflowRepresentation
docs.text: The cashflow representation of the swap stream.

docs.title: Slot: cashflowsMatchParameters
docs.text: A true/false flag to indicate whether the cashflows match the parametric definition of the stream, i.e. whether the cashflows could be regenerated from the parameters without loss of information.

docs.title: Slot: category
docs.text: Used in both obligations and deliverable obligations to represent a class or type of securities which apply. ISDA 2003 Term: Obligation Category/Deliverable Obligation Category.

docs.title: Slot: change
docs.text: Quantity by which the trade is being increased, decreased or replaced, and the price at which such quantity change is agreed. The quantity change should always be specified as a positive number, with the direction (increase/decrease/replacement) being specified by the direction enumeration. A fee can also be associated to the quantity change by specifying a Price component of type CashPrice, including the corresponding settlement date and direction.

docs.title: Slot: childSecurity
docs.text: Defines the underlier for the Child Company involved in Spin Off corporate action.

docs.title: Slot: childSecurityPrice
docs.text: The price observation that relates to underlier for the Child Company.

docs.title: Slot: city
docs.text: The city component of the postal address.

docs.title: Slot: className
docs.text: The name defined by the classification system for a specific attribute in the taxonomy

docs.title: Slot: classification
docs.text: Specifies the taxonomy value as a set of class names and values for each class.

docs.title: Slot: clause
docs.text: Clauses that have had elections made against them in this Master Agreement. There must be at least one clause defined in the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: clauseLibrary
docs.text: Specification of whether the agreement terms have been negotiated using the clause library methodology.

docs.title: Slot: clearedDate   (DEPRECATED)
docs.text: Specifies the date on which a trade is cleared (novated) through a central counterparty clearing service.

docs.title: Slot: clearedPhysicalSettlement
docs.text: Specifies whether the swap resulting from physical settlement of the swaption transaction will clear through a clearing house. The meaning of Cleared Physical Settlement is defined in the 2006 ISDA Definitions, Section 15.2 (published in Supplement number 28).

docs.title: Slot: clearerParty1
docs.text: Optional party facing the CCP, acting as clearing member for party1.

docs.title: Slot: clearerParty2
docs.text: Optional party facing the CCP, acting as clearing member for party2.

docs.title: Slot: clearingBroker
docs.text: Indicates the name of the Clearing Broker FCM/DCM.

docs.title: Slot: clearingParty
docs.text: The Central Counter party (CCP) that the contract will be submitted to for clearing.

docs.title: Slot: clearstreamAmendmentToJapaneseProvisions
docs.text: Specification of whether Clearstream Event amendment language is included (true) or excluded (false).

docs.title: Slot: clientAssetSourcebookAdditionalLanguage
docs.text: Details of language relating to Client Asset and Money Rules (CASS).

docs.title: Slot: clipSize
docs.text: This element is required in FpML, optional in CDM for the purpose of accommodating the CME data representation while making reference to the FpML one.

docs.title: Slot: closedState
docs.text: Represents the qualification of what led to the trade's closure alongside the dates on which this closure took effect.

docs.title: Slot: codeShortId
docs.text: The name of the code list, e.g. business-center

docs.title: Slot: codes
docs.text: Code values

docs.title: Slot: collateral
docs.text: Detail the collateral requirement anticipated with the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: collateralAccessBreach
docs.text: The elections specific to Collateral Access Breach language.

docs.title: Slot: collateralAssetType
docs.text: The asset product type.

docs.title: Slot: collateralBalance
docs.text: Represents the populated or calculated collateral aggregate balance amount for the collateral portfolio.

docs.title: Slot: collateralBalanceStatus
docs.text: Defines the collateral balance breakdown of settlement status.

docs.title: Slot: collateralCriteria
docs.text: The specific criteria that applies. It can be created using AND, OR and NOT logic, and both asset and issuer characteristics.

docs.title: Slot: collateralManagementAgreement
docs.text: The designated Collateral Management Agreement with respect to the elective party as the Obligee.

docs.title: Slot: collateralPortfolio
docs.text: Represents attributes to define the details of collateral assets within a collateral portfolio to be used in margin call messaging and contribute to collateral balances e.g securities in a collateral account recorded by the principal as held or posted.

docs.title: Slot: collateralPosition
docs.text: Specifies the individual components of the collateral positions in the collateral portfolio.

docs.title: Slot: collateralPositionComponent
docs.text: Specifies the collateral to be moved and its direction.

docs.title: Slot: collateralPositionStatus
docs.text: Indicates the collateral positions settlement status.

docs.title: Slot: collateralProvisions
docs.text: specifies the collateral provisions of the product.

docs.title: Slot: collateralTransferAgreementElections
docs.text: Elections to specify a Collateral Transfer Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: collateralTransferTiming
docs.text: Specification of transfer / settlement timing for cash and securities collateral assuming that the notice is provided before the Notification Time (and with a 1LBD lag introduced if the notice is delivered after the Notification Time), and that securities allow for a further Local Business Day for transfer / settlement.

docs.title: Slot: collateralTransferTimingDefinition
docs.text: Bespoke language removing the pre-print requirement to transfer legal title of securities collateral through written instructions to the relevant depository institution or other securities intermediaries solely for the purposes of the 1994 New York Law Credit Support Annex.

docs.title: Slot: collateralType
docs.text: Enumerates the collateral types which are accepted by the Seller.

docs.title: Slot: collateralizedObligation
docs.text: Specifies the type of Collateralized Obligation.

docs.title: Slot: commencementDate
docs.text: The first day of the exercise period for an American style option.

docs.title: Slot: comment
docs.text: Optional comments for this group of inventory records.

docs.title: Slot: comments
docs.text: Any additional comments that are deemed necessary. For example, which software version is required to open the document? Or, how does this resource relate to the others for this event?

docs.title: Slot: commodityGrade
docs.text: Grade of product being delivered (e.g., grade of oil).

docs.title: Slot: commodityInfoPublisher
docs.text: Specifies the publication where the commodity prices can be found.

docs.title: Slot: commodityName
docs.text: Identifies the commodity more specifically. Where possible, this should follow the naming convention used in the 2005 ISDA Commodity Definitions SubAnnex A, including the subCommodity and additional qualifiers, but should be limited to 256 characters or less.

docs.title: Slot: commodityPriceReturnTerms
docs.text: Defines parameters in which the commodity price is assessed.

docs.title: Slot: commodityProductDefinition
docs.text: Specifies the commodity underlier in the event that no ISDA Commodity Reference Benchmark exists.

docs.title: common_domain_model
docs.text:
FINOS Common Domain Model (CDM) — LinkML schema

URI: https://w3id.org/lmodel/common-domain-model

docs.title: Slot: compare
docs.text: Where two ratings are specified whether the higher or lower rating prevails.

docs.title: Slot: compareVariableSet
docs.text: A logical container to hold a defined set of related data. In this case the collation of Ratings Information and associated exposure multiplier where multiple credit ratings are compared when determining the applicable Independent Amount.

docs.title: Slot: componentId
docs.text: Identifiers for each component of the list. Since the data type is used to link multiple identified objects together, at least 2 components are required in the list. Creating an identified list with only 1 identified component has been deemed unnecessary, because it would just create a redundant identifier.

docs.title: Slot: componentSecurityIndexAnnexFallback
docs.text: For an index option transaction, a flag to indicate whether a relevant Component Security Index Annex is applicable to the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: composite
docs.text: (Optionally) Specifies the underlying price components if the price can be expressed as a composite: e.g. dirty price = clean price + accrued.

docs.title: Slot: compoundedGrowth
docs.text: The compounding curve, showing how the initial value grew during the calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: compoundingBusinessCenter
docs.text: Specifies the applicable business centers for compounding.

docs.title: Slot: compoundingMethod
docs.text: If one or more calculation period contributes to a single payment amount this element specifies whether compounding is applicable and, if so, what compounding method is to be used. This element must only be included when more than one calculation period contributes to a single payment amount.

docs.title: Slot: compoundingType
docs.text: Specifies the type of compounding to be applied (None, Business, Calendar).

docs.title: Slot: compressibleSpread
docs.text: Specifies how spreads should be applied in a low/negative rate environment. If true, spread is applied only if rate is positive.

docs.title: Slot: concentrationLimit
docs.text: Specification of concentration limits applicable to the collateral criteria.

docs.title: Slot: concentrationLimitCriteria
docs.text: Specifies a set of criteria to describe the assets that the concentration limits apply to.

docs.title: Slot: concentrationLimitType
docs.text: Specifies the type of concentration limit to be applied.

docs.title: Slot: condition
docs.text: An enumerated element, to qualify whether All or Any credit notation applies.

docs.title: Slot: conditionPrecedentBond
docs.text: To indicate whether the Condition Precedent Bond is applicable. The swap contract is only valid if the bond is issued and if there is any dispute over the terms of fixed stream then the bond terms would be used.

docs.title: Slot: conditionsPrecedent
docs.text: The set of elections that may overwrite the default Condition Precedent provision, and the set of provisions that are deemed Access Condition.

docs.title: Slot: conditionsPrecedentElection
docs.text: The election to specify whether the standard Conditions Precedent apply.

docs.title: Slot: consentRequiredLoan
docs.text: A deliverable obligation characteristic. A loan that is capable of being assigned with the consent of the Reference Entity or the guarantor, if any, of the loan or any agent. ISDA 2003 Term: Consent Required Loan.

docs.title: Slot: consistencyWithControlAgreement
docs.text: Unless specified as inapplicable in the event of any inconsistency between this Deed and the Control Agreement, this Deed will prevail over the Control Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: constituentWeight
docs.text: Describes the weight of each of the constituents within the basket. If not provided, it is assumed to be equal weighted.

docs.title: Slot: contactInformation
docs.text: The contact information for such business unit, when different from the contact information associated with the party.

docs.title: Slot: continuity
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Defined in the ISDA published Standard Terms Supplement for use with CDS Transactions on Leveraged Loans. ISDA 2003 Term: Continuity.

docs.title: Slot: contractDetails
docs.text: Represents information specific to trades involving contractual products.

docs.title: Slot: contractFormation
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing an contract formation primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: contractualDefinitionIdentifier
docs.text: Contractual Definition Identifier in which the code is published. Includes Document Type and Document Version

docs.title: Slot: contractualDefinitionType
docs.text: e.g. ISDA2021Definitions

docs.title: Slot: contractualDefinitionsType
docs.text: The definitions such as those published by ISDA that will define the terms of the trade.

docs.title: Slot: contractualMatrix
docs.text: A reference to a contractual matrix of elected terms/values (such as those published by ISDA) that shall be deemed to apply to the trade. The applicable matrix is identified by reference to a name and optionally a publication date. Depending on the structure of the matrix, an additional term (specified in the matrixTerm element) may be required to further identify a subset of applicable terms/values within the matrix.

docs.title: Slot: contractualParty
docs.text: The two contractual parties to the legal agreement, which reference information is positioned as part of the partyInformation attribute.

docs.title: Slot: contractualTermsSupplement
docs.text: A contractual supplement (such as those published by ISDA) that will apply to the trade.

docs.title: Slot: contractualTermsSupplementType
docs.text: Identifies the form of applicable contractual supplement.

docs.title: Slot: controlAgreement
docs.text: The party-specific election with respect to the control agreement.

docs.title: Slot: controlAgreementAsCsd
docs.text: The identification of whether the Control Agreement is a Credit Support Document with respect to each party.

docs.title: Slot: controlAgreementNecEvent
docs.text: The bespoke provisions that might be specified by the parties to the agreement applicable to a Notice of Exclusive Control Event.

docs.title: Slot: controlAgreementNecEventElection
docs.text: Indicates party specific Control Agreement language related to delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control.

docs.title: Slot: conversionFactor
docs.text: Defines the conversion applied if the quantity unit on contract is different from unit on referenced underlier.

docs.title: Slot: copyTo
docs.text: A unique identifier (within the specified coding scheme) giving the details of some party to whom a copy of this message will be sent for reference.

docs.title: Slot: corporateAction
docs.text: Specifies the necessary information to create a corporate action.

docs.title: Slot: corporateActionIntent
docs.text: The intent of a corporate action on the position.

docs.title: Slot: corporateActionType
docs.text: The type of corporate action taking place.

docs.title: Slot: correlationReturnTerms
docs.text: Return terms based upon the observed correlation between the components of the underlying basket.

docs.title: Slot: correlationStrikePrice
docs.text: Correlation Strike Price in accordance with the ISDA 2011 Equity Derivatives Definitions.

docs.title: Slot: counterparty
docs.text: Maps two defined parties to counterparty enums for the transacted product.

docs.title: Slot: counterpartyOwnIssuePermitted
docs.text: Represents a filter based on whether it is permitted for the underlying asset to be issued by the posting entity or part of their corporate family.

docs.title: Slot: counterpartyPosition
docs.text: Represents the Position that has been effected by a business or life-cycle event.

docs.title: Slot: counterpartyPositionBusinessEvent
docs.text: Documents the life cycle event for a position.

docs.title: Slot: country
docs.text: The ISO 3166 standard code for the country within which the postal address is located.

docs.title: Slot: couponRate
docs.text: Specifies the coupon rate (expressed in percentage) of a fixed income security or convertible bond.

docs.title: Slot: coveredBond
docs.text: Specifies the type of Covered Bond.

docs.title: Slot: coveredTransactions
docs.text: The specification of transactions covered by the terms of the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: creditAgreementDate
docs.text: Specifies the credit agreement date is the closing date (the date where the agreement has been signed) for the loans in the credit agreement. Funding of the facilities occurs on (or sometimes a little after) the Credit Agreement date. This underlier attribute is used to help identify which of the company's outstanding loans are being referenced by knowing to which credit agreement it belongs. ISDA Standards Terms Supplement term: Date of Original Credit Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: creditEvent
docs.text: Specifies the necessary information to create a credit event.

docs.title: Slot: creditEventNotice
docs.text: A specified condition to settlement. An irrevocable written or verbal notice that describes a credit event that has occurred. The notice is sent from the notifying party (either the buyer or the seller) to the counterparty. It provides information relevant to determining that a credit event has occurred. This is typically accompanied by Publicly Available Information. ISDA 2003 Term: Credit Event Notice.

docs.title: Slot: creditEventType
docs.text: The type of credit event taking place.

docs.title: Slot: creditNotation
docs.text: Specifies only one credit notation is determined.

docs.title: Slot: creditNotations
docs.text: Specifies if several credit notations exist, alongside an 'any' or 'all' or all condition.

docs.title: Slot: creditRisk
docs.text: Indicates tranched or untranched credit risk.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportAgreementElections
docs.text: Elections to specify a Credit Support Annex or Credit Support Deed for Intial or Variation Margin.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportAgreementMarginType
docs.text: specifies the type of margin for which a legal agreement is named.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportAgreementType
docs.text: Specification of the credit support agreement type.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportAmount
docs.text: The total amount one counterparty must deliver to the other at any time: the combination of the Exposure to that party and the net Independent Amounts it must post, minus any agreed Threshold.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportDocument
docs.text: The specified Credit Support Document(s), if any.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportDocumentElection
docs.text: The party election of Credit Support Document(s), if any.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportDocumentTerms
docs.text: Specification of the Credit Support Document terms.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportDocumentTypes
docs.text: If a Credit Support Document is specified but not yet in CDM representation, it can still be captured. This argument should be used if the creditSupportDocument argument cannot be used due to not being able to represent the document fully in CDM format.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportObligations
docs.text: The Credit Support Obligations applicable to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportOffsets
docs.text: The specification of whether the standard Credit Support Offset provisions are applicable (true) or not applicable (false).

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportProvider
docs.text: The specified Credit Support Provider(s), if any.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportProviderElection
docs.text: The party election of Credit Support Provider(s), if any.

docs.title: Slot: creditSupportProviderTerms
docs.text: Specification of the Credit Support Provider terms.

docs.title: Slot: creditWatch
docs.text: Indicates the potential direction of a short-term or long-term rating. It focuses on identifiable events and short-term trends that cause ratings to be placed under special surveillance.

docs.title: Slot: criteria
docs.text: A logical container to hold a defined set of related data. In this case the collation of criteria required by the party and its custodian to Hold the other party's Posted Collateral.

docs.title: Slot: crossCurrency
docs.text: If 'Cross-Currency' is specified as the Settlement Type in the relevant Transaction Supplement, an amount in the Settlement Currency, determined by the Calculation Agent as being equal to the number of Options exercised or deemed exercised, multiplied by: (Settlement Price – Strike Price) / (Strike Price – Settlement Price) x Multiplier x one unit of the Reference Currency converted into an amount in the Settlement Currency using the rate of exchange of the Settlement Currency as quoted on the Reference Price Source on the Valuation Date, provided that if the above is equal to a negative amount the Option Cash Settlement Amount shall be deemed to be zero.

docs.title: Slot: currency
docs.text: Defines the currency to be used as a unit for a price, quantity, or other purpose.

docs.title: Slot: currency1
docs.text: The first currency specified when a pair of currencies is to be evaluated.

docs.title: Slot: currency2
docs.text: The second currency specified when a pair of currencies is to be evaluated.

docs.title: Slot: currencyReference
docs.text: Reference to a currency specified elsewhere in the document

docs.title: Slot: custodian
docs.text: The custody agent. While CreateiQ only specifies the custodian's name, specifying the legal entity as part of the CDM is deemed more appropriate, while this will still provide the ability to accommodate situations where only the entity name is available, as the entityId attribute is optional as part of the LegalEntity class.

docs.title: Slot: custodianCondition
docs.text: Specifies any additional conditions relevant to the Custodian of the respective parties as set out in the Holding and Using Posted Collateral clause.

docs.title: Slot: custodianEligibility
docs.text: Specifies whether the party's custodian is eligible to hold the other party's posted collateral. If 'True' then the custodian is eligible to hold the Posted Collateral given that the specified criteria are met.

docs.title: Slot: custodianEvent
docs.text: Specifies if and until when a Custodian Event clause applies.

docs.title: Slot: custodianRisk
docs.text: The qualification of the Custodian Risk.

docs.title: Slot: custodyArrangements
docs.text: The Custodian and Segregated Account details in respect of each party to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: customElection
docs.text: A supplemental custom election that might be specified by the parties for the purpose of specifying the Additional Representation.

docs.title: Slot: customLocation
docs.text: The Calculation Date Location when specified a location which doesn't correspond to the FpML list of business centers or cannot be mapped to it.

docs.title: Slot: customMethodology
docs.text: The methodology according to which sensitivities will be computed, when specified through a custom election.

docs.title: Slot: customNotification
docs.text: The Notification Time as a bespoke election.

docs.title: Slot: customValue
docs.text: The qualification of the Additional Type of transaction that can require the collection or delivery of initial margin when specified as a custom value by the parties to the legal agreement.

docs.title: Slot: customisedWorkflow
docs.text: Non-standardized data in a generic form.

docs.title: Slot: cutoffTime
docs.text: Specifies the time of day that interest needs to be confirmed by.

docs.title: Slot: dateAdjustments
docs.text: The business day convention and financial business centers used for adjusting the date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business date in the specified business centers.

docs.title: Slot: dateAdjustmentsReference
docs.text: A pointer style reference to date adjustments defined elsewhere in the document.

docs.title: Slot: dateLocation
docs.text: Specifies where is the time measured.

docs.title: Slot: dateOfBirth
docs.text: The natural person's date of birth.

docs.title: Slot: dateOfTimelyStatement
docs.text: The parties' election to specify the number of days one party has effectively provided the Timely Statement to the other party.

docs.title: Slot: dateReference
docs.text: Specification of the dividend date using an enumeration, with values such as the pay date, the ex-date or the record date.

docs.title: Slot: dateRelativeTo
docs.text: Specifies the anchor as an href attribute. The href attribute value is a pointer style reference to the element or component elsewhere in the document where the anchor date is defined.

docs.title: Slot: dateRelativeToCalculationPeriodDates
docs.text: The calculation period references on which settlements in non-deliverable currency are due and will then have to be converted according to the terms specified through the other parts of the nonDeliverableSettlement structure. Implemented for Brazilian-CDI swaps where it will refer to the termination date of the appropriate leg.

docs.title: Slot: dateRelativeToPaymentDates
docs.text: The payment date references on which settlements in non-deliverable currency are due and will then have to be converted according to the terms specified through the other parts of the nonDeliverableSettlement structure.

docs.title: Slot: dateRelativeToValuationDates
docs.text: The calculation period references on which settlements in non-deliverable currency are due and will then have to be converted according to the terms specified through the other parts of the nonDeliverableSettlement structure. Implemented for Brazilian-CDI swaps where it will refer to the termination date of the appropriate leg.

docs.title: Slot: dateTime
docs.text: The CDM specifies that the zoned date time is to be expressed in accordance with ISO 8601, either as UTC as an offset to UTC.

docs.title: Slot: datedValue
docs.text: A schedule of step date and value pairs. On each step date the associated step value becomes effective. The step dates are used to order the steps by ascending order. This attribute is optional so the data type may be used to define a schedule with a single value.

docs.title: Slot: day
docs.text: The day in respect of which the Valuation Time is being specified. If not specified, addional language must be used to define the methodology.

docs.title: Slot: dayCountFraction
docs.text: The enumerated values to specify the day count fraction.

docs.title: Slot: dayCountYearFraction
docs.text: The year fraction value of the calculation period, result of applying the ISDA rules for day count fraction defined in the ISDA Annex.

docs.title: Slot: dayDistribution
docs.text: Denotes the method by which the pricing days are distributed across the pricing period.

docs.title: Slot: dayFrequency
docs.text: Defines the occurrence of the dayOfWeek within the pricing period on which pricing will take place, e.g. the 3rd Friday within each Calculation Period. If omitted, every dayOfWeek will be a pricing day.

docs.title: Slot: dayOfMonth
docs.text: Specifies the day of the month if used.

docs.title: Slot: dayOfWeek
docs.text: Specifies the day of the week if used.

docs.title: Slot: dayType
docs.text: In the case of an offset specified as a number of days, this element defines whether consideration is given as to whether a day is a good business day or not. If a day type of business days is specified then non-business days are ignored when calculating the offset. The financial business centers to use for determination of business days are implied by the context in which this element is used. This element must only be included when the offset is specified as a number of days. If the offset is zero days then the dayType element should not be included.

docs.title: Slot: daysAfterCustodianEvent
docs.text: Election to specify the number of days after the occurrence of the Custodian Event/Collateral Management Event for the purpose of qualifying the CE/CME End Date.

docs.title: Slot: daysInRangeAdjustment
docs.text: The contract specifies whether the notional should be scaled by the Number of Days in Range divided by the Expected N. The number of Days in Ranges refers to the number of returns that contribute to the realized volatility.

docs.title: Slot: dealerOrCCP
docs.text: Holds an identifier for the reference entity that is agreed by both parties as a basis for cash settlement calculations. This could be a dealer from whom quotations are obtained by the calculation agent on the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement in a credit event. ISDA 2003 Term: Dealer. This could be the clearing organization (CCP, DCO) to which the trade should be cleared, as applicable for cash-settled swaptions.

docs.title: Slot: debt
docs.text: Specifies the credit rating debt type (e.g. long term, high yield, deposits, ...) associated with the credit rating notation and scale.

docs.title: Slot: debtEconomics
docs.text: Specifies selected financial terms of a debt security.

docs.title: Slot: debtType
docs.text: Identifies the type of debt and selected debt economics.

docs.title: Slot: debtTypes
docs.text: Specifies if there are several debt types, alongside an 'any' or 'all' or all condition. As an example, Baa1 rating is required for any long term debt and deposit.

docs.title: Slot: deemedEffectiveNextLBD
docs.text: Specifies if notice shall be deemed to be effective at the time such notice is actually received unless such notice is received on a day which is not a Local Business Day or after the Notification Time on any Local Business Day in which event such notice shall be deemed to be effective on the next succeeding Local Business Day. If deemed effective,'True'. If not deemed effective, or not stated,'False'.

docs.title: Slot: defaultRequirement
docs.text: In relation to certain credit events, serves as a threshold for Obligation Acceleration, Obligation Default, Repudiation/Moratorium and Restructuring. Market standard is USD 10,000,000 (JPY 1,000,000,000 for all Japanese Yen trades). This is applied on an aggregate or total basis across all Obligations of the Reference Entity. Used to prevent technical/operational errors from triggering credit events. ISDA 2003 Term: Default Requirement.

docs.title: Slot: definitionOfMarketValueNonStandard
docs.text: If the definition of 'Market Value' is non standard, it can be specified here.

docs.title: Slot: definitionalSource
docs.text: The source of an FRO, particularly if not a Contractual Definition (e.g. the broker rates matrix).

docs.title: Slot: deliverableObligations
docs.text: This element contains all the ISDA terms relevant to defining the deliverable obligations.

docs.title: Slot: delivery
docs.text: Contains the information relative to the delivery of the asset.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryAmount
docs.text: The nearest integral multiple of Base Currency units to which the Delivery Amount will be rounded in accordance with the specified rounding direction.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryCapacity
docs.text: The number of units included in the transaction for each delivery interval

docs.title: Slot: deliveryDateReference
docs.text: Specifies the parameters for identifying the relevant contract date when the commodity reference price is a futures contract.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryDateRollConvention
docs.text: Specifies, for a Commodity Transaction that references a delivery date for a listed future, the day on which the specified future will roll to the next nearby month prior to the expiration of the referenced future. If the future will not roll at all - i.e. the price will be taken from the expiring contract, 0 should be specified here. If the future will roll to the next nearby on the last trading day - i.e. the price will be taken from the next nearby on the last trading day, then 1 should be specified and so on.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryDirection
docs.text: The rounding rule applicable to the Delivery Amount (which can be (i) up to nearest; (ii) down to nearest).

docs.title: Slot: deliveryInLieuRight
docs.text: Delivery In Lieu rights.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryMethod
docs.text: Specifies a delivery method for the security transaction.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryOfCommitments
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Defined in the ISDA published Standard Terms Supplement for use with CDS Transactions on Leveraged Loans. ISDA 2003 Term: Delivery of Commitments.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryPeriod
docs.text: Period and time profile over which the delivery takes place.

docs.title: Slot: deliveryTerm
docs.text: Also called contract month or delivery month. However, it's not always a month. It is usually expressed using a code, e.g. Z23 would be the Dec 2023 contract, (Z = December). For crude oil, the corresponding contract might be called CLZ23. Optional as this can be uniquely identified in the identifier.

docs.title: Slot: delta
docs.text: The ratio of the change in the price of a derivative transaction to the change in the price of the underlying. This field is applicable only to options and swaptions.

docs.title: Slot: demandsAndNotices
docs.text: The optional specification of address where the demands, specifications and notices will be communicated to for each of the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: denominatedCurrency
docs.text: The underlying asset denominated currency.

docs.title: Slot: deprecatedDate
docs.text: When the code ceased to be valid for new uses

docs.title: Slot: deprecationReason
docs.text: Deprecation and Code Descriptions

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: Provides additional information about the commodity underlier.

docs.title: Slot: designatedMaturity
docs.text: Allows a designed maturity to be specified for the fixing time.

docs.title: Slot: designatedPriority
docs.text: Applies to Loan CDS, to indicate what lien level is appropriate for a deliverable obligation. Applies to European Loan CDS, to indicate the Ranking of the obligation. Example: a 2nd lien Loan CDS would imply that the deliverable obligations are 1st or 2nd lien loans.

docs.title: Slot: determinationMethod
docs.text: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

docs.title: Slot: determinationMethodology
docs.text: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

docs.title: Slot: determinationRole
docs.text: Defines the enumerated values to specify the determination roles to the transaction. Such roles mostly address any determination that would be required when some Extraordinary Events would happen, for instance qualifying the effectiveness of such event, or when a calculation is required, etc. else any other kind of determination as need be. Yet for clarity, other kinds of determination may be covered by such roles, which are not necessarily restricted to the scope of Extarordinary Events, depending on particular product specifications e.g. for instance when Calculation Agent is mentioned as the Price Determination Method enumarated value, etc.

docs.title: Slot: determiningParty
docs.text: Specifies the party which determines additional disruption events.

docs.title: Slot: directLoanParticipation
docs.text: A deliverable obligation characteristic. A loan with a participation agreement whereby the buyer is capable of creating, or procuring the creation of, a contractual right in favour of the seller that provides the seller with recourse to the participation seller for a specified share in any payments due under the relevant loan which are received by the participation seller. ISDA 2003 Term: Direct Loan Participation.

docs.title: Slot: directTime
docs.text: An absolute time value expressed in a specific time zone.

docs.title: Slot: direction
docs.text: Direction of the quantity change specified as either an increase, decrease or replacement.

docs.title: Slot: discountFactor
docs.text: A decimal value representing the discount factor used to calculate the present value of cash flow.

docs.title: Slot: discountRate
docs.text: A discount rate, expressed as a decimal, to be used in the calculation of a discounted amount. A discount amount of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: discountRateDayCountFraction
docs.text: A discount day count fraction to be used in the calculation of a discounted amount.

docs.title: Slot: discountingIndex
docs.text: It specifies the interest payable on collateral delivered under a CSA covering the trade.

docs.title: Slot: discountingMethod
docs.text: The parameters specifying any discounting conventions that may apply. This element must only be included if discounting applies.

docs.title: Slot: discountingType
docs.text: The discounting method that is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: discrepancyClause
docs.text: To indicate whether the Discrepancy Clause is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: disputeNotificationReference
docs.text: The determination of whether reference is made to dispute resolution notification timing in the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: disputeResolution
docs.text: The election terms under which a party disputes (i) the Calculation Agents calculation of a Delivery Amount or a Return Amount, or (ii) the Value of any Transfer of Eligible Credit Support or Posted Credit Support.

docs.title: Slot: disputedCashOrSecurityValue
docs.text: Paragraph 5. If a party (a 'Disputing Party') disputes the Value of any Posted Credit Support (IM).

docs.title: Slot: disputingParty
docs.text: Where the party who is not granted with the substitution role at least has a right to dispute the determination given by the counterparty with such role. As an example, a given PartyA is the unique Counterparty with the Role of WhoMaySubstitute, yet PartyB could be Disputing Party in regard of such Role.

docs.title: Slot: distressedRatingsDowngrade
docs.text: A credit event. Results from the fact that the rating of the reference obligation is down-graded to a distressed rating level. From a usage standpoint, this credit event is typically not applicable in case of RMBS trades.

docs.title: Slot: distributionAndInterestPayment
docs.text: The Distributions and Interest Payment terms specified as part of the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: dividendAmountType
