docs.text: Specifies whether the dividend is paid with respect to the Dividend Period.

docs.title: Slot: dividendApplicability
docs.text: The parameters which define whether dividends are applicable

docs.title: Slot: dividendComposition
docs.text: Specifies how the composition of Dividends is to be determined.

docs.title: Slot: dividendCurrency
docs.text: Specifies the currency in which the dividend will be denominated, e.g. the dividend currency, or a specified currency. This class is not specified as such in FpML, which makes use of the CurrencyAndDeterminationMethod.model to specify such terms.

docs.title: Slot: dividendEntitlement
docs.text: Defines the date on which the receiver of the equity return is entitled to the dividend.

docs.title: Slot: dividendObservation
docs.text: To record observations of dividends.

docs.title: Slot: dividendPaymentDate
docs.text: Specifies when the dividend will be paid to the receiver of the equity return. Has the meaning as defined in the ISDA 2002 Equity Derivatives Definitions. Is not applicable in the case of a dividend reinvestment election.

docs.title: Slot: dividendPayoutRatio
docs.text: Specifies the dividend payout ratio associated with each underlier. In FpML 5.10 the payout is positioned at the underlier level, although there is an intent to reconsider this approach and position it at the leg level. This is approach adopted by the CDM.

docs.title: Slot: dividendPeriod
docs.text: One to many time bounded dividend payment periods, each with a dividend payment date per period.

docs.title: Slot: dividendRatio
docs.text: Multiplier value (e.g. 85 %, etc.) to calculate net dividend amount, given gross amount before taking into account the relevant fiscal features.

docs.title: Slot: dividendReinvestment
docs.text: Boolean element that defines whether the dividend will be reinvested or not.

docs.title: Slot: dividendReturnTerms
docs.text: Return terms based upon dividend payments associated to the underlier.

docs.title: Slot: dividendTerms
docs.text: Specifies the dividend requirements if applicable.

docs.title: Slot: dividendValuationDate
docs.text: Specifies the dividend valuation dates of the swap.

docs.title: Slot: dividendValuationDates
docs.text: Specifies the dividend valuation dates of the swap.

docs.title: Slot: documentIdentifier
docs.text: While FpML specifies the document identifier with a value and an associated scheme, the CDM makes use of the Identifier, which has an explicit issuer. The issuer of this identifier is not necessarily the same as the party reference.

docs.title: Slot: documentation
docs.text: Represents the legal document(s) that governs a trade and associated contractual product terms, either as a reference to such documents when specified as part of the CDM, or through identification of some of the key terms of those documents, such as the type of document, the document identifier, the publisher, the document vintage and the agreement date.

docs.title: Slot: domesticCurrencyIssued
docs.text: Identifies that the Security must be denominated in the domestic currency of the issuer.

docs.title: Slot: dutyPayer
docs.text: The payer of documentary duty.

docs.title: Slot: dutyPayerLanguage
docs.text: Bespoke terms specific to the payment of documentary duty.

docs.title: Slot: dutyPaymentDate
docs.text: The date that documentary duty will be paid.

docs.title: Slot: dutyPaymentLanguage
docs.text: Bespoke terms specific to the date that documentary duty will be paid.

docs.title: Slot: earliestCancellationTime
docs.text: The earliest time in a business day that notice of cancelation can be given.

docs.title: Slot: earliestDate
docs.text: The first day when cancelation is permitted to take effect. A party may give notice prior to this date and taken together with the effective period would be necessary to cancel on this date.

docs.title: Slot: earliestExerciseDateTenor
docs.text: The time interval to the first (and possibly only) exercise date in the exercise period.

docs.title: Slot: earliestExerciseTime
docs.text: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) to, and including, the expiration date.

docs.title: Slot: earlyCallDate
docs.text: Date prior to which the option buyer will have to pay a Make Whole Amount to the option seller if he/she exercises the option.

docs.title: Slot: earlyTerminationDate
docs.text: The early termination election.

docs.title: Slot: earlyTerminationDateOptionalLanguage
docs.text: A boolean attribute to specify whether Failure to Pay Early Termination language is included (True) or excluded (False) from the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: earlyTerminationEvent
docs.text: The adjusted dates associated with an individual early termination date.

docs.title: Slot: earlyTerminationProvision
docs.text: Parameters specifying provisions relating to the optional and mandatory early termination of a swap transaction.

docs.title: Slot: economicTerms
docs.text: The price forming features, including payouts and provisions.

docs.title: Slot: effectiveDate
docs.text: When the code became/becomes effective

docs.title: Slot: effectivePeriod
docs.text: Effective period for cancelation when notice is given. This is the period after notice is given that cancellation becomes effecticve.

docs.title: Slot: effectiveTime
docs.text: The time and zone of the date in which the event contractually takes effect.

docs.title: Slot: election
docs.text: The parties' election that qualify the Valuation of Appropriate Collateral in the case where it is deemed applicable.

docs.title: Slot: electiveAmount
docs.text: Specifies an enumerated election to express the elective amount.

docs.title: Slot: eligibilityQuery
docs.text: a copy of the input query that was checked against the eligible collateral specification

docs.title: Slot: eligibilityToHoldCollateral
docs.text: The specification of the conditions under which a party and its custodian(s) are entitled to hold posted collateral.

docs.title: Slot: eligibleCollateral
docs.text: The eligible collateral as specified in relation to the pledgor/chargor/obligor(s) posting obligation.

docs.title: Slot: eligibleCountry
docs.text: The restrictions that might be required by a party and its custodian in terms of country(ies) where the other party's collateral can be held.

docs.title: Slot: eligibleCreditSupport
docs.text: Specification of the Eligible Collateral or Credit Support applicable to the Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: eligibleCurrency
docs.text: A definition of a currency agreed by the parties, typically to indicate the currencies of eligible cash collateral.

docs.title: Slot: eligibleCurrencyInclBaseCurrency
docs.text: A flag detailing whether the Base Currency is included as an Eligible Currency.

docs.title: Slot: eligibleCurrencyOther
docs.text: Utilised where the clause data structure is not able to capture a material aspect of the clause.

docs.title: Slot: email
docs.text: The email address.

docs.title: Slot: endDate
docs.text: The last date of a date range.

docs.title: Slot: endTime
docs.text: The end time of the delivery interval for each block or shape.

docs.title: Slot: enforcementEvent
docs.text: Enforcement Events specific to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: entity
docs.text: Specification of the process agent entity.

docs.title: Slot: entityIdentifier
docs.text: A legal entity identifier with a source (e.g. RED entity code).

docs.title: Slot: entityType
docs.text: Defines the reference entity types corresponding to a list of types in the ISDA First to Default documentation.

docs.title: Slot: equityCashSettlementDates
docs.text: The parameters used to generate the payment date schedule, relative to the equityCalculationPeriod. Per Part 1 Section 12, 'Definitions', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation. Para 73.

docs.title: Slot: equityIndex
docs.text: An enumerated list for equity indices.

docs.title: Slot: equityType
docs.text: Identifies the type of equity.

docs.title: Slot: equityUnderlierProvisions
docs.text: Contains Equity Underlyer provisions regarding jurisdiction and fallbacks.

docs.title: Slot: escrow
docs.text: If this element is specified and set to 'true', indicates that physical settlement must take place through the use of an escrow agent. (For Canadian counterparties this is always 'Not Applicable'. ISDA 2003 Term: Escrow.

docs.title: Slot: eu_EMIR_EligibleCollateral
docs.text: Identifies European Union Eligible Collateral Assets classification categories based on EMIR Uncleared Margin Rules. Eligible Collateral asset classes for both initial margin (IM) and variation margin (VM) posted and collected between specified entities. Please note: EMIR regulation will detail which eligible collateral assets classes apply to each type of entity pairing (counterparty) and which apply to posting of IM and VM

docs.title: Slot: event
docs.text: Specifies the relevant trigger for the Threshold or Minimum Transfer Amount to fall to zero.

docs.title: Slot: eventCurrency
docs.text: Additional Provisions for a Confirmation of an FX or Currency Option Transaction.

docs.title: Slot: eventCurrencyBuyerSeller
docs.text: Unless otherwised specified, the Buyer is the party to which the Event Currency Amount is owed on the Settlement Date and the Seller is the party which owes the Event Currency Amount on the Settlement Date.

docs.title: Slot: eventCurrentAmount
docs.text: Defines the Event Currency Amount to be exchanged on the Settlement Date.

docs.title: Slot: eventDate
docs.text: Specifies the date on which the event is taking place. This date is equal to the trade date in the case of a simple execution. However it can be different from the trade date, for example in the case of a partial termination.

docs.title: Slot: eventDeterminationDate
docs.text: The date in which the credit event is determined by the Credit Derivatives Determinations Comitee.

docs.title: Slot: eventIdentifier
docs.text: The identifier(s) that uniquely identify a lifecycle event. The unbounded cardinality is meant to provide the ability to associate identifiers that are issued by distinct parties. As an example, each of the parties to the event may choose to associate their own identifiers to the event.

docs.title: Slot: eventQualifier
docs.text: The CDM event qualifier, which corresponds to the outcome of the isEvent qualification logic which qualifies the lifecycle event as a function of its features (e.g. PartialTermination, ClearingSubmission, Novation, ...).

docs.title: Slot: eventReference
docs.text: The reference to the instantiation of an Event object, either through a globalKey or an xml-derived id/href mechanism. The definition associated to the Lineage class provides more details with respect to those referencing approaches, their expected usage and available implementation.

docs.title: Slot: eventTime
docs.text: The time and zone of the date in which the event is taking place.

docs.title: Slot: eventsOfDefault
docs.text: The definitions regarding any different events of default relating to the GMSLA.

docs.title: Slot: evergreenProvision
docs.text: A data defining: the right of a party to exercise an Evergreen option

docs.title: Slot: exDate
docs.text: The date on which the corporate action is known to have taken place.

docs.title: Slot: excessDividendAmount
docs.text: Determination of Gross Cash Dividend per Share.

docs.title: Slot: exchange
docs.text: If the Asset is listed, defines the public exchange of the listing.

docs.title: Slot: exchangeDate
docs.text: The bespoke exchange date terms that might be specified by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: exchangeId
docs.text: _ Identifies the exchange from which the reference price should be sourced, using the scheme at the following url: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/external/exchange-id-MIC-1-0_

docs.title: Slot: exchangeTradedContractNearest
docs.text: Specification of the exchange traded contract nearest.

docs.title: Slot: excluded
docs.text: A free format string to specify any excluded obligations or deliverable obligations, as the case may be, of the reference entity or excluded types of obligations or deliverable obligations. ISDA 2003 Term: Excluded Obligations/Excluded Deliverable Obligations.

docs.title: Slot: excludedCollateral
docs.text: The excluded collateral as specified in relation to the pledgor/chargor/obligor(s) posting obligation.

docs.title: Slot: excludedProducts
docs.text: Description of the relevant derivative transactions excluded from the calculation of exposure.

docs.title: Slot: excludedReferenceEntity
docs.text: Excluded reference entity.

docs.title: Slot: excludedTransactions
docs.text: A boolean flag to represent whether any transactions are excluded (ie True) or not (ie False).

docs.title: Slot: exclusiveJurisdiction
docs.text: Classification of optional exclusive jurisdiction terms.

docs.title: Slot: executed
docs.text: Credit limit utilisation attributable to executed trades.

docs.title: Slot: execution
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing an execution primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: executionDetails
docs.text: Specifies the type and venue of execution, e.g. via voice, or electronically.

docs.title: Slot: executionLanguage
docs.text: The bespoke execution language election.

docs.title: Slot: executionLocation
docs.text: The execution location of the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: executionTerms
docs.text: The location and language of execution to determine duty to be paid.

docs.title: Slot: executionType
docs.text: Identifies the type of execution, e.g. via voice, electronically...

docs.title: Slot: executionVenue
docs.text: Represents the venue on which a trade was executed.

docs.title: Slot: exercise
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing an exercise primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseDate
docs.text: Specifies the date on which an option contained within the financial product would be exercised. The date may be omitted if the contractual product allows for only a single date of exercise (European exercise).

docs.title: Slot: exerciseDates
docs.text: The dates that define the Bermuda option exercise dates and the expiration date. The last specified date is assumed to be the expiration date. The dates can either be specified as a series of explicit dates and associated adjustments or as a series of dates defined relative to another schedule of dates, for example, the calculation period start dates. Where a relative series of dates are defined the first and last possible exercise dates can be separately specified.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseFee
docs.text: A fee to be paid on exercise. This could be represented as an amount or a rate and notional reference on which to apply the rate.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseFeeSchedule
docs.text: The fees associated with an exercise date. The fees are conditional on the exercise occurring. The fees can be specified as actual currency amounts or as percentages of the notional amount being exercised.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseFrequency
docs.text: The frequency of subsequent exercise dates in the exercise period following the earliest exercise date. An interval of 1 day should be used to indicate an American style exercise period.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseNotice
docs.text: Definition of the party to whom notice of exercise should be given.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseNoticeGiver
docs.text: Specifies the principal party of the trade that has the right to exercise.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseNoticeReceiver
docs.text: Specifies the party to which notice of exercise should be given, e.g. by the buyer of the option. Although in many cases it is the buyer of the option who sends the exercise notice to the seller of the option, this component is reused, e.g. in case of OptionEarlyTermination, either or both parties have the right to exercise.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseOption
docs.text: Specifies the Option Payout being exercised on the trade.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseProcedure
docs.text: The set of parameters defining the procedure associated with the exercise, e.g. manual exercise.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseQuantity
docs.text: Contains instructions for exercising the option including a quantity change, and optionally a transfer.

docs.title: Slot: exerciseTerms
docs.text: The terms for exercising the option, which include the option style (e.g. American style option), the exercise procedure (e.g. manual exercise) and the settlement terms (e.g. physical vs. cash).

docs.title: Slot: exerciseTime
docs.text: _Specifies the time at which an option contained within the financial product woulld be exercised. The time may be omitted if the contractual product allows for only a single time of exercise (European exercise). _

docs.title: Slot: exhaustionPoint
docs.text: Upper bound percentage of the loss that the Tranche can endure, expressed as a decimal. An exhaustion point of 5% would be represented as 0.05. The difference between Attachment and Exhaustion points is call the width of the Tranche.

docs.title: Slot: existingLoans
docs.text: Are existing loans covered in the event of default (Only relevant to 2010 GMSLAs)?

docs.title: Slot: expectedN
docs.text: Expected number of trading days.

docs.title: Slot: expirationDate
docs.text: The last day within the term of the contract that cancelation is allowed.

docs.title: Slot: expirationDateTime
docs.text: There may be a set period/time restriction associated to the security.

docs.title: Slot: expirationTime
docs.text: The latest time for exercise on expirationDate. It is made mandatory given that for all option styles, this field is required.

docs.title: Slot: expirationTimeType
docs.text: The time of day at which the equity option expires, for example the official closing time of the exchange.

docs.title: Slot: exposure
docs.text: Specification of amendments to the calculation of Exposure in terms of the Transactions covered.

docs.title: Slot: exposureMultiplier
docs.text: Specifies the multiplier applied to exposure based on the credit rating of the rated party.

docs.title: Slot: extendibleProvision
docs.text: A provision that allows the specification of an embedded option with a swap giving the buyer of the option the right to extend the swap, in whole or in part, to the extended termination date.

docs.title: Slot: extendibleProvisionAdjustedDates
docs.text: The adjusted dates associated with an extendible provision. These dates have been adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: extensionEvent
docs.text: The adjusted dates associated with a single extendible exercise date.

docs.title: Slot: extensionFrequency
docs.text: The frequency with which the evergreen contract will be extended if notice is not given.

docs.title: Slot: extensionPeriod
docs.text: The period within which notice can be given that the contract will be extended.

docs.title: Slot: extensionTerm
docs.text: The length of each extension period relative to the effective date of the preceding contract.

docs.title: Slot: externalId
docs.text: _ The FRO name that is being mapped to/from._

docs.title: Slot: externalMappings
docs.text: Any mappings to other codes for this index.

docs.title: Slot: externalStandard
docs.text: The standard/version to which the map applies.

docs.title: Slot: extraordinaryDividendsParty
docs.text: Specifies the party which determines if dividends are extraordinary in relation to normal levels.

docs.title: Slot: fPVFinalPriceElectionFallback
docs.text: Specifies the fallback provisions for Hedging Party in the determination of the Final Price.

docs.title: Slot: facilityType
docs.text: Specifies the type of loan facility (letter of credit, revolving, ...).

docs.title: Slot: failureToDeliver
docs.text: If true, failure to deliver is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: failureToDevliverIndemnityApplies
docs.text: Does paragraph 6.4 (indemnity for failure to redeliver Equivalent Non-Cash Collateral) apply to the GMSLA?

docs.title: Slot: failureToPay
docs.text: The failure to pay election.

docs.title: Slot: failureToPayEarlyTermination
docs.text: A boolean attribute to specify whether Failure to Pay Early Termination language in the agreement is deemed applicable or not.

docs.title: Slot: failureToPayInterest
docs.text: A credit event. Corresponds to the failure by the Reference Entity to pay an expected interest amount or the payment of an actual interest amount that is less than the expected interest amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Failure to Pay Interest.

docs.title: Slot: failureToPayPrincipal
docs.text: A credit event. Corresponds to the failure by the Reference Entity to pay an expected principal amount or the payment of an actual principal amount that is less than the expected principal amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Failure to Pay Principal.

docs.title: Slot: fallBackSettlementRateOption
docs.text: This settlement rate option will be used in its place.

docs.title: Slot: fallback
docs.text: Represents whether a fallback calculation method is applicable. 'True' if fallback calculation method is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackAET
docs.text: Specifies whether automatic termination applies in the event of certain bankruptcy events.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackBondApplicable
docs.text: The applicability of a fallback bond as defined in the 2006 ISDA Inflation Derivatives Definitions, sections 1.3 and 1.8.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackCurrency
docs.text: Specifies a single fallback Termination Currency should the stated currency not be freely available.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackExercise
docs.text: If fallback exercise is specified then the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the swaption, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001). The term in-the-money is assumed to have the meaning defined in the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 17.4. In-the-money.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackLanguageBespokeTerms
docs.text: Where parties may optionnaly describe any extra bespoke agreements about fallback procedure attached to a particular determination role. This fallback bespoke paragraph would typically address topics such as : delay for the Disputing Party to notify a disagreement when receiving a determination from the Calculation Agent ; Independent Third Party Dealers election terms e.g. number of Dealers to be jointly elected by the counterparties ; delay for joint election of Dealers by the counterparties ; further fallback election procedure in case of disagreement between parties to jointly elect all the Dealers e.g. typically each party designates 1 Dealer, each a Party Representant, which thus result in 2 Dealers in charge of joint election of 3 other Dealers who will be the final ones to provide the response, each a Final Dealer ; delay for joint election of the Final Dealers by the Party Representants ; fees repartition e.g. typically cost and fees incurred by the election of Dealers are equally shared by the parties ; etc.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackRate
docs.text: Definition of any fallback rate that may be applicable.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackReferencePrice
docs.text: The method, prioritised by the order it is listed in this element, to get a replacement rate for the disrupted settlement rate option.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackSurveyValuationPostponement
docs.text: Request rate quotes from the market. This element is set as type Empty in FpML. When present, the FpML synonym is mapped to a value True in the CDM.

docs.title: Slot: fallbackToMandatoryMethodDays
docs.text: The specification of the number of days after effective delivery of notice that Mandatory method fallback applies. Specification is only required when one or more Regimes have Fall Back to Mandatory Method elected as a SIMM exception.

docs.title: Slot: feature
docs.text: The option feature, such as quanto, Asian, barrier, knock.

docs.title: Slot: featurePayment
docs.text: The feature payment, i.e. the payment made following trigger occurrence.

docs.title: Slot: feeAmount
docs.text: The amount of fee to be paid on exercise. The fee currency is that of the referenced notional.

docs.title: Slot: feeAmountSchedule
docs.text: The exercise fee amount schedule. The fees are expressed as currency amounts. The currency of the fee is assumed to be that of the notional schedule referenced.

docs.title: Slot: feePaymentDate
docs.text: The date on which exercise fee(s) will be paid. It is specified as a relative date.

docs.title: Slot: feeRate
docs.text: A fee represented as a percentage of some referenced notional. A percentage of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: feeRateSchedule
docs.text: The exercise free rate schedule. The fees are expressed as percentage rates of the notional being exercised. The currency of the fee is assumed to be that of the notional schedule referenced.

docs.title: Slot: finalCalculationPeriodDateAdjustment
docs.text: Business date convention adjustment to final payment period per leg (swapStream) upon exercise event. The adjustments can be made in-line with leg level BDC's or they can be specified separately.

docs.title: Slot: finalFixingDate
docs.text: This attribute is not part of the FpML ResetDate, and has been added as part of the CDM to support the credit derivatives final fixing date.

docs.title: Slot: finalPayment
docs.text: A true/false flag to indicate whether there is a final exchange of principal on the termination date.

docs.title: Slot: finalPaymentDate
docs.text: The last payment when specified as an adjustable or relative date, as in the FpML total return construct.

docs.title: Slot: finalPeriodFeeAdjustment
docs.text: An optional adjustment to the rate for the last period of the evergreen i.e. the period from when notice is given to stop rolling the contract through to the termination date.

docs.title: Slot: finalPrice
docs.text: The final price resulting from the auction.

docs.title: Slot: finalPrincipalExchangeCalculation
docs.text: To be specified only for products that embed a redemption payment.

docs.title: Slot: finalPrincipalPayment
docs.text: Principal Payment at Trade maturity

docs.title: Slot: finalRateRounding
docs.text: The rounding convention to apply to the final rate used in determination of a calculation period amount.

docs.title: Slot: finalReturns
docs.text: A clause providing that final return collateral is to be provided without consideration of any Minimum Transfer Amount and collateral haircut.

docs.title: Slot: finalStub
docs.text: Specifies how the final stub amount is calculated. A single floating rate tenor different to that used for the regular part of the calculation periods schedule may be specified, or two floating tenors may be specified. If two floating rate tenors are specified then Linear Interpolation (in accordance with the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 8.3. Interpolation) is assumed to apply. Alternatively, an actual known stub rate or stub amount may be specified.

docs.title: Slot: finalValuationDate
docs.text: Specifies the final valuation dates of the underlyer.

docs.title: Slot: finalValuationPrice
docs.text: Specifies a final price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

docs.title: Slot: financialUnit
docs.text: Provides an enumerated value for financial units, generally used in the context of defining quantities for securities.

docs.title: Slot: firstCompoundingPeriodEndDate
docs.text: The end date of the initial compounding period when compounding is applicable. It must only be specified when the compoundingMethod element is present and not equal to a value of None. This date may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments.

docs.title: Slot: firstDefinedIn
docs.text: The supplement or version the FRO was first added to the 2006 Definitions or 2021 Floating Rate Matrix. (e.g. S52)

docs.title: Slot: firstName
docs.text: The natural person's first name. It is optional in FpML.

docs.title: Slot: firstObservationDateOffset
docs.text: Defines the offset of the series of pricing dates relative to the calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: firstOrSecondPeriod
docs.text: _2002 ISDA Equity Derivatives Definitions: Dividend Period as either the First Period or the Second Period. | _

docs.title: Slot: firstPaymentDate
docs.text: The first unadjusted payment date. This day may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any business day convention specified in paymentDatesAdjustments. This element must only be included if there is an initial stub. This date will normally correspond to an unadjusted calculation period start or end date. This is true even if early or delayed payment is specified to be applicable since the actual first payment date will be the specified number of days before or after the applicable adjusted calculation period start or end date with the resulting payment date then being adjusted in accordance with any business day convention specified in paymentDatesAdjustments.

docs.title: Slot: firstPeriodStartDate
docs.text: The start date of the calculation period. FpML specifies that for interest rate swaps this date must only be specified if it is not equal to the effective date. It is always specified in the case of equity swaps and credit default swaps with periodic payments. This date may be subject to adjustment in accordance with a business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: firstRegularPeriodStartDate
docs.text: The start date of the regular part of the calculation period schedule. It must only be specified if there is an initial stub calculation period. This day may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments.

docs.title: Slot: fixedAmount
docs.text: Defines that the Threshold is a Fixed Amount.

docs.title: Slot: fixedPaymentAmount
docs.text: A known fixed payment amount.

docs.title: Slot: fixedPrice
docs.text: Specifies the fixed price on which fixed forward payments are based.

docs.title: Slot: fixedRate
docs.text: The value of the fixed rate that was used.

docs.title: Slot: fixedSettlement
docs.text: Used for Recovery Lock, to indicate whether fixed Settlement is Applicable or Not Applicable. If Buyer fails to deliver an effective Notice of Physical Settlement on or before the Buyer NOPS Cut-off Date, and if Seller fails to deliver an effective Seller NOPS on or before the Seller NOPS Cut-off Date, then either: (a) if Fixed Settlement is specified in the related Confirmation as not applicable, then the Seller NOPS Cut-off Date shall be the Termination Date; or (b) if Fixed Settlement is specified in the related Confirmation as applicable, then: (i) if the Fixed Settlement Amount is a positive number, Seller shall, subject to Section 3.1 (except for the requirement of satisfaction of the Notice of Physical Settlement Condition to Settlement), pay the Fixed Settlement Amount to Buyer on the Fixed Settlement Payment Date; and (ii) if the Fixed Settlement Amount is a negative number, Buyer shall, subject to Section 3.1 (except for the requirement of satisfaction of the Notice of Physical Settlement Condition to Settlement), pay the absolute value of the Fixed Settlement Amount to Seller on the Fixed Settlement Payment Date.

docs.title: Slot: fixing
docs.text: The default fixing details.

docs.title: Slot: fixingDate
docs.text: The date on which the fixing is scheduled to occur.

docs.title: Slot: fixingDates
docs.text: The fixing dates are the dates on which the index values are observed. The fixing dates are specified by reference to the reset date through business days offset and an associated set of financial business centers. Normally these offset calculation rules will be those specified in the ISDA definition for the relevant floating rate index (ISDA's Floating Rate Option). However, non-standard offset calculation rules may apply for a trade if mutually agreed by the principal parties to the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: fixingOffset
docs.text: Parameters defining the normal fixing offset (can vary by index tenor / designated maturity).

docs.title: Slot: fixingOffsetDefinition
docs.text: Legal text that underlies the Fixing Offset. ISDA Fixing Offset Definition. (e.g. One day that is either a Sydney Business Day or a Melbourne Business Day following the Reset Date)

docs.title: Slot: fixingOffsetReason
docs.text: Fixing Offset Reason

docs.title: Slot: fixingPeriod
docs.text: Period over which the underlying price is observed.

docs.title: Slot: fixingReason
docs.text: Fixing Reason

docs.title: Slot: fixingTime
docs.text: The time that the fixing will be taken along with a business center to define the time zone.

docs.title: Slot: fixingTimeDefinition
docs.text: Legal text that underlies the Fixing Time. ISDA Fixing Time Definition. (e.g. 09:30, Sydney time).

docs.title: Slot: floatingAmount
docs.text: Floating Amount Calculation

docs.title: Slot: floatingAmountEvents
docs.text: This element contains the ISDA terms relating to the floating rate payment events and the implied additional fixed payments, applicable to the credit derivatives transactions on mortgage-backed securities with pay-as-you-go or physical settlement.

docs.title: Slot: floatingAmountProvisions
docs.text: Specifies the floating amount provisions associated with the floatingAmountEvents.

docs.title: Slot: floatingRate
docs.text: The rates to be applied to the initial or final stub may be the linear interpolation of two different rates. While the majority of the time, the rate indices will be the same as that specified in the stream and only the tenor itself will be different, it is possible to specift two different rates. For example, a 2 month stub period may use the linear interpolation of a 1 month and 3 month rate. The different rates would be specified in this component. Note that a maximum of two rates can be specified. If a stub period uses the same floating rate index, including tenor, as the regular calculation periods then this should not be specified again within this component, i.e. the stub calculation period amount component may not need to be specified even if there is an initial or final stub period. If a stub period uses a different floating rate index compared to the regular calculation periods then this should be specified within this component. If specified here, they are likely to have id attributes, allowing them to be referenced from within the cashflows component.

docs.title: Slot: floatingRateDefinition
docs.text: The floating rate reset information for the calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: floatingRateIndex
docs.text: The reference index that is used to specify the floating interest rate.

docs.title: Slot: floatingRateMultiplier
docs.text: A rate multiplier to apply to the floating rate. The multiplier can be a positive or negative decimal. This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one).

docs.title: Slot: floatingRateMultiplierSchedule
docs.text: A rate multiplier or multiplier schedule to apply to the floating rate. A multiplier schedule is expressed as explicit multipliers and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in the calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The multiplier can be a positive or negative decimal. This element should only be included if the multiplier is not equal to 1 (one) for the term of the stream.

docs.title: Slot: floorRate
docs.text: The floor rate, if any, which applies to the floating rate for the calculation period. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. The floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: floorRateSchedule
docs.text: The floor rate or floor rate schedule, if any, which applies to the floating rate. The floor rate (strike) is only required where the floating rate on a swap stream is floored at a certain strike level. A floor rate schedule is expressed as explicit floor rates and dates and the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The floor rate is assumed to be exclusive of any spread and is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A floor rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: followUpConfirmation
docs.text: A flag to indicate whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

docs.title: Slot: forecastAmount
docs.text: The amount representing the forecast of the accrued value of the calculation period. An intermediate value used to generate the forecastPaymentAmount in the PaymentCalculationPeriod.

docs.title: Slot: forecastPaymentAmount
docs.text: A monetary amount representing the forecast of the future value of the payment.

docs.title: Slot: forecastRate
docs.text: The value representing the forecast rate used to calculate the forecast future value of the accrual period.A value of 1% should be represented as 0.01.

docs.title: Slot: fpmlDescription
docs.text: FpML Description

docs.title: Slot: frenchLawAddendum
docs.text: The French Law Addendum Provisions specific to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: frequency
docs.text: Defines the frequency to be used when defining a quantity. For example a quantity may be specified as a number of barrels of oil per day, which needs multiplying by the number of days in the relevant period to get the total quantity as a number of barrels.

docs.title: Slot: fro
docs.text: The underlying FRO name and designated maturity.

docs.title: Slot: froType
docs.text: FRO type (e.g. OIS)

docs.title: Slot: fullDischarge
docs.text: Full Discharge condition.

docs.title: Slot: fullFaithAndCreditObLiability
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Defined in the ISDA published additional provisions for U.S. Municipal as Reference Entity. ISDA 2003 Term: Full Faith and Credit Obligation Liability.

docs.title: Slot: fundType
docs.text: Identifies the type of fund.

docs.title: Slot: futureValueNotional
docs.text: The future value notional is specific to BRL CDI swaps, and is specified alongside the notional amount. The value is calculated as follows: Future Value Notional = Notional Amount * (1 + Fixed Rate) ^ (Fixed Rate Day Count Fraction). The currency should always match that expressed in the notional schedule. The value date should match the adjusted termination date.

docs.title: Slot: futuresPriceValuation
docs.text: The official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions.

docs.title: Slot: fxDesignatedCurrency
docs.text: When specified, the reference currency for the purpose of specifying the FX Haircut relating to a posting obligation. The list of valid currencies is not presently positioned as an enumeration as part of the CDM because that scope is limited to the values specified by ISDA and FpML. As a result, implementers have to make reference to the relevant standard, such as the ISO 4217 standard for currency codes.

docs.title: Slot: fxFeature
docs.text: Defines quanto or composite FX features that are included in the swap leg.

docs.title: Slot: fxFixingDate
docs.text: The date on which the currency rate will be determined for the purpose of specifying the amount in deliverable currency. This attribute was formerly part of 'NonDeliverableSettlement', which is now being harmonised into a common 'CashSettlementTerms' that includes a 'ValuationDate'.

docs.title: Slot: fxFixingSchedule
docs.text: The date, when expressed as a schedule of date(s), on which the currency rate will be determined for the purpose of specifying the amount in deliverable currency. This attribute was formerly part of 'NonDeliverableSettlement', which is now being harmonised into a common 'CashSettlementTerms' that includes a 'ValuationDate'.

docs.title: Slot: fxHaircut
docs.text: The alternative definition for FX haircut percentage that applies to each party and item of Eligible Collateral unless this item is denominated in a Major Currency or in the Base Currency.

docs.title: Slot: fxHaircutCurrency
docs.text: The reference currency for the purpose of specifying the FX Haircut relating to a posting obligation, as being either the Termination Currency or an FX Designated Currency.

docs.title: Slot: fxHaircutPercentage
docs.text: FX Haircut Percentage means, for any item of Eligible Collateral (IM), the percentage specified in accordance with Paragraph 13.

docs.title: Slot: fxLinkedNotionalAmount
docs.text: The amount that a cashflow will accrue interest on. This is the calculated amount of the FX linked - i.e. the other currency notional amount multiplied by the appropriate FX spot rate.

docs.title: Slot: fxLinkedNotionalSchedule
docs.text: Multiplier specified as an FX-linked schedule, e.g. for a resetting cross-currency swap..

docs.title: Slot: fxRate
docs.text: Specifies a currency conversion rate.

docs.title: Slot: fxSpotRateSource
docs.text: The information source and time at which the spot currency exchange rate will be observed.

docs.title: Slot: generalFundObligationLiability
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Defined in the ISDA published additional provisions for U.S. Municipal as Reference Entity. ISDA 2003 Term: General Fund Obligation Liability.

docs.title: Slot: generalSimmElections
docs.text: The specification of the ISDA SIMM Method for all Covered Transactions with respect to all Regimes.

docs.title: Slot: generalTerms
docs.text: The specification of the non-monetary terms for the Credit Derivative Transaction, including the buyer and seller and selected items from the ISDA 2014 Credit Definition article II, such as the reference obligation and related terms.

docs.title: Slot: global_
docs.text: Global credit limit utilisation amount, agnostic of long/short position direction.

docs.title: Slot: governingLaw
docs.text: Represents the law governing the trade and associated contractual product terms.

docs.title: Slot: governmentalIntervention
docs.text: A credit event. A governmental intervention is an event resulting from an action by a governmental authority that materially impacts the reference entity's obligations, such as an interest rate reduction, principal reduction, deferral of interest or principal, change in priority ranking, or change in currency or composition of payment. ISDA 2014 Term: Governmental Intervention.

docs.title: Slot: gracePeriod
docs.text: The number of calendar or business days after any due date that the reference entity has to fulfil its obligations before a failure to pay credit event is deemed to have occurred. ISDA 2003 Term: Grace Period.

docs.title: Slot: gracePeriodExtension
docs.text: If this element is specified, indicates whether or not a grace period extension is applicable. ISDA 2003 Term: Grace Period Extension Applicable.

docs.title: Slot: growthFactor
docs.text: The daily growth factors, showing the weighted rates divided by the day count basis plus one, giving how much the value grows for each step in the calculation.

docs.title: Slot: guarantor
docs.text: The party that guarantees by way of a contractual arrangement to pay the debts of an obligor if the obligor is unable to make the required payments itself. ISDA 2003 Term: Guarantor.

docs.title: Slot: guarantorReference
docs.text: A pointer style reference to a reference entity defined elsewhere in the document. Used when the reference entity is the guarantor.

docs.title: Slot: guarantorType
docs.text: Specifies the origin of entity guaranteeing the collateral.

docs.title: Slot: haircutIndicator
docs.text: Indicates if the collateral balance amount is based on pre or post haircut, if a haircut is associated with the collateral asset

docs.title: Slot: haircutPercentage
docs.text: Valuation Percentage means, for any item of Eligible Collateral (IM), the percentage specified in accordance with Paragraph 13.

docs.title: Slot: hasControlAgreementLanguage
docs.text: Control Agreement language is specified when True.

docs.title: Slot: highestLowestVariableSet
docs.text: A logical container to hold a defined set of related data. In this case the collation of Ratings Information and associated exposure multiplier where highest or lowest of the associated credit ratings are used when determining the applicable Independent Amount.

docs.title: Slot: history
docs.text: FRO History

docs.title: Slot: holdingAndUsingPostedCollateral
docs.text: The elections for the holding and using of posted collateral by the respective parties to the Credit Support Annex for Variation Margin.

docs.title: Slot: honorific
docs.text: An honorific title, such as Mr., Ms., Dr. etc.

docs.title: Slot: hourMinuteTime
docs.text: A time specified in hh:mm:ss format where the second component must be '00', e.g. 11am would be represented as 11:00:00.

docs.title: Slot: hourminutetime
docs.text: A time specified in a 24-hour notation, e.g. 3pm would be represented as 15:00.

docs.title: Slot: identifer
docs.text: Unique identifier for this record. This can be used to uniquely identify a specific piece of inventory.

docs.title: Slot: identification
docs.text: Identification information about the code list

docs.title: Slot: identifiedCrossCurrencySwap
docs.text: The qualification of whether cross-currency swaps need to be identified in the Confirmation so that the obligations to exchange principal be disregarded for the purpose of determining the Delivery Amount or Return Amount.

docs.title: Slot: identifier
docs.text: Asset Identifiers are used to uniquely identify an Asset, using a specified Asset Identifier Type.

docs.title: Slot: identifierType
docs.text: Defines the symbology source of the Asset Identifier, eg CUSIP, ISIN, etc.

docs.title: Slot: impliedWritedown
docs.text: A credit event. Results from the fact that losses occur to the underlying instruments that do not result in reductions of the outstanding principal of the reference obligation.

docs.title: Slot: inBaseCurrency
docs.text: If True, specifies that the interest transfers should be converted to base currency equivalent, or if False specifies that the transfer should be in the currency of the collateral.

docs.title: Slot: inLoan
docs.text: YES / NO to flag FROs identified by the FpML Syndicated Loan WG as having underlying benchmark that may also be referenced in syndicated loans.

docs.title: Slot: includeAccrualInMarginCalc
docs.text: Indicates whether or not to include the open interest accrual in the margin calculation.

docs.title: Slot: includeCoolingOffLanguage
docs.text: The Pledgor/Obligor/Chargor Rights Event election includes cooling off language when the attribute is set of True.

docs.title: Slot: includesDefaultLanguage
docs.text: Default language is included when True, and excluded when False.

docs.title: Slot: inclusionDate
docs.text: Includes any Transaction specified below that is entered into on or after the specified date.

docs.title: Slot: inclusive
docs.text: Specifies whether the period bound is inclusive, e.g. for a lower bound, false would indicate greater than, whereas true would indicate greater than or equal to.

docs.title: Slot: incurredRecoveryApplicable
docs.text: Outstanding Swap Notional Amount is defined at any time on any day, as the greater of: (a) Zero; If Incurred Recovery Amount Applicable: (b) The Original Swap Notional Amount minus the sum of all Incurred Loss Amounts and all Incurred Recovery Amounts (if any) determined under this Confirmation at or prior to such time.Incurred Recovery Amount not populated: (b) The Original Swap Notional Amount minus the sum of all Incurred Loss Amounts determined under this Confirmation at or prior to such time.

docs.title: Slot: indemnity
docs.text: Specifies whether indemnity applies in the event AET is applicable to one or both of the parties.

docs.title: Slot: independentAmount
docs.text: Specifies the additional amount of collateral that is required to be delivered by a party irrespective of the mark-to-market exposure under the related Transactions. It may take the form of a fixed amount or may be determined using ratings.

docs.title: Slot: independentAmountBalance
docs.text: Represents additional credit support amount over and above mark to market value.

docs.title: Slot: indexAnnexDate
docs.text: A CDS index series annex date.

docs.title: Slot: indexAnnexSource
docs.text: A CDS index series annex source.

docs.title: Slot: indexAnnexVersion
docs.text: A CDS index series version identifier, e.g. 1, 2, 3 etc.

docs.title: Slot: indexCancellation
docs.text: Consequence of index cancellation.

docs.title: Slot: indexDisclaimer
docs.text: If present and true, then index disclaimer is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: indexDisruption
docs.text: Consequence of index disruption.

docs.title: Slot: indexFactor
docs.text: Index Factor is the index version factor or percent, expressed as an absolute decimal value between 0 and 1, that multiplied by the original notional amount yields the notional amount covered by the seller of protection.

docs.title: Slot: indexModification
docs.text: Consequence of index modification.

docs.title: Slot: indexReferenceInformation
docs.text: This attribute contains all the terms relevant to the underlying Index.

docs.title: Slot: indexSeries
docs.text: A CDS index series identifier, e.g. 1, 2, 3 etc.

docs.title: Slot: indexSource
docs.text: The reference source such as Reuters or Bloomberg. FpML specifies indexSource to be of type rateSourcePageScheme, but without specifying actual values.

docs.title: Slot: indexStyle
docs.text: The ISDA FRO style (e.g. term rate, swap rate, etc).

docs.title: Slot: indexTenor
docs.text: The ISDA Designated Maturity, i.e. the floating rate tenor.

docs.title: Slot: indexTransition
docs.text: Specifies inputs needed to process a Index Transition business event.

docs.title: Slot: index_
docs.text: _ The FRO name that is being mapped to/from._

docs.title: Slot: indirectLoanParticipation
docs.text: ISDA 1999 Term: Indirect Loan Participation. NOTE: Only applicable as a deliverable obligation under ISDA Credit 1999.

docs.title: Slot: ineligibleCreditSupport
docs.text: The parties to which the provisions of the Credit Support Annex for Variation Margin will apply to.

docs.title: Slot: infinity
docs.text: Specifies that the Threshold is Infinity. If 'True' then the threshold for the elective party is Infinity.

docs.title: Slot: inflationLag
docs.text: An off-setting period from the payment date which determines the reference period for which the inflation index is observed.

docs.title: Slot: inflationRateIndex
docs.text: The reference index that is used to specify the inflation interest rate.

docs.title: Slot: informationSource
docs.text: A class defining the source of data used in an Observation for any purposes. The data is either sourced from a Provider, or from a Party.

docs.title: Slot: initial
docs.text: The natural person's middle initial(s). If a middle initial is provided then a name should be absent.

docs.title: Slot: initialCustodian
docs.text: Election to specify the initial custodian.

docs.title: Slot: initialDesignation
docs.text: Election to specify the initial custodian.

docs.title: Slot: initialFee
docs.text: An initial fee for the cancelable option.

docs.title: Slot: initialFixingDate
docs.text: The initial fixing date.

docs.title: Slot: initialIndexLevel
docs.text: Initial known index level for the first calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: initialLevel
docs.text: Contract will strike off this initial level. Providing just the initialLevel without initialLevelSource, infers that this is AgreedInitialPrice - a specified Initial Index Level.

docs.title: Slot: initialLevelSource
docs.text: In this context, this is AgreedInitialPrice - a specified Initial Index Level.

docs.title: Slot: initialPayment
docs.text: A true/false flag to indicate whether there is an initial exchange of principal on the effective date.

docs.title: Slot: initialPoints
docs.text: An optional element that contains the up-front points expressed as a percentage of the notional. An initialPoints value of 5% would be represented as 0.05. The initialPoints element is an alternative to marketFixedRate in quoting the traded level of a trade. When initialPoints is used, the traded level is the sum of fixedRate and initialPoints. The initialPoints is one of the items that are factored into the initialPayment calculation and is payable by the Buyer to the Seller. Note that initialPoints and marketFixedRate may both be present in the same document when both implied values are desired.

docs.title: Slot: initialPrincipalPayment
docs.text: Principal Payment made at Trade inception.

docs.title: Slot: initialRate
docs.text: The initial floating rate reset agreed between the principal parties involved in the trade. This is assumed to be the first required reset rate for the first regular calculation period. It should only be included when the rate is not equal to the rate published on the source implied by the floating rate index. An initial rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: initialStockLoanRate
docs.text: Specifies the initial stock loan per ISDA Def. A percentage of 5% is represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: initialStub
docs.text: Specifies how the initial stub amount is calculated. A single floating rate tenor different to that used for the regular part of the calculation periods schedule may be specified, or two floating tenors may be specified. If two floating rate tenors are specified then Linear Interpolation (in accordance with the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 8.3. Interpolation) is assumed to apply. Alternatively, an actual known stub rate or stub amount may be specified.

docs.title: Slot: initialValuationDate
docs.text: Specifies the initial valuation dates of the underlyer.

docs.title: Slot: initialValuationPrice
docs.text: Specifies an initial price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

docs.title: Slot: instruction
docs.text: Specifies the instructions to create the Business Event.

docs.title: Slot: instructionType
docs.text: Identifies the enumeration values to specify the call notification type, direction, specific action type.

docs.title: Slot: integralMultipleAmount
docs.text: A notional amount which restricts the amount of notional that can be exercised when partial exercise or multiple exercise is applicable. The integral multiple amount defines a lower limit of notional that can be exercised and also defines a unit multiple of notional that can be exercised, i.e. only integer multiples of this amount can be exercised.

docs.title: Slot: intendedSettlementDate
docs.text: The intended settlement date of the recall, expressed as an offset against a relative date e.g. T+1. The best practice is that the borrower must make their best efforts to settle on T+1.

docs.title: Slot: intent
docs.text: The intent attribute is meant to be specified when the event qualification cannot be programmatically inferred from the event features. As a result it is only associated with those primitives that can give way to such ambiguity, the quantityChange being one of those.

docs.title: Slot: interest
docs.text: Specifies the general rule for periodic interest rate payment.

docs.title: Slot: interestAmountApplication
docs.text: The application of Interest Amount with respect to the Delivery Amount and the Return Amount.

docs.title: Slot: interestCalculationFrequency
docs.text: Represents how often and when interest is calculated.

docs.title: Slot: interestCalculationParameters
docs.text: Represents the basic interest calculation parameters.

docs.title: Slot: interestHandlingParameters
docs.text: Represents the parameters describing how and when interest transfer occurs.

docs.title: Slot: interestParameters
docs.text: Represents the interest parameters for the various currencies, margin types, posting parties.

docs.title: Slot: interestPaymentHandling
docs.text: Specifies how the collateral interest is to be handled.

docs.title: Slot: interestRate
docs.text: An optional element which can be used to hold a rate associated to this piece of availability.

docs.title: Slot: interestRolloverLimit
docs.text: Specifies the level below which the interest will be rolled over.

docs.title: Slot: interestShortfall
docs.text: A floating rate payment event. With respect to any Reference Obligation Payment Date, either (a) the non-payment of an Expected Interest Amount or (b) the payment of an Actual Interest Amount that is less than the Expected Interest Amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Interest Shortfall.

docs.title: Slot: interestShortfallCap
docs.text: Specifies the nature of the interest Shortfall cap (i.e. Fixed Cap or Variable Cap) in the case where it is applicable. ISDA 2003 Term: Interest Shortfall Cap.

docs.title: Slot: interestShortfallReimbursement
docs.text: An additional Fixed Payment Event. Corresponds to the payment by or on behalf of the Issuer of an actual interest amount in respect to the reference obligation that is greater than the expected interest amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Interest Shortfall Reimbursement.

docs.title: Slot: interimValuationDate
docs.text: Specifies the interim valuation dates of the underlyer.

docs.title: Slot: interimValuationPrice
docs.text: Specifies an interim price schedule to be associated to an individual underlier that is a basket constituent. The multiple cardinality is aligned to the one of the PriceQuantity->price that this price is referencing.

docs.title: Slot: intermediatePayment
docs.text: A true/false flag to indicate whether there are intermediate or interim exchanges of principal during the term of the swap.

docs.title: Slot: intermediatePrincipalPayment
docs.text: Principal Payment as part of the Trade lifecycle e.g. as part of notional reset adjustements in a Cross Currency Swap with a varying notional leg.

docs.title: Slot: interpolationMethod
docs.text: The type of interpolation method that the calculation agent reserves the right to use.

docs.title: Slot: interpolationTerms
docs.text: Describes the rate, tenor, period duration for the short and long stubs, when the accrualRate optionnaly results from an interpolation method.

docs.title: Slot: interpretationTerms
docs.text: The bespoke provision that might be specified by the parties to the agreement applicable to Interpretations.

docs.title: Slot: inventoryRecord
docs.text: An array holding the list of inventory being described. Each element in the inventoryRecord array represents an individual piece of inventory i.e. a security.

docs.title: Slot: isApplicable
docs.text: The Additional Representation is applicable when True, and not applicable when False.

docs.title: Slot: isBaseCurrency
docs.text: The SIMM Calculation Currency (also known as SIMM Reporting Currency) means the Base Currency when True. It means a different currency when False. In that latter case, the SIMM Calculation Currency is specified as part of the currency attribute.

docs.title: Slot: isCreditSupportDocument
docs.text: Unless specified as True, the Control Agreement is not a Credit Support Document under the agreement with respect to a party.

docs.title: Slot: isEligible
docs.text: a simple boolean which is set to true if the asset described in the EligibilityQuery input is eligible

docs.title: Slot: isExchangeListed
docs.text: Defines whether the Asset is listed on a public exchange.

docs.title: Slot: isIncluded
docs.text: A boolean attribute to specify whether collateral critieria are inclusion (True) or exclusion (False) criteria.

docs.title: Slot: isOpenOffer
docs.text: Open Offer

docs.title: Slot: isRecallable
docs.text: Whether the securities on loan can be recalled by the lender.

docs.title: Slot: isSpecified
docs.text: The qualification of whether some other related agreement is specified (True) or not (False).

docs.title: Slot: isTerminationCurrency
docs.text: The reference currency for the purpose of specifying the FX Haircut relating to a posting obligation is the Termination Currency when the Boolean value is set to True.

docs.title: Slot: isWeighted
docs.text: Identifies whether the average values will be weighted or unweighted.

docs.title: Slot: issuanceCutoffTime
docs.text: The operational deadline on T+0 before which a recall must be requested. For the UK, best practice recommends that this would be 30 minutes before market close i.e. 16:00:00 GMT.

docs.title: Slot: issuer
docs.text: The identifier issuer, when specified explicitly alongside the identifier value (instead of being specified by reference to a party).

docs.title: Slot: issuerAgencyRating
docs.text: Represents an agency rating based on default risk and creditors claim in event of default associated with asset issuer.

docs.title: Slot: issuerCountryOfOrigin
docs.text: Represents a filter on the issuing entity country of origin based on the ISO Standard 3166, which is the same as filtering by eligible Sovereigns.

docs.title: Slot: issuerName
docs.text: Specifies the issuing entity name or LEI.

docs.title: Slot: issuerReference
docs.text: The identifier issuer, when specified by reference to a party specified as part of the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: issuerType
docs.text: Specifies the origin of entity issuing the collateral.

docs.title: Slot: itemName
docs.text: In this initial iteration, this corresponds to the DTCC TIW element name.

docs.title: Slot: itemValue
docs.text: In this initial iteration, this corresponds to the DTCC value.

docs.title: Slot: japaneseLawCsa
docs.text: The bespoke definition of whether Japanese Law CSA (VM) are specified by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: japaneseSecuritiesProvisions
docs.text: The Japanese Securities Provisions election.

docs.title: Slot: jurisdictionRelatedTerms
docs.text: The jurisdiction specific terms relevant to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: juryWaiver
docs.text: The Jury Waiver conditions specific to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: knockIn
docs.text: The option only becomes active when a predetermined trigger level is breached.

docs.title: Slot: knockOut
docs.text: The option becomes null and void when a predetermined trigger level is breached.

docs.title: Slot: lag
docs.text: The pricing period per calculation period if the pricing days do not wholly fall within the respective calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: lagDuration
docs.text: Defines the offset of the series of pricing dates relative to the calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: language
docs.text: Indicates the language of the resource, described using the ISO 639-2/T Code.

docs.title: Slot: lastFixingPriceBeforeAdjustment
docs.text: The last fixing price of the Underlier affected by the CorporateAction, before any adjustment with regards to the CorporateAction.

docs.title: Slot: lastPaymentDate
docs.text: The date associated with the last payment in relation to the artefact (e.g. contract) to which this closed state applies. As an example, in the case of an early termination event, it would be the settlement date of the associated fee, if applicable.

docs.title: Slot: lastRegularPaymentDate
docs.text: The last regular payment date when specified as a date, as in the FpML interest rate construct. FpML specifies that this date may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any business day convention specified in the paymentDatesAdjustments attribute.

docs.title: Slot: lastRegularPeriodEndDate
docs.text: The end date of the regular part of the calculation period schedule. It must only be specified if there is a final stub calculation period. This day may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments.

docs.title: Slot: lastUpdatedIn
docs.text: The supplement or version the FRO was last updated in the 2006 Definitions or 2021 Floating Rate Matrix. (e.g. FRO-M-V1)

docs.title: Slot: latestCancelationTime
docs.text: The latest time at which notice of cancelation can be given.

docs.title: Slot: latestExerciseTime
docs.text: For a Bermuda or American style option, the latest time on an exercise business day (excluding the expiration date) within the exercise period that notice can be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent. Notice of exercise given after this time will be deemed to have been given on the next exercise business day.

docs.title: Slot: legacyAlternative
docs.text: Alternative procedures to those in the pre-print for resolving collateral related disputes.

docs.title: Slot: legacyConsent
docs.text: The process for substituting/exchanging one form of collateral held by a party for a different form of collateral, used with legacy agreements.

docs.title: Slot: legacyNamedEntity
docs.text: The identity of the relevant custodian where Named Entity is elected.

docs.title: Slot: legacyVMCustodian
docs.text: Details how the Custodian is determined.

docs.title: Slot: legalAgreement
docs.text: Optional legal agreements associated to the contract being formed, for instance a master agreement.

docs.title: Slot: legalAgreementIdentification
docs.text: The type of legal agreement, identified via a set of composable attributes: agreementName, publisher, governing law and version, e.g. ISDA 2013 Standard Credit Support Annex English Law.

docs.title: Slot: legalDocument
docs.text: The specification of this other agreement, when the qualification is True.

docs.title: Slot: length
docs.text: Indicates the length of the resource. For example, if the resource were a PDF file, the length would be in pages.

docs.title: Slot: lengthUnit
docs.text: The length unit of the resource. For example, pages (pdf, text documents) or time (audio, video files).

docs.title: Slot: lengthValue
docs.text: The length value of the resource.

docs.title: Slot: level
docs.text: The trigger level.

docs.title: Slot: levelPercentage
docs.text: The trigger level percentage.

docs.title: Slot: lien
docs.text: Specifies the seniority level of the lien.

docs.title: Slot: limitAmount
docs.text: The total limit available for the limit level and limit type. While the attribute is of type integer in the CME schema, it has been specified to be of type number in the CDM to take into consideration java size limits as well as for consistency purposes with the way most monetary amounts are expressed.

docs.title: Slot: limitImpactDueToTrade
docs.text: The limit utilized by this specific trade. While the attribute is of type integer in the CME schema, it has been specified to be of type number in the CDM to take into consideration java size limits as well as for consistency purposes with the way most monetary amounts are expressed.

docs.title: Slot: limitLevel
docs.text: The level at which the limit is set: customer business, proprietary business or account level. This attribute is specified as a string as part of the CME clearing confirmation specification.

docs.title: Slot: limitType
docs.text: Standard code to indicate which type of credit line is being referred to - i.e. IM, DV01, PV01, CS01, Notional, Clip Size, Notional, maximumOrderQuantity.

docs.title: Slot: limitedRightToConfirm
docs.text: Has the meaning defined as part of the 1997 ISDA Government Bond Option Definitions, section 4.5 Limited Right to Confirm Exercise. If present, (i) the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent if not done on or before the expiration time on the Expiration date (ii) specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

docs.title: Slot: lineage
docs.text: Pointer to the previous PortfolioState and new Event(s) leading to the current (new) state. Previous PortfolioState in the Lineage can be Null in case this is the start of the chain of Events.

docs.title: Slot: linearInterpolationElection
docs.text: Per Part 1 Section 3, 'Floating Obligations', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation. Para 3.3.

docs.title: Slot: listId
docs.text: The identifier for the list. In the case of a package transaction, this would be the package identifier. This attribute is mandatory to allow the list itself to be identified.

docs.title: Slot: listed
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Indicates whether or not the obligation is quoted, listed or ordinarily purchased and sold on an exchange. ISDA 2003 Term: Listed.

docs.title: Slot: loadType
docs.text: Identification of the delivery profile.

docs.title: Slot: loan
docs.text: Identifies the underlying asset when it is a loan.

docs.title: Slot: loansCanBeGrouped
docs.text: The mark to market can be defined separately for different groups of loans.

docs.title: Slot: localBusinessDay
docs.text: Whether the Notification Time is precluded on the day being a local business day.

docs.title: Slot: localJurisdiction
docs.text: The ISO 3166 standard code for the country within which the postal address is located.

docs.title: Slot: location
docs.text: FpML specifies the timezoneLocationScheme by reference to the Time Zone Database (a.k.a. tz database) maintained by IANA, the Internet Assigned Numbers Authority.

docs.title: Slot: locationIdentifierType
docs.text: Specifies the nature of a location identifier.

docs.title: Slot: locationUri
docs.text: Suggested retrieval location for this version, in genericode format. An application must signal an error to the user if a document retrieved using a LocationUri is not in genericode format.

docs.title: Slot: lockoutCalculation
docs.text: any lockout parameters if applicable.

docs.title: Slot: longPosition
docs.text: Credit limit utilisation attributable to long positions.

docs.title: Slot: lookbackCalculation
docs.text: any lookback parameters if applicable.

docs.title: Slot: lotIdentifier
docs.text: Lot Identifier associated with the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: lowerBarrier
docs.text: All observations below this price level will be excluded from the variance calculation.

docs.title: Slot: lowerBound
docs.text: Specifies the lower bound of a period range, e.g. greater than or equal to 5Y.

docs.title: Slot: mainPublication
docs.text: The current main publication source such as relevant web site or a government body. FpML specifies mainPublication to be of type mainPublicationSource, but without specifying actual values.

docs.title: Slot: majorCurrency
docs.text: The additional currencies that are specified as Major Currency for the purpose of applying the FX Haircut Percentage.

docs.title: Slot: makeWholeAmount
docs.text: Amount to be paid by the buyer of the option if the option is exercised prior to the Early Call Date. (The market practice in the convertible bond option space being that the buyer should be penalised if he/she exercises the option early on.)

docs.title: Slot: mandatoryEarlyTermination
docs.text: A mandatory early termination provision to terminate the swap at fair value.

docs.title: Slot: mandatoryEarlyTerminationAdjustedDates
docs.text: The adjusted dates associated with a mandatory early termination provision. These dates have been adjusted for any applicable business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: mandatoryEarlyTerminationDate
docs.text: The early termination date associated with a mandatory early termination of a swap.

docs.title: Slot: mandatoryEarlyTerminationDateTenor
docs.text: Period after trade date of the mandatory early termination date.

docs.title: Slot: manualExercise
docs.text: Specifies that the notice of exercise must be given by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

docs.title: Slot: manufacturedIncomeRequirement
docs.text: Specifies the proportion of the value of the dividend on the borrowed shares that the borrower is legally obligated to return to the lender.

docs.title: Slot: mappings
docs.text: Any mappings to other FRos.

docs.title: Slot: mapsFrom
docs.text: The predecessor FRO(s) that this index maps to.

docs.title: Slot: mapsTo
docs.text: The successor FRO that this index maps to.

docs.title: Slot: marginApproach
docs.text: Specifies the margin approach specific to Initial Margin agreements.

docs.title: Slot: marginCallAction
docs.text: Specifies the margin call action details, specified as either Delivery or Return.

docs.title: Slot: marginCallResponseAction
docs.text: Specifies the margin call action details, including collateral to be moved and direction.

docs.title: Slot: marginPercentage
docs.text: Specifies a percentage value of transaction needing to be posted as collateral expressed as a valuation. As an example a 104% requirement would be represented as a decimal number 1.04.

docs.title: Slot: marginResponseType
docs.text: Indicates the response type, such as, is the margin call response a 'full' 'part' agreement or 'dispute'.

docs.title: Slot: marginType
docs.text: Specifies the type of margin for which interest is being calculated, if the parameters are different depending on type of margin (initial or variation).

docs.title: Slot: marketDisruption
docs.text: The market disruption event as defined by ISDA 2002 Definitions.

docs.title: Slot: marketFixedRate
docs.text: An optional element that only has meaning in a credit index trade. This element contains the credit spread ('fair value') at which the trade was executed. Unlike the fixedRate of an index, the marketFixedRate varies over the life of the index depending on market conditions. The marketFixedRate is the price of the index as quoted by trading desks.

docs.title: Slot: marketPrice
docs.text: An optional element that only has meaning in a credit index trade. This element contains the price at which the trade was executed and is used instead of marketFixedRate on credit trades on certain indicies which are quoted using a price rather than a spread.

docs.title: Slot: masterAgreementDatedAsOfDate
docs.text: Defines the dates agreed by the parties as the date of the Credit Support Annex or Credit Support Deed.

docs.title: Slot: masterAgreementElections
docs.text: A legal representation of the different possible master agreements

docs.title: Slot: masterAgreementSchedule
docs.text: Elections to specify a Master Agreement Schedule.

docs.title: Slot: masterAgreementType
docs.text: Specification of the master agreement type.

docs.title: Slot: masterConfirmationAnnexType
docs.text: The type of master confirmation annex executed between the parties.

docs.title: Slot: masterConfirmationType
docs.text: The type of master confirmation executed between the parties.

docs.title: Slot: matchingEligibleCriteria
docs.text: if there was a match, this will be the one or more criteria that were supplied in the EligbilityCollateralSpecification which matched with the query input

docs.title: Slot: materialDividend
docs.text: If present and true, then material non cash dividends are applicable.

docs.title: Slot: materialSubsidiaryTerms
docs.text: The meaning of Material Subsidiary for the Event of Default or Termination Event specified.

docs.title: Slot: matrixSource
docs.text: Relevant settled entity matrix source.

docs.title: Slot: matrixTerm
docs.text: Defines any applicable key into the relevant matrix. For example, the Transaction Type would be the single term required for the Credit Derivatives Physical Settlement Matrix. This element should be omitted in the case of the 2000 ISDA Definitions Settlement Matrix for Early Termination and Swaptions.

docs.title: Slot: matrixType
docs.text: Identifies the form of applicable matrix.

docs.title: Slot: maturity
docs.text: Maturity in years

docs.title: Slot: maturityExtension
docs.text: A credit event. Results from the fact that the underlier fails to make principal payments as expected.

docs.title: Slot: maturityRange
docs.text: Represents a filter based on the underlying asset maturity.

docs.title: Slot: maturityType
docs.text: Specifies whether the maturity range is the remaining or original maturity.

docs.title: Slot: maximumBoundaryPercent
docs.text: Maximum Boundary as a percentage of the Strike Price.

docs.title: Slot: maximumBusinessDays
docs.text: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning is dependant on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

docs.title: Slot: maximumDaysOfPostponement
docs.text: The maximum number of days to wait for a quote from the disrupted settlement rate option before proceeding to the next method.

docs.title: Slot: maximumMaturity
docs.text: A deliverable obligation characteristic. An obligation that has a remaining maturity from the Physical Settlement Date of not greater than the period specified. ISDA 2003 Term: Maximum Maturity.

docs.title: Slot: maximumNotionalAmount
docs.text: The maximum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

docs.title: Slot: maximumNumberOfOptions
docs.text: The maximum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date. If the number is not specified, it means that the maximum number of options corresponds to the remaining unexercised options.

docs.title: Slot: maximumStockLoanRate
docs.text: Specifies the maximum stock loan rate for Loss of Stock Borrow. A percentage of 5% is represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: meanAdjustment
docs.text: Specifies whether Mean Adjustment is applicable or not in the calculation of the Realized Volatility, Variance or Correlation

docs.title: Slot: merger
docs.text: Defines the underlier for both the Purchaser Company and the Acquired Compagny involved in Spin Off corporate action, as well as the respective price observation for each.

docs.title: Slot: messageId
docs.text: A unique identifier assigned to the message.

docs.title: Slot: messageInformation
docs.text: Allows details related to the availability messaging use case to be defined

docs.title: Slot: method
docs.text: Method used for the valuation of the transaction by the valuation party.

docs.title: Slot: methodology
docs.text: Indicates the type of equity average trading volume being stated (single) the highest amount on one exchange, or (consolidated) volumes across multiple exchanges.

docs.title: Slot: middleName
docs.text: The natural person's middle name(s). If a middle name is provided then an initial should be absent.

docs.title: Slot: mimeType
docs.text: Indicates the type of media used to store the content. mimeType is used to determine the software product(s) that can read the content. MIME Types are described in RFC 2046.

docs.title: Slot: minimumAssets
docs.text: The minimal level of assets requirement with respect to the custody agent.

docs.title: Slot: minimumBillingAmount
docs.text: daily fee increments accrue until a threshold is crossed, at which point payment becomes due)

docs.title: Slot: minimumBoundaryPercent
docs.text: Minimum Boundary as a percentage of the Strike Price.

docs.title: Slot: minimumFee
docs.text: Indicates the minimum fee amount applied to the billing record, if any.

docs.title: Slot: minimumNotionalAmount
