docs.text: The minimum notional amount that can be exercised on a given exercise date. See multipleExercise.

docs.title: Slot: minimumNumberOfOptions
docs.text: The minimum number of options that can be exercised on a given exercise date.

docs.title: Slot: minimumQuotationAmount
docs.text: In the determination of a cash settlement amount, if weighted average quotations are to be obtained, the minimum quotation amount specifies a minimum intended threshold amount of outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount of the lower of either USD 1,000,000 (or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency) or the quotation amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Minimum Quotation Amount.

docs.title: Slot: minimumRating
docs.text: The minimal rating requirement with respect to the custody agent.

docs.title: Slot: minimumTransferAmount
docs.text: Represents the threshold specified in the agreement below which collateral need not be delivered, and represents the smallest incremental value of exposure that must be reached before the parties are obliged to transfer collateral.

docs.title: Slot: minimumTransferAmountAmendment
docs.text: The bespoke provision that might be specified by the parties to the agreement applicable to Minimum Transfer Amount. Unless specified the definition of Minimum Transfer Amount in any Other Regulatory CSA has the meaning specified in such Other Regulatory CSA.

docs.title: Slot: modifiedEquityDelivery
docs.text: Value of this attribute set to 'true' indicates that modified equity delivery is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: money
docs.text: The money amount to be used as the bound, e.g. 1,000 USD.

docs.title: Slot: monthOfYear
docs.text: Specifies the month of the year if used.

docs.title: Slot: mthToDefault
docs.text: M th reference obligation to default to allow representation of N th to M th defaults.

docs.title: Slot: multipleCreditEventNotices
docs.text: Presence of this element and value set to 'true' indicates that Section 3.9 of the 2003 Credit Derivatives Definitions shall apply. Absence of this element indicates that Section 3.9 shall not apply. NOTE: Not allowed under ISDA Credit 1999.

docs.title: Slot: multipleExchangeIndexAnnexFallback
docs.text: For an index option transaction, a flag to indicate whether a relevant Multiple Exchange Index Annex is applicable to the transaction. This annex defines additional provisions which are applicable where an index is comprised of component securities that are traded on multiple exchanges.

docs.title: Slot: multipleExercise
docs.text: As defined in the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 12.4. Multiple Exercise, the buyer of the option has the right to exercise all or less than all the unexercised notional amount of the underlying swap on one or more days in the exercise period, but on any such day may not exercise less than the minimum notional amount or more that the maximum notional amount, and if an integral multiple amount is specified, the notional amount exercised must be equal to, or be an integral multiple of, the integral multiple amount.

docs.title: Slot: multipleHolderObligation
docs.text: In relation to a restructuring credit event, unless multiple holder obligation is not specified restructurings are limited to multiple holder obligations. A multiple holder obligation means an obligation that is held by more than three holders that are not affiliates of each other and where at least two thirds of the holders must agree to the event that constitutes the restructuring credit event. ISDA 2003 Term: Multiple Holder Obligation.

docs.title: Slot: multipleValuationDates
docs.text: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies (a) the number of applicable valuation dates, and (b) the number of business days after satisfaction of all conditions to settlement when the first such valuation date occurs, and (c) the number of business days thereafter of each successive valuation date. ISDA 2003 Term: Multiple Valuation Dates.

docs.title: Slot: multiplier
docs.text: Defines an optional number that the quantity should be multiplied by to derive a total quantity. This number is associated to a unit. For example in the case of the Coal (API2) CIF ARA (ARGUS-McCloskey) Futures Contract on the CME, where the unit would be contracts, the multiplier value would 1,000 and the mulitiplier unit would be 1,000 MT (Metric Tons).

docs.title: Slot: mutualEarlyTermination
docs.text: Used for specifying whether the Mutual Early Termination Right that is detailed in the Master Confirmation will apply.

docs.title: Slot: name
docs.text: Specifies the taxonomy value as a simple string, which may be associated to an external scheme.

docs.title: Slot: namedAffiliate
docs.text: Details the Named Affiliate where the Rated Party is Named Affiliate.

docs.title: Slot: namedEntity
docs.text: Details the Named Entity where the Rated Party is Named Entity.

docs.title: Slot: naturalPerson
docs.text: Optional information about people involved in a transaction or business process.

docs.title: Slot: necEvent
docs.text: Indicates Control Agreement language related to delivery of a Notice of Exclusive Control.

docs.title: Slot: needsConsent
docs.text: The election as to whether the Pledgor/Obligor/Chargor/Security Provider must obtain the Secured Partys consent for any collateral substitution.

docs.title: Slot: negativeInterest
docs.text: Specifies how negative rates should be applied. If rates go negative, should the payment be reversed (true) or zeroed out (false)?

docs.title: Slot: negativeInterestRateTreatment
docs.text: The specification of any provisions for calculating payment obligations when a floating rate is negative (either due to a quoted negative floating rate or by operation of a spread that is subtracted from the floating rate).

docs.title: Slot: negativeTreatment
docs.text: How to handle negative interest rates.

docs.title: Slot: netInterestWithMarginCalls
docs.text: Indicates whether the interest amount may be offset against any margin call deliver or return amounts? (aka 'net payments' indicator).

docs.title: Slot: netPostedAndHeldInterest
docs.text: Indicates whether to net Held and Posted Interest Payments (i.e. whether interest payable for a period can be netted with interest receivable).

docs.title: Slot: nettingObligationsApply
docs.text: Does paragraph 5.6 (netting of obligations to deliver Collateral and redeliver Equivalent Collateral) apply to the GMSLA?

docs.title: Slot: nextEvent
docs.text: The intended next event can be specified, even if the instructions are not known yet.

docs.title: Slot: noRating
docs.text: What conditions apply where a party has no rating.

docs.title: Slot: noReferenceObligation
docs.text: Used to indicate that there is no Reference Obligation associated with this Credit Default Swap and that there will never be one.

docs.title: Slot: nonCashDividendTreatment
docs.text: Specifies the treatment of Non-Cash Dividends.

docs.title: Slot: nonCashRatio
docs.text: Specifies the non cash actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity underlier. A ratio of 90% should be expressed at 0.90.

docs.title: Slot: nonContractualObligations
docs.text: Specification of whether the Governing Law clause extends to Non-Contractual Obligations (True) or does not extend to Non-Contractual Obligations (False).

docs.title: Slot: nonEnumeratedTaxonomyValue
docs.text: Identifies the taxonomy value when not specified as an enumeration.

docs.title: Slot: nonLegalEntity
docs.text: Specifies a non-legal entity that exists in the agreement with a defined relationship to a Legal entity to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: nonReliance
docs.text: If true, then non reliance is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: nonStandardisedTerms
docs.text: Specifies, when boolean value is True, that additional economic terms exist that have not been included in the product representation.

docs.title: Slot: nonstandardSettlementRate
docs.text: Indicates that a non-standard rate source will be used for the fixing.

docs.title: Slot: notBearer
docs.text: A deliverable obligation characteristic. Any obligation that is not a bearer instrument. This applies to Bonds only and is meant to avoid tax, fraud and security/delivery provisions that can potentially be associated with Bearer Bonds. ISDA 2003 Term: Not Bearer.

docs.title: Slot: notContingent
docs.text: OTE: Only allowed as an obligation characteristic under ISDA Credit 1999. In essence Not Contingent means the repayment of principal cannot be dependent on a formula/index, i.e. to prevent the risk of being delivered an instrument that may never pay any element of principal, and to ensure that the obligation is interest bearing (on a regular schedule). ISDA 2003 Term: Not Contingent.

docs.title: Slot: notDomesticCurrency
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Any obligation that is payable in any currency other than the domestic currency. Domestic currency is either the currency so specified or, if no currency is specified, the currency of (a) the reference entity, if the reference entity is a sovereign, or (b) the jurisdiction in which the relevant reference entity is organised, if the reference entity is not a sovereign. ISDA 2003 Term: Not Domestic Currency.

docs.title: Slot: notDomesticIssuance
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Any obligation other than an obligation that was intended to be offered for sale primarily in the domestic market of the relevant Reference Entity. This specifies that the obligation must be an internationally recognised bond. ISDA 2003 Term: Not Domestic Issuance.

docs.title: Slot: notDomesticLaw
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. If the reference entity is a Sovereign, this means any obligation that is not subject to the laws of the reference entity. If the reference entity is not a sovereign, this means any obligation that is not subject to the laws of the jurisdiction of the reference entity. ISDA 2003 Term: Not Domestic Law.

docs.title: Slot: notRatedBy
docs.text: Defines where conditions apply if no Rating where ratings may not exist.

docs.title: Slot: notSovereignLender
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Any obligation that is not primarily (majority) owed to a Sovereign or Supranational Organisation. ISDA 2003 Term: Not Sovereign Lender.

docs.title: Slot: notSubordinated
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. An obligation that ranks at least equal with the most senior Reference Obligation in priority of payment or, if no Reference Obligation is specified in the related Confirmation, the obligations of the Reference Entity that are senior. ISDA 2003 Term: Not Subordinated.

docs.title: Slot: notation
docs.text: Specifies The credit rating notation. As it varies among credit rating agencies, FpML doesn't specify a default scheme.

docs.title: Slot: noticeDeadlineDateTime
docs.text: A specific date and time for the notice deadline

docs.title: Slot: noticeDeadlinePeriod
docs.text: Defines the min period for notify of a substitution.

docs.title: Slot: noticePeriod
docs.text: The length of each evergreen extension period relative to the effective date of the preceding contract.

docs.title: Slot: notification
docs.text: Specifies the terms describing notification requirements.

docs.title: Slot: notificationDayType
docs.text: The type of days on which notification should occur.

docs.title: Slot: notificationTime
docs.text: The time by which a demand for the Transfer of Eligible Credit Support (IM) or Posted Credit Support (IM) needs to be made in order for the transfer to take place in accordance with the Transfer Timing provisions.

docs.title: Slot: notifyingParty
docs.text: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. ISDA 2003 Term: Notifying Party.

docs.title: Slot: notionalAmount
docs.text: The amount that a cashflow will accrue interest on.

docs.title: Slot: notionalAmountReference
docs.text: A reference to the notional amount.

docs.title: Slot: notionalReference
docs.text: A pointer style reference to the associated notional schedule defined elsewhere in the document.

docs.title: Slot: nthToDefault
docs.text: N th reference obligation to default triggers payout.

docs.title: Slot: number
docs.text: The number to be used as the bound, e.g. 5.

docs.title: Slot: numberOfDataSeries
docs.text: Number of data series, normal market practice is that correlation data sets are drawn from geographic market areas, such as America, Europe and Asia Pacific, each of these geographic areas will have its own data series to avoid contagion.

docs.title: Slot: numberOfObservationDates
docs.text: The number of observation dates between observation start date and observation end date.

docs.title: Slot: numberOfOriginals
docs.text: The number of original documents.

docs.title: Slot: numberOfRatingAgencies
docs.text: Defines the number of Rating Agencies that the Party must be rated by.

docs.title: Slot: numberOfSubstitutionsAllowed
docs.text: Specifies if 1 or more substitutions are allowed.

docs.title: Slot: numberOfValuationDates
docs.text: The number of valuation dates between valuation start date and valuation end date.

docs.title: Slot: numberValuationDates
docs.text: Where multiple valuation dates are specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies (a) the number of applicable valuation dates, and (b) the number of business days after satisfaction of all conditions to settlement when the first such valuation date occurs, and (c) the number of business days thereafter of each successive valuation date. ISDA 2003 Term: Multiple Valuation Dates.

docs.title: Slot: obligationAcceleration
docs.text: A credit event. One or more of the obligations have been declared due and payable before they would otherwise have been due and payable as a result of, or on the basis of, the occurrence of a default, event of default or other similar condition or event other than failure to pay (preferred by the market over Obligation Default, because more definitive and encompasses the definition of Obligation Default - this is more favorable to the Seller). Subject to the default requirement amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Obligation Acceleration.

docs.title: Slot: obligationDefault
docs.text: A credit event. One or more of the obligations have become capable of being declared due and payable before they would otherwise have been due and payable as a result of, or on the basis of, the occurrence of a default, event of default or other similar condition or event other than failure to pay. ISDA 2003 Term: Obligation Default.

docs.title: Slot: obligations
docs.text: A description of any additional obligations secured by the credit support arrangements.

docs.title: Slot: obligee
docs.text: The party to whom obligations under the Master Agreement are owed and secured by the credit support arrangements.

docs.title: Slot: observable
docs.text: Specifies the object to be observed for a price, it could be an asset or an index. The cardinality is optional as some quantity / price cases have no observable (e.g. a fixed rate in a given currency).

docs.title: Slot: observation
docs.text: Specifies inputs needed to process an observation.

docs.title: Slot: observationCapRate
docs.text: A daily observation cap rate.

docs.title: Slot: observationDate
docs.text: Specifies the date value to use when resolving the market data.

docs.title: Slot: observationDates
docs.text: The observation date upon which the rate is observed.

docs.title: Slot: observationEvent
docs.text: Contains all information related to an observation.

docs.title: Slot: observationFloorRate
docs.text: A daily observation floor rate.

docs.title: Slot: observationHistory
docs.text: Represents the observed events related to a particular product or process, such as credit events or corporate actions.

docs.title: Slot: observationIdentifier
docs.text: Represents the observation was made i.e. how to uniquely identify the observed value among the population of all available market data.

docs.title: Slot: observationNumber
docs.text: Observation number, which should be unique, within a series generated by a date schedule.

docs.title: Slot: observationParameters
docs.text: _ any applicable observation parameters, such as daily caps or floors._

docs.title: Slot: observationReference
docs.text: Specifies an identification key for the market observation. This attribute can be used as a reference to assign weights to a series of dates defined in a parametricSchedule.

docs.title: Slot: observationSchedule
docs.text: Specifies a schedule of dates (non-parametric) on which market observations take place, and allows for the optional definition of weights where applicable. When no weight is specified, then weight of each date is assumed to be 1.0

docs.title: Slot: observationShiftCalculation
docs.text: any obervation shift parameters if applicable.

docs.title: Slot: observationTerms
docs.text: Class containing terms that are associated with observing a price/benchmark/index across either single or multple observations. To be used for option contracts that reference a benchmark price.

docs.title: Slot: observationTime
docs.text: Represents the time and time-zone.

docs.title: Slot: observationTimeType
docs.text: The enumerated values to specify points in the day when option exercise and valuation can occur.

docs.title: Slot: observationWeight
docs.text: The number of days weighting to be associated with the rate observation, i.e. the number of days such rate is in effect. This is applicable in the case of a weighted average method of calculation where more than one reset date is established for a single calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: observations
docs.text: Represents an audit of the observations used to produce the reset value. If multiple observations were necessary to produce the reset value, the aggregation method should be defined on the payout.

docs.title: Slot: observedFxSpotRate
docs.text: The actual observed FX spot rate.

docs.title: Slot: observedRate
docs.text: The actual observed rate before any required rate treatment is applied, e.g. before converting a rate quoted on a discount basis to an equivalent yield. An observed rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: observedRates
docs.text: The value observed for that date

docs.title: Slot: observedValue
docs.text: Specifies the observed value as a number.

docs.title: Slot: offsetDays
docs.text: Specifies how many days from the trigger event should the payment occur.

docs.title: Slot: offsetMultiplier
docs.text: A time offset multiplier, e.g. 1, 2 or 3 etc. A negative value can be used when specifying a negative offset, e.g. -2 hours.

docs.title: Slot: offsetTimeUnit
docs.text: _The unit of time for the offset (e.g., seconds, minutes, hours, days). _

docs.title: Slot: onBehalfOf
docs.text: Optionally specifies the counterparty that the ancillary party is acting on behalf of.

docs.title: Slot: onFullReturn
docs.text: Indicates the option that accrued interest should be calculated and distributed when a full return of collateral occurs.

docs.title: Slot: onPartialReturn
docs.text: Indicates the option that accrued interest should be calculated and distributed when a partial return collateral occurs.

docs.title: Slot: oneWayProvisions
docs.text: The determination of whether the One Way Provisions are applicable (true) or not applicable (false).

docs.title: Slot: openDateTime
docs.text: The date and time when the position was opened.

docs.title: Slot: openUnits
docs.text: The number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this element is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

docs.title: Slot: operand
docs.text: The 2nd value in the arithmetic operation, which may be non-commutative in some cases: Subtract, Divide). The 2nd operand is called 'operand' to distinguish it from the 1st one which is the price anchor.

docs.title: Slot: operandType
docs.text: Optionally qualifies the type of operand: e.g. accrued or forward point.

docs.title: Slot: optionType
docs.text: The type of option, ie Put or Call. Left empty if it is a Future.

docs.title: Slot: optionalEarlyTermination
docs.text: An option for either or both parties to terminate the swap at fair value.

docs.title: Slot: optionalEarlyTerminationAdjustedDates
docs.text: An early termination provision to terminate the trade at fair value where one or both parties have the right to decide on termination.

docs.title: Slot: optionalEarlyTerminationParameters
docs.text: Definition of the first early termination date and the frequency of the termination dates subsequent to that. American exercise is defined by having a frequency of one day.

docs.title: Slot: optionsExchangeDividends
docs.text: If present and true, then options exchange dividends are applicable.

docs.title: Slot: optionsPriceValuation
docs.text: The official settlement price as announced by the related exchange is applicable, in accordance with the ISDA 2002 definitions

docs.title: Slot: ordinal
docs.text: In the case of multi-layered hierarchical classification systems such as commodity classification, the layer the value and className occupy in the classification hierarchy, where 1 represents the top-layer.

docs.title: Slot: othReferenceEntityObligations
docs.text: This element is used to specify any other obligations of a reference entity in both obligations and deliverable obligations. The obligations can be specified free-form. ISDA 2003 Term: Other Obligations of a Reference Entity.

docs.title: Slot: other
docs.text: Utilised where the clause data structure is not able to capture a material aspect of the clause.

docs.title: Slot: otherAgreement
docs.text: Definition of an agreement that is not enumerated in the CDM.

docs.title: Slot: otherAgreementType
docs.text: The agreement executed between the parties and intended to govern product-specific derivatives transactions between those parties.

docs.title: Slot: otherAgreements
docs.text: The bespoke definition of other agreement terms as specified by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: otherAssetType
docs.text: Specifies the eligible asset type when not enumerated.

docs.title: Slot: otherCSA
docs.text: The bespoke definition of Other CSA as specified by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: otherDetails
docs.text: Any specfic elections that are not captured by the above options, such as grouping information.

docs.title: Slot: otherEligibleAndPostedSupport
docs.text: The Other Eligible Support elections associated with margin agreements.

docs.title: Slot: otherEligibleSupport
docs.text: Specifies the Other Eligible Support conditions. If not specified, this election is deemed as not applicable.

docs.title: Slot: otherEligibleSupportIM
docs.text: The Other Eligible Support election. If not specified, this election is deemed as not applicable.

docs.title: Slot: otherLanguage
docs.text: Bespoke execution language to be included when specified.

docs.title: Slot: otherParty
docs.text: The role(s) that other party(ies) may have in relation to the legal agreement, further to the contractual parties.

docs.title: Slot: otherProvisions
docs.text: Other Custom Provisions of Custody Arrangements.

docs.title: Slot: otherSpecifiedEntityTerms
docs.text: The non standard terms for the Event of Default or Termination Event specified.

docs.title: Slot: otherTerms
docs.text: The custom Resolution Time election that might be specified by the parties.

docs.title: Slot: outlook
docs.text: Assesses the potential direction of a long-term credit rating over the intermediate term, which is generally up to two years for investment grade and generally up to one year for speculative grade.

docs.title: Slot: overallExposure
docs.text: Represents the whole overall mark to market value or IM calculation value of the trade portfolio as recorded by the principle (in base currency).

docs.title: Slot: ownershipPartyReference
docs.text: A reference to the party that has ownership of this party role information. FpML specifies that For shared trade information, this attribute will reference the originator of the data (for example, an execution facility or clearing house).

docs.title: Slot: packageInformation
docs.text: Specifies the package information in case the business event represents several trades executed as a package (hence this attribute is optional). The package information is only instantiated once at the business event level to preserve referential integrity, whereas individual trades make reference to it to identify that they are part of a package.

docs.title: Slot: packageReference
docs.text: A reference to the package linking the trade with other trades, in case the trade was executed as part of a package (hence this attribute is optional).

docs.title: Slot: parametricDates
docs.text: _Specifies parametric terms to determine which days within a given calculation period the price would be observed. Typically associated with Commodities. _

docs.title: Slot: parentParty
docs.text: Represents the identification of a parent child relationship between two entities in the Umbrella agreement, allowing non-legal entities to be linked to the appropriate legal entity and allowing funds, portfolio or managed accounts to be linked to their applicable Investment Manager or Agent within the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: parentSecurity
docs.text: Defines the underlier for the Parent Company involved in Spin Off corporate action.

docs.title: Slot: parentSecurityPrice
docs.text: The price observation that relates to underlier for the Parent Company.

docs.title: Slot: partialCashSettlement
docs.text: Specifies whether either 'Partial Cash Settlement of Assignable Loans', 'Partial Cash Settlement of Consent Required Loans' or 'Partial Cash Settlement of Participations' is applicable. If this element is specified and Assignable Loan is a Deliverable Obligation Characteristic, any Assignable Loan that is deliverable, but where a non-receipt of Consent by the Physical Settlement Date has occurred, the Loan can be cash settled rather than physically delivered. If this element is specified and Consent Required Loan is a Deliverable Obligation Characteristic, any Consent Required Loan that is deliverable, but where a non-receipt of Consent by the Physical Settlement Date has occurred, the Loan can be cash settled rather than physically delivered. If this element is specified and Direct Loan Participation is a Deliverable Obligation Characteristic, any Participation that is deliverable, but where this participation has not been effected (has not come into effect) by the Physical Settlement Date, the participation can be cash settled rather than physically delivered.

docs.title: Slot: partialExercise
docs.text: As defined in the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 12.3. Partial Exercise, the buyer of the option has the right to exercise all or less than all the notional amount of the underlying swap on the expiration date, but may not exercise less than the minimum notional amount, and if an integral multiple amount is specified, the notional amount exercised must be equal to, or be an integral multiple of, the integral multiple amount.

docs.title: Slot: parties
docs.text: Defines all parties to that execution, including agents and brokers.

docs.title: Slot: party
docs.text: Specifies whether the debt security is redeemed at the election of the Issuer/Holder.

docs.title: Slot: party1
docs.text: First party facing the CCP if it is clearing for its own account.

docs.title: Slot: party2
docs.text: Second party facing the CCP if it is clearing for its own account.

docs.title: Slot: partyChange
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing a party change primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: partyCustomisedWorkflow
docs.text: Workflow data that is specific to certain market participants and is expressed as part of the CDM in a very generic manner, which can be party-specific. The initial use cases have been derived from the CME clearing and the DTCC TIW submissions.

docs.title: Slot: partyElection
docs.text: A qualification as to whether the Additional Representation is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: partyElections
docs.text: The party elective amounts.

docs.title: Slot: partyId
docs.text: The identifier associated with a party, e.g. the 20 digits LEI code.

docs.title: Slot: partyName
docs.text: The party name to which the workflow pertains to.

docs.title: Slot: partyOptionTerminationCurrency
docs.text: Provides that the Termination Currency will be determined by reference to a contractual mechanism when closing out the Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: partyReference
docs.text: Specifies the party that is associated to the counterparty.

docs.title: Slot: partyRole
docs.text: Specifies an additional party roles to be added on to the new transaction.

docs.title: Slot: partyRoles
docs.text: Defines the role(s) that party(ies) may have in relation to the execution.

docs.title: Slot: partyVersion
docs.text: The party which the specified SIMM version applies to.

docs.title: Slot: passThrough
docs.text: Specifies the rules for pass-through payments from the underlier, such as dividends.

docs.title: Slot: passThroughItem
docs.text: One to many pass through payment items.

docs.title: Slot: passThroughPercentage
docs.text: Percentage of payments from the underlier which are passed through.

docs.title: Slot: payDate
docs.text: The date on which resulting from the corporate action are delivered.

docs.title: Slot: payRelativeTo
docs.text: Specifies whether the payments occur relative to each adjusted calculation period start date or end date, each reset date, valuation date or the last pricing date. Calculation period start date means relative to the start of the first calculation period contributing to a given payment. Similarly, calculation period end date means the end of the last calculation period contributing to a given payment. The valuation date is applicable for Brazilian-CDI and equity swaps.

docs.title: Slot: payer
docs.text: Specifies the counterparty responsible for making the payments defined by this structure. The party is one of the two principal parties to the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: payerAccountReference
docs.text: A reference to the account responsible for making the payments defined by this structure.

docs.title: Slot: payerPartyReference
docs.text: The party responsible for making the payments defined by this structure.

docs.title: Slot: paymentAmount
docs.text: A fixed payment amount.

docs.title: Slot: paymentBusinessCenter
docs.text: Specifies applicable business centers for payments.

docs.title: Slot: paymentCalculationPeriod
docs.text: The adjusted payment date and associated calculation period parameters required to calculate the actual or projected payment amount. A list of payment calculation period elements may be ordered in the document by ascending adjusted payment date. An FpML document containing an unordered list of payment calculation periods is still regarded as a conformant document.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDate
docs.text: The feature payment date.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDateOffset
docs.text: Only to be used when SharePayment has been specified in the dividendDateReference element. The number of Currency Business Days following the day on which the Issuer of the Shares pays the relevant dividend to holders of record of the Shares.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDateSchedule
docs.text: The payment dates when specified as relative to a set of dates specified somewhere else in the instance document/transaction, e.g. the valuation dates as typically the case for equity swaps, or when specified as a calculation period schedule.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDates
docs.text: Defines the payment date schedule, as defined by the parameters that are needed to specify it, either in a parametric way or by reference to another schedule of dates (e.g. the valuation dates).

docs.title: Slot: paymentDatesAdjustments
docs.text: The definition of the business day convention and financial business centers used for adjusting the payment date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business center.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDatesReference
docs.text: A set of href pointers to payment dates defined somewhere else in the document.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDaysOffset
docs.text: If early payment or delayed payment is required, specifies the number of days offset that the payment occurs relative to what would otherwise be the unadjusted payment date. The offset can be specified in terms of either calendar or business days. Even in the case of a calendar days offset, the resulting payment date, adjusted for the specified calendar days offset, will still be adjusted in accordance with the specified payment dates adjustments. This element should only be included if early or delayed payment is applicable, i.e. if the periodMultiplier element value is not equal to zero. An early payment would be indicated by a negative periodMultiplier element value and a delayed payment (or payment lag) would be indicated by a positive periodMultiplier element value.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDelay
docs.text: Applicable to CDS on MBS to specify whether payment delays are applicable to the fixed Amount. RMBS typically have a payment delay of 5 days between the coupon date of the reference obligation and the payment date of the synthetic swap. CMBS do not, on the other hand, with both payment dates being on the 25th of each month.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDetail
docs.text: An attribute that specifies a payment as the combination of a payment amount, a payment date and an associated payment calculation rule.

docs.title: Slot: paymentDiscounting
docs.text: FpML specifies the FpML PaymentDiscounting.model group for representing the discounting elements that can be associated with a payment.

docs.title: Slot: paymentFrequency
docs.text: The frequency at which regular payment dates occur. If the payment frequency is equal to the frequency defined in the calculation period dates component then one calculation period contributes to each payment amount. If the payment frequency is less frequent than the frequency defined in the calculation period dates component then more than one calculation period will contribute to the payment amount. A payment frequency more frequent than the calculation period frequency or one that is not a multiple of the calculation period frequency is invalid. If the payment frequency is of value T (term), the period is defined by the effectiveDate and the terminationDate.

docs.title: Slot: paymentPercent
docs.text: A percentage of the notional amount.

docs.title: Slot: paymentRequirement
docs.text: Specifies a threshold for the failure to pay credit event. Market standard is USD 1,000,000 (JPY 100,000,000 for Japanese Yen trades) or its equivalent in the relevant obligation currency. This is applied on an aggregate basis across all Obligations of the Reference Entity. Intended to prevent technical/operational errors from triggering credit events. ISDA 2003 Term: Payment Requirement

docs.title: Slot: paymentRule
docs.text: The calculation rule.

docs.title: Slot: payoutReference
docs.text: Represents the origin to the transfer as a reference for lineage purposes, whether it originated from trade level settlement terms or from payment terms on an economic payout.

docs.title: Slot: pending
docs.text: Credit limit utilisation attributable to pending unexecuted orders.

docs.title: Slot: perUnitOf
docs.text: Provides an attribute to define the unit of the thing being priced. For example, {amount, unitOfAmount, PerUnitOfAmount} = [10, EUR, Shares] = (10.00 EUR/SHARE) * (300,000 SHARES) = EUR 3,000,000.00 (Shares cancel out in the calculation).

docs.title: Slot: percentageLimit
docs.text: Specifies the perecentage of collateral limit represented as a decimal number - example 25% is 0.25.

docs.title: Slot: percentageRule
docs.text: This attribute is not present as part of the FpML construct, as the payment rule is specialised by means of runtime type extension through the xsi:type.

docs.title: Slot: performance
docs.text: Performance calculation, in accordance with Part 1 Section 12 of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap, Para 75. 'Equity Performance'. Cumulative performance is used as a notional multiplier factor on both legs of an Equity Swap.

docs.title: Slot: period
docs.text: A time period, e.g. a day, week, month, year or term of the stream.

docs.title: Slot: periodDatesAdjustments
docs.text: The specification of the business day convention and financial business centers used for adjusting any calculation period date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business center.

docs.title: Slot: periodFrequency
docs.text: The frequency at which calculation period end dates occur with the regular part of the calculation period schedule and their roll date convention.

docs.title: Slot: periodMultiplier
docs.text: A time period multiplier, e.g. 1, 2, or 3. If the period value is T (Term) then period multiplier must contain the value 1.

docs.title: Slot: periodSkip
docs.text: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

docs.title: Slot: periodicDates
docs.text: A calculation period schedule.

docs.title: Slot: periodicSchedule
docs.text: Specifies the date range and frequency on which market observations take place. Weights can be assigned to dates in the schedule by assigning the weight and corresponding observationReference in the observationSchedule.

docs.title: Slot: periodicity
docs.text: The qualification of the Interest Adjustment periodicity.

docs.title: Slot: periods
docs.text: Defines the periods of delivery, including the delivery profile.

docs.title: Slot: person
docs.text: The person(s) who might be associated with the party as part of the execution, contract or legal document.

docs.title: Slot: personId
docs.text: The identifier associated with a person, e.g. the internal identification code.

docs.title: Slot: personReference
docs.text: A reference to the natural person to whom the role refers to.

docs.title: Slot: personRole
docs.text: _The role of the person(s) _

docs.title: Slot: physicalSettlementPeriod
docs.text: The number of business days used in the determination of the physical settlement date. The physical settlement date is this number of business days after all applicable conditions to settlement are satisfied. If a number of business days is not specified fallback provisions apply for determining the number of business days. If Section 8.5/8.6 of the 1999/2003 ISDA Definitions are to apply the businessDaysNotSpecified element should be included. If a specified number of business days are to apply these should be specified in the businessDays element. If Section 8.5/8.6 of the 1999/2003 ISDA Definitions are to apply but capped at a maximum number of business days then the maximum number should be specified in the maximumBusinessDays element. ISDA 2003 Term: Physical Settlement Period.

docs.title: Slot: physicalSettlementTerms
docs.text: Specifies the physical settlement terms which apply to the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: physicalSettlementTermsReference
docs.text: Reference to the physical settlement terms applicable to this item.

docs.title: Slot: pledgedAccount
docs.text: The pledged account associated with the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: pledgeeRepresentativeRider
docs.text: The terms of the Rider for the ISDA Euroclear 2019 Collateral Transfer Agreement with respect to the use of a Pledgee Representative attached to this Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: portfolioIdentifier
docs.text: Specifies a unique identifier for a set of collateral positions in a portfolio.

docs.title: Slot: portfolioReturnTerms
docs.text: Specifies an individual type of return of a Performance Payout, when such individual return is part of an aggregation of multiple similar returns, at Performance Payout level

docs.title: Slot: portfolioState
docs.text: Describes the state of the Portfolio as a list of Positions resulting from the aggregation.

docs.title: Slot: portfolioStateReference
docs.text: The reference to the previous state of a Portfolio, in a chain of Events leading up to a build of that Portfolio as the holding of Product(s) in specific Quantity(ies). As part of the PortfolioState object, a pointer to the previous PortfolioState is provided through a Lineage object, together with pointer(s) to the Event or set of Events leading up to the current (new) state.

docs.title: Slot: positionBase
docs.text: Encapsulates the core constituents that characterize a position.

docs.title: Slot: positionIdentifier
docs.text: Represents the identifier(s) that uniquely identify a position for an identity issuer. A position can include multiple identifiers, for example an internal position identifer and a UTI (Unique Trade Identifier).

docs.title: Slot: positionState
docs.text: Identifies the state of the position, to distinguish if just executed, formed, already settled, closed, etc.

docs.title: Slot: positionStatus
docs.text: To aggregate based on position status (EXECUTED, SETTLED etc)

docs.title: Slot: positions
docs.text: The list of positions, each containing a Quantity and a Product.

docs.title: Slot: postalCode
docs.text: The code, required for computerized mail sorting systems, that is allocated to a physical address by a national postal authority.

docs.title: Slot: postingObligations
docs.text: The security providers posting obligations.

docs.title: Slot: postingParty
docs.text: The Posting Party for the purposes of One Way Provisions. It is specified in the case where the One Way Provision is deemed applicable.

docs.title: Slot: precision
docs.text: Specifies the rounding precision in terms of a number of decimal places when the number is evaluated in decimal form (not percentage), e.g. 0.09876543 rounded to the nearest 5 decimal places is 0.0987654.

docs.title: Slot: predeterminedClearingOrganizationParty
docs.text: Specifies the clearing organization (CCP, DCO) to which the trade should be cleared.

docs.title: Slot: premiumType
docs.text: (Optionally) Additional attribute that can further define any premium to the price.

docs.title: Slot: prescribedDocumentationAdjustment
docs.text: This may be used to indicate that 'prescribed documentation adjustment' is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: presentValueAmount
docs.text: A monetary amount representing the present value of the forecast payment.

docs.title: Slot: presentValuePrincipalAmount
docs.text: The amount representing the present value of the principal payment.

docs.title: Slot: previousWorkflowStep
docs.text: Optional previous workflow step that provides lineage to workflow steps that precedes it.

docs.title: Slot: price
docs.text: The price of the package.

docs.title: Slot: priceComponent
docs.text: Denotes the price used to compute the valuation.

docs.title: Slot: priceExpression
docs.text: (Optionally) Specifies whether the price is expressed in absolute or percentage terms.

docs.title: Slot: pricePublisher
docs.text: Defines a publication in which the price can be found. (e.g Gas Daily, Platts Bloomberg. Commodity publishers can be found at this URL: http://www.fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-information-provider>

docs.title: Slot: priceQuantity
docs.text: Defines the prices (e.g. spread, equity price, FX rate), quantities (e.g. currency amount, no. shares) and settlement terms (e.g. initial fee, broker fee, up-front cds payment or option premium settlement) associated with the constituents of the transacted product.

docs.title: Slot: priceQuoteType
docs.text: Describes the required quote type of the underlying price that will be observed. Example values include 'Bid, 'Ask', 'Settlement' (for a futures contract) and 'WeightedAverage' (for some published prices and indices).

docs.title: Slot: priceReturnTerms
docs.text: Return terms based upon the underlier's observed price.

docs.title: Slot: priceSchedule
docs.text: A payout's price specified as a schedule, which may also contain a single value if that price is constant. There may be multiple prices specified for a single payout: e.g. a floating interest rate leg may specify a spread, a cap and/or floor and a multiplier. The price must be specified outside of the payout in a PriceQuantity object and only referenced inside the payout using an address.

docs.title: Slot: priceSource
docs.text: Specifies a publication that provides the commodity price, including, where applicable the details of where in the publication the price is published. Applicable when the commodity reference price is not a futures contract

docs.title: Slot: priceSourceHeading
docs.text: Specifies the heading or field name for the price on a given page or screen, where applicable.

docs.title: Slot: priceSourceLocation
docs.text: Specifies the location of the price which may be a specific page, electornic screen name, or a code (e.g. a RIC code) where the price can be found.

docs.title: Slot: priceSourceTime
docs.text: Specifies the time at which the price should be observed.

docs.title: Slot: priceSubType
docs.text: Allows further classification of the chosen price type.

docs.title: Slot: priceTimeIntervalQuantity
docs.text: Price per quantity per delivery time interval.

docs.title: Slot: priceType
docs.text: Specifies the price type as an enumeration: interest rate, exchange rate, asset price etc. This attribute is mandatory so that prices can always be clasiffied according to their type. The price type implies some constraints on the price's units.

docs.title: Slot: pricingDates
docs.text: Specifies specific dates or parametric rules for the dates on which the price will be determined.

docs.title: Slot: pricingMethodElection
docs.text: Per Part 1 Section 5, 'Pricing', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation, Para 5.1.

docs.title: Slot: pricingTime
docs.text: The regional exchange close time for the underlying contract,including time zone, at which the trades should be priced. This provides an indication for which regional snapshot should be used for pricing primarily for Global markets where there are multiple regional close times.

docs.title: Slot: primaryAssetClass
docs.text: Classifies the most important risk class of the trade.

docs.title: Slot: primaryContactInformation
docs.text: The main notice/address information of the party.

docs.title: Slot: primaryFxSpotRateSource
docs.text: Specifies the primary source from which a rate should be observed.

docs.title: Slot: primaryObligor
docs.text: The entity primarily responsible for repaying debt to a creditor as a result of borrowing or issuing bonds. ISDA 2003 Term: Primary Obligor.

docs.title: Slot: primaryObligorReference
docs.text: A pointer style reference to a reference entity defined elsewhere in the document. Used when the reference entity is the primary obligor.

docs.title: Slot: primarySource
docs.text: The primary source for where the rate observation will occur. Will typically be either a page or a reference bank published rate.

docs.title: Slot: primitiveInstruction
docs.text: Specifies the primitive instructions that will be used to call primitive event functions.

docs.title: Slot: principal
docs.text: Specifies the general rule for repayment of principal.

docs.title: Slot: principalAmount
docs.text: When known at the time the transaction is made, the cash amount to be paid.

docs.title: Slot: principalPayment
docs.text: The specification of the principal exchange. Optional as only applicable in the case of cross-currency or zero-coupon swaps with a final payment.

docs.title: Slot: principalPaymentDate
docs.text: The date where the PrincipalPayment shall be settled.

docs.title: Slot: principalPaymentSchedule
docs.text: Describe dates schedules for Principal Exchanges and related role of the parties when known.

docs.title: Slot: principalShortfallReimbursement
docs.text: An additional Fixed Payment Event. Corresponds to the payment by or on behalf of the Issuer of an actual principal amount in respect to the reference obligation that is greater than the expected principal amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Principal Shortfall Reimbursement.

docs.title: Slot: processAgent
docs.text: The Process Agent that might be appointed by the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: processedRate
docs.text: The value of the rate after processing.

docs.title: Slot: processedRates
docs.text: The value after any processing, such as application of caps or floors.

docs.title: Slot: processingDetails
docs.text: Details fo the floating rate treatment after the rate is observed or calculated. This will include details of things like multipliers, spreads, caps and floors, and the raw and treated rates.

docs.title: Slot: product
docs.text: Defines the financial product to be executed and contract formed.

docs.title: Slot: productQualifier
docs.text: Derived from the product payout features using a CDM product qualification function that determines the product type based on the product payout features.

docs.title: Slot: profile
docs.text: Defines the delivery profile of the asset, including the load type and the delivery intervals.

docs.title: Slot: propertyType
docs.text: Specifies the type of property when the security is linked to a property asset.

docs.title: Slot: proposedEvent
docs.text: The proposed event for a workflow step.

docs.title: Slot: protectedParty
docs.text: This may be used to specify which party is protected (e.g. under Replacement Value cash settlement methods).

docs.title: Slot: protectionTerms
docs.text: Specifies the terms for calculating a payout to protect the buyer of the swap in the case of a qualified credit event. These terms include the applicable credit events, the reference obligation, and in the case of a CDS on mortgage-backed securities, the floatingAmountEvents.

docs.title: Slot: protectionTermsReference
docs.text: Reference to the documentation terms applicable to this item.

docs.title: Slot: provider
docs.text: The organisation that creates or maintains the Index.

docs.title: Slot: publicSource
docs.text: A public information source, e.g. a particular newspaper or electronic news service, that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred. ISDA 2003 Term: Public Source.

docs.title: Slot: publicationCalendar
docs.text: Publication Calendar (e.g. EUR-ICESWAP)

docs.title: Slot: publicationDate
docs.text: The most recent date the code list was published, e.g. 2021-10-05

docs.title: Slot: publiclyAvailableInformation
docs.text: A public information source, e.g. a particular newspaper or electronic news service, that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

docs.title: Slot: publisher
docs.text: The legal agreement publisher, e.g. ISDA.

docs.title: Slot: purchaserSecurity
docs.text: Defines the underlier for the Purchaser Company involved in Merger corporate action.

docs.title: Slot: purchaserSecurityPrice
docs.text: The price observation that relates to underlier for the Purchaser Company.

docs.title: Slot: putCall
docs.text: Specifies the embedded option feature of a debt security.

docs.title: Slot: qualification
docs.text: The timestamp qualifier is specified through an enumeration because the experience of integrating the DTCC and CME data representations suggests that a wide set of timestamps are currently utilized among service providers, while there is not at present an objective set of criteria that could help suggest a defined set of timestamps as part of the CDM. At some future point, one possible baseline could be developed from the review of the set of timestamps specified across regulatory regimes and regulations (incl. regulations such as high frequency trading). Also, the integration with a further set of implementations and the specification of business workflows such as clearing as part of the CDM development should help confirm the implementation approach in this respect.

docs.title: Slot: qualifyingParticipationSeller
docs.text: If Direct Loan Participation is specified as a deliverable obligation characteristic, this specifies any requirements for the Qualifying Participation Seller. The requirements may be listed free-form. ISDA 2003 Term: Qualifying Participation Seller.

docs.title: Slot: quantity
docs.text: Specifies quantity amount returned if not the full amount from the TradeState, e.g. partial return

docs.title: Slot: quantityChange
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing an quantity change primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: quantityMultiplier
docs.text: Quantity multiplier is specified on top of a reference quantity and is used as a multiplying factor when resolving the quantity. A quantity multiplier can only exist when the resolvable quantity specifies a reference quantity.

docs.title: Slot: quantityReference
docs.text: Reference quantity when resolvable quantity is defined as relative to another (resolvable) quantity. A resolvable quantity needs to contain either an absolute quantity or a reference to another (resolvable) quantity. This requirement is captured by a choice rule on the class.

docs.title: Slot: quantitySchedule
docs.text: A payout's quantity specified as a schedule, which may also contain a single value if that quantity is constant. There can only be a single quantity schedule applicable to a payout: e.g. the notional for an interest rate leg. The quantity must be specified outside of the payout in a PriceQuantity object and only referenced inside the payout using an address.

docs.title: Slot: quanto
docs.text: If 'Quanto' is specified as the Settlement Type in the relevant Transaction Supplement, an amount, as determined by the Calculation Agent in accordance with the Section 8.2 of the Equity Definitions.

docs.title: Slot: quasiGovernmentType
docs.text: Specifies debt issues by institutions or bodies, typically constituted by statute, with a function mandated by the government and subject to government supervision inclusive of profit- and non-profit making bodies. Includes the US Agencies and GSEs and the EU concept of public sector entities. Excluding any entities which are also Regional Government.

docs.title: Slot: quotationAmount
docs.text: In the determination of a cash settlement amount, if weighted average quotations are to be obtained, the quotation amount specifies an upper limit to the outstanding principal balance of the reference obligation for which the quote should be obtained. If not specified, the ISDA definitions provide for a fallback amount equal to the floating rate payer calculation amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Amount.

docs.title: Slot: quotationMethod
docs.text: The type of price quotations to be requested from dealers when determining the market value of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement, or which rate quote is to be observed for a fixing. For example, Bid, Offer, Mid-market or Exercising Party Pays. ISDA 2003 Term: Quotation Method. The meaning of Exercising Party Pays is defined in the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 17.2. Certain Definitions Relating to Cash Settlement, paragraph (j).

docs.title: Slot: quotationStyle
docs.text: An optional element that contains the up-front points expressed as a percentage of the notional. An initialPoints value of 5% would be represented as 0.05. The initialPoints element is an alternative to marketFixedRate in quoting the traded level of a trade. When initialPoints is used, the traded level is the sum of fixedRate and initialPoints. The initialPoints is one of the items that are factored into the initialPayment calculation and is payable by the Buyer to the Seller. Note that initialPoints and marketFixedRate may both be present in the same document when both implied values are desired.

docs.title: Slot: quoteBasis
docs.text: The method by which the exchange rate is quoted.

docs.title: Slot: quotedCurrencyPair
docs.text: Describes the composition of a rate that has been quoted or is to be quoted.

docs.title: Slot: rate
docs.text: The rate of exchange between the two currencies of the leg of a deal. Must be specified with a quote basis.

docs.title: Slot: rateCutOffDaysOffset
docs.text: Specifies the number of business days before the period end date when the rate cut-off date is assumed to apply. The financial business centers associated with determining the rate cut-off date are those specified in the reset dates adjustments. The rate cut-off number of days must be a negative integer (a value of zero would imply no rate cut off applies in which case the rateCutOffDaysOffset element should not be included). The relevant rate for each reset date in the period from, and including, a rate cut-off date to, but excluding, the next applicable period end date (or, in the case of the last calculation period, the termination date) will (solely for purposes of calculating the floating amount payable on the next applicable payment date) be deemed to be the relevant rate in effect on that rate cut-off date. For example, if rate cut-off days for a daily averaging deal is -2 business days, then the refix rate applied on (period end date - 2 days) will also be applied as the reset on (period end date - 1 day), i.e. the actual number of reset dates remains the same but from the rate cut-off date until the period end date, the same refix rate is applied. Note that in the case of several calculation periods contributing to a single payment, the rate cut-off is assumed only to apply to the final calculation period contributing to that payment. The day type associated with the offset must imply a business days offset.

docs.title: Slot: rateObservation
docs.text: The details of a particular rate observation, including the fixing date and observed rate. A list of rate observation elements may be ordered in the document by ascending adjusted fixing date. An FpML document containing an unordered list of rate observations is still regarded as a conformant document.

docs.title: Slot: rateRecordDate
docs.text: Specifies the 'Rate Record Day' for a Fallback rate. Fallback rate fixing processes typically set the fixing rate in arrears, i.e., the Fallback Rate corresponding to a Rate Record Date is set at the end of the interest accural period. When this applies, Reset->resetDate occurs at the end of the interest period, and the Reset->rateRecordDate occurs near the start of the interest period. The Reset->rateRecordDate and Reset->observations->observationIdentifier->observationDate will differ if a Fallback rate is unavailable on the Rate Record Date, and the latest previous available rate is used as the observation.

docs.title: Slot: rateReference
docs.text: A pointer style reference to a floating rate component defined as part of a stub calculation period amount component. It is only required when it is necessary to distinguish two rate observations for the same fixing date which could occur when linear interpolation of two different rates occurs for a stub calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: rateSchedule
docs.text: The fixed rate or fixed rate schedule expressed as explicit fixed rates and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments.

docs.title: Slot: rateSource
docs.text: The rate source in the case of a variable cap.

docs.title: Slot: rateSpecification
docs.text: The specification of the rate value(s) applicable to the contract using either a floating rate calculation, a single fixed rate, a fixed rate schedule, or an inflation rate calculation.

docs.title: Slot: rateTreatment
docs.text: The specification of any rate conversion which needs to be applied to the observed rate before being used in any calculations. The two common conversions are for securities quoted on a bank discount basis which will need to be converted to either a Money Market Yield or Bond Equivalent Yield. See the Annex to the 2000 ISDA Definitions, Section 7.3. Certain General Definitions Relating to Floating Rate Options, paragraphs (g) and (h) for definitions of these terms.

docs.title: Slot: ratedParty
docs.text: The party to which a rating applies.

docs.title: Slot: ratingPriorityResolution
docs.text: Denotes which Criteria has priority if more than one agency rating applies.

docs.title: Slot: ratingType
docs.text: The relevant rating type.

docs.title: Slot: ratingVariableSet
docs.text: Allows a grouping of Rating agencies and Rating values.

docs.title: Slot: ratingsBased
docs.text: Defines that the Threshold is based on a Ratings condition(s).

docs.title: Slot: ratingsXExposure
docs.text: Indicates the Independent Amount is determined using both credit rating and exposure metrics.

docs.title: Slot: rawRate
docs.text: The raw or untreated rate, prior to any of the rate treatments.

docs.title: Slot: realisedVarianceMethod
docs.text: The contract specifies which price must satisfy the boundary condition.

docs.title: Slot: recalculationOfValue
docs.text: The elections to specify terms for recalculation of the market value of posted collateral.

docs.title: Slot: recalculationOfValueElection
docs.text: The procedure for Recalculation of Value.

docs.title: Slot: recalculationOfValueTerms
docs.text: Additional Recalculation of Value terms when specified.

docs.title: Slot: recallNonCashCollateralDescription
docs.text: Specifies the details to describe or identify non-cash collateral eligible assets for recall purposes.

docs.title: Slot: recallProvision
docs.text: A provision defining criteria controlling the ability for a lender to recall securities it has lent out.

docs.title: Slot: receiver
docs.text: Specifies the party that receives the payments corresponding to this structure. The party is one of the two counterparties to the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: receiverAccountReference
docs.text: A reference to the account that receives the payments corresponding to this structure.

docs.title: Slot: receiverPartyReference
docs.text: The party that receives the payments corresponding to this structure.

docs.title: Slot: receivingParty
docs.text: The party receiving the invoice

docs.title: Slot: recordDate
docs.text: The date on which the account phyical balance and related underlier ownership is recorded by the custodian.

docs.title: Slot: recordEndDate
docs.text: The ending date of the period described by this record

docs.title: Slot: recordStartDate
docs.text: The starting date of the period described by this record

docs.title: Slot: recordTransfer
docs.text: The settlement terms for the billing record

docs.title: Slot: recoveryFactor
docs.text: Used for fixed recovery, specifies the recovery level, determined at contract formation, to be applied on a default. Used to calculate the amount paid by the seller to the buyer for cash settlement on the cash settlement date. Amount calculation is (1 minus the Recovery Factor) multiplied by the Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount. The currency will be derived from the Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount.

docs.title: Slot: recoveryPercent
docs.text: The percentage of the original value of the asset affected by the credit event that can be recovered.

docs.title: Slot: redemption
docs.text: Specifies the general rule for redemption of a debt security.

docs.title: Slot: redemptionType
docs.text: Specifies the contractual redemption or conversion features associated with a debt security.

docs.title: Slot: referenceBank
docs.text: An institution (party) identified by means of a coding scheme and an optional name.

docs.title: Slot: referenceBankId
docs.text: An institution (party) identifier, e.g. a bank identifier code (BIC). FpML specifies a referenceBankIdScheme.

docs.title: Slot: referenceBankName
docs.text: The name of the institution (party). A free format string. FpML does not define usage rules for the element.

docs.title: Slot: referenceBanks
docs.text: A container for a set of reference institutions that may be called upon to provide rate quotations as part of the method to determine the applicable cash settlement amount. If institutions are not specified, it is assumed that reference institutions will be agreed between the parties on the exercise date, or in the case of swap transaction to which mandatory early termination is applicable, the cash settlement valuation date.

docs.title: Slot: referenceCurrency
docs.text: Specifies the reference currency of the trade.

docs.title: Slot: referenceEntity
docs.text: The corporate or sovereign entity which is subject to the swap transaction and any successor that assumes all or substantially all of its contractual and other obligations. Reference Entities cannot be senior or subordinated. It is the obligations of the Reference Entities that can be senior or subordinated. ISDA 2014 Credit definitions article II section 2.1: Reference Entity means the entity specified as such in the related Confirmation.

docs.title: Slot: referenceFramework
docs.text: Specifies the type of commodity.

docs.title: Slot: referenceInformation
docs.text: The reference entity, part of a credit basket, impacted by the credit event.

docs.title: Slot: referenceObligation
docs.text: The Reference Obligation is a financial instrument that is either issued or guaranteed by the reference entity. It serves to clarify the precise reference entity protection is being offered upon, and its legal position with regard to other related firms (parents/subsidiaries). Furthermore the Reference Obligation is ALWAYS deliverable and establishes the Pari Passu ranking (as the deliverable bonds must rank equal to the reference obligation). ISDA 2003 Term: Reference Obligation.

docs.title: Slot: referencePolicy
docs.text: Applicable to the transactions on mortgage-backed security, which can make use of a reference policy. Presence of the element with value set to 'true' indicates that the reference policy is applicable; absence implies that it is not.

docs.title: Slot: referencePool
docs.text: This element contains all the reference pool items to define the reference entity and reference obligation(s) in the basket.

docs.title: Slot: referencePoolItem
docs.text: This type contains all the constituent weight and reference information.

docs.title: Slot: referencePrice
docs.text: Used to determine (a) for physically settled trades, the Physical Settlement Amount, which equals the Floating Rate Payer Calculation Amount times the Reference Price and (b) for cash settled trades, the Cash Settlement Amount, which equals the greater of (i) the difference between the Reference Price and the Final Price and (ii) zero. ISDA 2003 Term: Reference Price.

docs.title: Slot: referenceSwapCurve
docs.text: Defines the strike of an option when expressed by reference to a swap curve (Typically the case for a convertible bond option).

docs.title: Slot: regIMRole
docs.text: Indicates the role of the party in an regulatory initial margin call instruction (i.e Pledgor party or Secured party).

docs.title: Slot: regMarginType
docs.text: Identifies margin type and if related regulatory mandate

docs.title: Slot: regime
docs.text: The Regime Table provision , which determines the regulatory regime(s) applicable to each of the parties to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: regimeTerms
docs.text: A class that is used by the ApplicableRegime and the AdditionalRegime classes to specify the terms that are specific to each party and regime which are referred to in the Regime Table as part of certain legal agreements, such as the ISDA 2016 and 2018 CSA for Initial Margin.

docs.title: Slot: regionalGovernmentType
docs.text: Specifies Regional government, local authority or municipal.

docs.title: Slot: regulatoryComplianceRepresentation
docs.text: The qualification of whether Additional Information related to Regulatory Compliance and Concentration Limits is applicable or not.

docs.title: Slot: rejected
docs.text: Flags this step as rejected.

docs.title: Slot: rejectedReason
docs.text: Optional reason for rejecting the workflow step

docs.title: Slot: relatedAgreements
docs.text: Specifies the agreement(s) that govern the agreement, either as a reference to such agreements when specified as part of the CDM, or through identification of some of the key terms of those agreements, such as the type of agreement, the publisher, the vintage, the agreement identifier and the agreement date.

docs.title: Slot: relatedExchange
docs.text: Provides the related Exchanges, if applicable.

docs.title: Slot: relationshipWithControlAgreement
docs.text: Unless specified as inapplicable the parties recognise that the Control Agreement is a means by which the parties can perform their obligations.

docs.title: Slot: relativeDate
docs.text: A date specified as some offset to another date (the anchor date).

docs.title: Slot: relativeDateAdjustments
docs.text: The business day convention and financial business centers used for adjusting the relative date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business date in the specified business centers.

docs.title: Slot: relativeDates
docs.text: A series of dates specified as some offset to another series of dates (the anchor dates).

docs.title: Slot: relativeTime
docs.text: A time value calculated relative to another reference time.

docs.title: Slot: releaseDate
docs.text: Election to specify the number of days prior to the termination of the Control Agreement /Collateral Management Event for the purpose of qualifying the CE/CME End Date, in the case where advance notice is given.

docs.title: Slot: relevantJurisdiction
docs.text: The ISO 3166 standard code for the country within which the postal address is located.

docs.title: Slot: relevantProvisionsElection
docs.text: Recommended Japanese Securities Provisions are applicable when True, additional Provisions are specified when False.

docs.title: Slot: relevantProvisionsTerms
docs.text: Specific terms applicable to Recommended Japanese Securities Provisions.

docs.title: Slot: relevantUnderlyingDate
docs.text: The effective date on the underlying product if the option is exercised. For example, for a swaption it is the swap effective date, for an option on an FX spot or forward it is the value date for settlement, and in an extendible/cancelable provision it is the swap termination date, which is the date on which the termination is effective.'

docs.title: Slot: relevantUnderlyingDateReference
docs.text: Reference to the unadjusted cancellation effective dates.

docs.title: Slot: replace
docs.text: Specifies whether the previous valuation tracks in the valuation history are removed (True) or kept (False).

docs.title: Slot: replacementTradeIdentifier
docs.text: Specifies the trade identifier to apply to the replacement trade for physical exercise.

docs.title: Slot: representativeEndDate
docs.text: The definition of representative end date in relation to a representative event.

docs.title: Slot: representativeEvent
docs.text: The specification of whether the representative event terms are applicable.

docs.title: Slot: representativeEventTerms
docs.text: The specific representative event terms applicable when specified.

docs.title: Slot: representativeTerms
docs.text: The specific representative terms applicable when specified.

docs.title: Slot: repudiationMoratorium
docs.text: A credit event. The reference entity, or a governmental authority, either refuses to recognise or challenges the validity of one or more obligations of the reference entity, or imposes a moratorium thereby postponing payments on one or more of the obligations of the reference entity. Subject to the default requirement amount. ISDA 2003 Term: Repudiation/Moratorium.

docs.title: Slot: reset
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing a reset event.

docs.title: Slot: resetDate
docs.text: Specifies the date on which the reset is occuring.

docs.title: Slot: resetDates
docs.text: The reset dates schedule, i.e. the dates on which the new observed index value is applied for each period and the interest rate hence begins to accrue.

docs.title: Slot: resetDatesAdjustments
docs.text: The definition of the business day convention and financial business centers used for adjusting the reset date if it would otherwise fall on a day that is not a business day in the specified business center.

docs.title: Slot: resetFrequency
docs.text: The frequency at which the reset dates occur. In the case of a weekly reset frequency, also specifies the day of the week that the reset occurs. If the reset frequency is greater than the calculation period frequency then this implies that more than one reset is established for each calculation period and some form of rate averaging is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: resetHistory
docs.text: Represents the updated Trade attributes which can change as the result of a reset event. Only the changed values are captured, leaving the remaining data attributes empty. See Create_Reset function for further details on how TradeState is used in the Reset event. The TradeState data type is used to maintain backwards compatibility with the current Reset mechanism.

docs.title: Slot: resetRelativeTo
docs.text: Specifies whether the reset dates are determined with respect to each adjusted calculation period start date or adjusted calculation period end date. If the reset frequency is specified as daily this element must not be included.

docs.title: Slot: resetValue
docs.text: Specifies the reset or fixing value. The fixing value could be a cash price, interest rate, or other value.

docs.title: Slot: resolutionAlternative
docs.text: Details of the alternative dispute resolution procedure (if any).

docs.title: Slot: resolutionTime
docs.text: The time by which the dispute needs to be resolved, failure of which would trigger a recalculation alongside a process that is specified as part of the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: resolvedQuantity
docs.text: A product's quantity as a single, non-negative amount. When specified as part of a product definition, this quantity attribute would not be set. Instead it is specified on the quantity notation along with an asset identifier matching this payout's asset identifier. This allows the quantity to be resolved for a payout leg, which can then be specified here for convenience during data processing. There needs to be at least one resolvable quantity across payout legs of a product to define an anchor that other payout quantities can refer to. This attribute is ignored when mapping existing FpML messages.

docs.title: Slot: resourceId
docs.text: The unique identifier of the resource within the event. FpML specifies this element of type resourceIdScheme but with no specified value.

docs.title: Slot: resourceType
docs.text: A description of the type of the resource, e.g. a confirmation.

docs.title: Slot: restrictTo
docs.text: Restrict the criteria to only apply to a specific type of margin, ie IM or VM.

docs.title: Slot: restructuring
docs.text: A credit event. A restructuring is an event that materially impacts the reference entity's obligations, such as an interest rate reduction, principal reduction, deferral of interest or principal, change in priority ranking, or change in currency or composition of payment. ISDA 2003 Term: Restructuring.

docs.title: Slot: restructuringType
docs.text: Specifies the type of restructuring that is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: retrospectiveEffect
docs.text: Specifies the retrospective effect exception to the regulatory regime clause of Initial Margin documents as either a normalized value specified as part of an enumeration or a customized value specified of type string.

docs.title: Slot: returnAmount
docs.text: The nearest integral multiple of Base Currency units to which the Return Amount will be rounded in accordance with the specified rounding direction.

docs.title: Slot: returnDirection
docs.text: The rounding rule applicable to the Return Amount (which can be (i) up to nearest; (ii) down to nearest).

docs.title: Slot: returnTerms
docs.text: Specifies the type of return of a performance payout.

docs.title: Slot: returnType
docs.text: The type of return associated with the equity swap.

docs.title: Slot: revenueObligationLiability
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. Defined in the ISDA published additional provisions for U.S. Municipal as Reference Entity. ISDA 2003 Term: Revenue Obligation Liability.

docs.title: Slot: rightsEvent
docs.text: A boolean attribute to specify whether a Secured Party Rights Event will only occur upon the occurrence of one or more of the event specified in a Control Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: rightsEvents
docs.text: The bespoke provisions that might be specified by the parties to the agreement to specify the rights of Security Taker and/or Security Provider when an Early Termination or Access Condition event has occurred.

docs.title: Slot: rightsSubscriptionPrice
docs.text: The price to pay per each right.

docs.title: Slot: role
docs.text: Specifies the CounterpartyEnum, e.g. either Party1 or Party2, that is associated to the partyReference.

docs.title: Slot: rollConvention
docs.text: The roll convention specifies the period term as part of a periodic schedule, i.e. the calculation period end date within the regular part of the calculation period. The value could be a rule, e.g. IMM Settlement Dates, which is the 3rd Wednesday of the month, or it could be a specific day of the month, such as the first day of the applicable month. It is used in conjunction with a frequency and the regular period start date of a calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: rollFeature
docs.text: _Used in conjunction with an exchange-based pricing source. Identifies a way in which the futures contracts referenced will roll between periods. _

docs.title: Slot: rollSourceCalendar
docs.text: Used in conjunction with an exchange-based pricing source. Identifies a date source calendar from which the pricing dates and thus roll to the next contract will be based off (e.g. pricing is based on the NYMEX WTI First Nearby Futures Contract, if Future is chosen, the pricing will roll to the next futures contract on expiration, if ListedOption is chosen, the pricing will roll to the next futures contract on the Option expiration date which is three business days before the expiration of the NYMEX WTI futures contract.) Omitting this element will result in the default behavior expected with the pricing source described within the commodity element.

docs.title: Slot: roundToUnit
docs.text: The time unit to which the value should be rounded (e.g., minute, hour, day).

docs.title: Slot: rounding
