docs.text: Optional rules that define how the calculated time should be rounded after the offset has been applied.

docs.title: Slot: roundingDirection
docs.text: The direction in which rounding is performed (e.g., up, down, or to the nearest value).

docs.title: Slot: roundingFrequency
docs.text: Specifies when/how often is rounding applied?

docs.title: Slot: safekeepingPeriodExpiry
docs.text: The parties' election to specify the number of days prior to the end of the safekeeping period (Clearstream CTA) purpose of qualifying the CE/CME End Date, in the case where advance notice is given.

docs.title: Slot: scale
docs.text: Specifies the credit rating scale, with a typical distinction between short term, long term. FpML doesn't specify a default scheme, which is hence not specified as an enumeration as part of the CDM.

docs.title: Slot: schedule
docs.text: A derivative schedule.

docs.title: Slot: scheduleBounds
docs.text: The first and last dates of a schedule. This can be used to restrict the range of values in a reference series of dates.

docs.title: Slot: scheduleGridIMExposure
docs.text: Represents Initial Margin (IM) exposure derived from schedule or Grid calculation.

docs.title: Slot: schedulePeriod
docs.text: Defines a period of a calculation schedule structure.

docs.title: Slot: scope
docs.text: _ Defines the scope of the valuation, what it applies to e.g. the collateral or the trade_

docs.title: Slot: secondaryAssetClass
docs.text: _ Classifies additional risk classes of the trade, if any._

docs.title: Slot: secondaryFxSpotRateSource
docs.text: Specifies an alternative, or secondary, source from which a rate should be observed.

docs.title: Slot: secondarySource
docs.text: An alternative, or secondary, source for where the rate observation will occur. Will typically be either a page or a reference bank published rate.

docs.title: Slot: sector
docs.text: Represents a filter based on an industry sector defined under a system for classifying industry types such as Global Industry Classification Standard (GICS) and North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)

docs.title: Slot: secured
docs.text: Specifies the type of secured debt.

docs.title: Slot: securedList
docs.text: With respect to any day, the list of Syndicated Secured Obligations of the Designated Priority of the Reference Entity published by Markit Group Limited or any successor thereto appointed by the Specified Dealers (the 'Secured List Publisher') on or most recently before such day, which list is currently available at [http://www.markit.com]. ISDA 2003 Term: Relevant Secured List.

docs.title: Slot: securedType
docs.text: Specifies the type of secured debt product.

docs.title: Slot: securities
docs.text: Details of how securities collateral is valued when resolving disputes.

docs.title: Slot: securitiesCollateral
docs.text: Details of how securities collateral is valued.

docs.title: Slot: securititesCollateralTransferSettlementTime
docs.text: Details the day on which collateral is required to be transferred relative to the Notification Time.

docs.title: Slot: security
docs.text: The security details.

docs.title: Slot: securityAgreementElections
docs.text: Elections to specify a Security agreement.

docs.title: Slot: securityInterestForObligations
docs.text: The party to whom obligations under the Master Agreement are owed and secured by the credit support arrangements. Applicable to 1994 NY CSA, 1995 English Law CSD and 2016 New York Law VM CSA.

docs.title: Slot: securityProvider
docs.text: The security provider party(ies) to which the posting obligations apply to, which can be either one of the parties to the legal agreement, or both of those.

docs.title: Slot: securityProviderRightsEvent
docs.text: The bespoke provisions that might be specified by the parties to the agreement applicable to a Security Provider Rights Event.

docs.title: Slot: securityTakerRightsEvent
docs.text: The bespoke provisions that might be specified by the parties to the agreement applicable to a Security Taker Rights Event.

docs.title: Slot: securityType
docs.text: Identifies the type of security using an enumerated list.

docs.title: Slot: segregatedCashAccount
docs.text: The identification of the segregated cash account for the purpose of holding cash collateral.

docs.title: Slot: segregatedSecurityAccount
docs.text: The identification of the segregated security account for the purpose of holding security collateral.

docs.title: Slot: seller
docs.text: Seller party that can be resolved as one of the two principal parties to the transaction. The party that sells ('writes') this instrument, i.e. that grants the rights defined by this instrument and in return receives a payment for it. ISDA 2002 Equity Definitions section 1.19: Seller means the party specified as such in the related Confirmation. | ISDA 2006 Definitions article 12.1 (a)(i) relating to a Swaption: 'Seller' means the party the party specified as such or as writer in the related Confirmation | ISDA 2006 Definitions article 12.1 (a)(ii) relating to Swap Transactions with applicable Early Termination: the party specified as such or as writer in the related Confirmation or, if neither party is specified as such, the Non-exercising Party | ISDA 2006 Definitions article 12.1 (a)(iii) relating to any other Option Transaction: the party specified as such in the related Confirmation. | ISDA 2014 Credit Definition article 1.4: Seller means the Floating Rate Payer.

docs.title: Slot: sendingParty
docs.text: The party issuing the invoice

docs.title: Slot: seniority
docs.text: Specifies the order of repayment in the event of a sale or bankruptcy of the issuer or a related party (eg guarantor).

docs.title: Slot: sensitivityMethodologies
docs.text: The specification of methodologies to compute sensitivities specific to the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: sensitivityToCommodity
docs.text: The methodology to compute sensitivities to commodity indices for the purpose of Initial Margin agreements.

docs.title: Slot: sensitivityToETFs
docs.text: Represents risk sensitivity calculated with respect to the value of an exchange-traded fund (ETF).

docs.title: Slot: sensitivityToEquity
docs.text: The methodology to compute sensitivities to equity indices, funds and ETFs for the purpose of Initial Margin agreements.

docs.title: Slot: sensitivityToFunds
docs.text: Represents risk sensitivity calculated with respect to the value of a fund, such as a mutual fund or collective investment vehicle.

docs.title: Slot: sensitivityToIndices
docs.text: Represents risk sensitivity calculated with respect to the level of an equity or market index.

docs.title: Slot: sentBy
docs.text: The identifier for the originator of a message instance.

docs.title: Slot: sentTo
docs.text: The identifier(s) for the recipient(s) of a message instance.

docs.title: Slot: servicingParty
docs.text: The reference to the legal entity that services the account, i.e. in the books of which the account is held.

docs.title: Slot: settledEntityMatrix
docs.text: Used to specify the Relevant Settled Entity Matrix when there are settled entities at the time of the trade.

docs.title: Slot: settlementCentre
docs.text: Optional settlement centre as an enumerated list: Euroclear, Clearstream.

docs.title: Slot: settlementCurrency
docs.text: The settlement currency is to be specified when the Settlement Amount cannot be known in advance. The list of valid currencies is not presently positioned as an enumeration as part of the CDM because that scope is limited to the values specified by ISDA and FpML. As a result, implementers have to make reference to the relevant standard, such as the ISO 4217 standard for currency codes.

docs.title: Slot: settlementDate
docs.text: The date for settlement of the transfer.

docs.title: Slot: settlementProvision
docs.text: Optionally defines the parameters that regulate a settlement.

docs.title: Slot: settlementTerms
docs.text: Per Part 1 Section 8, 'Settlement', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation for Security Equity Swap.

docs.title: Slot: settlementType
docs.text: Whether the settlement will be cash, physical, by election, ...

docs.title: Slot: shapeSchedule
docs.text: Defines applicable settlement limits in each currency.

docs.title: Slot: shapingProvisions
docs.text: Defines the parameters that are necessary to 'shape' a settlement, i.e. break it down into smaller amounts.

docs.title: Slot: shareForCombined
docs.text: Shall occur if a Merger Event occurs and the consideration for the relevant Security consists solely of Combined Consideration.

docs.title: Slot: shareForOther
docs.text: Shall occur if a Merger Event occurs and the consideration for the relevant Security consists solely of Other Consideration.

docs.title: Slot: shareForRightsRatio
docs.text: _Multiple value, say 'M/N' where 'M' is the number of rights after the event, and 'N' of shares prior to the event. _

docs.title: Slot: shareForShare
docs.text: Shall occur if a Merger Event occurs and the consideration for the relevant Security consists solely of Combined Consideration.

docs.title: Slot: shareForShareRatio
docs.text: _Multiple value, say 'M/N' where 'M' is the number of shares after the event and 'N' is the number of shares prior to the event. _

docs.title: Slot: sharePriceDividendAdjustment
docs.text: Indicates whether the price of shares is adjusted for dividends or not.

docs.title: Slot: shortName
docs.text: A short name (without whitespace) for the code list, e.g. businessCenterScheme

docs.title: Slot: shortPosition
docs.text: Credit limit utilisation attributable to short positions.

docs.title: Slot: side
docs.text: The side (bid/mid/ask) of the measure.

docs.title: Slot: simmCalculationCurrency
docs.text: The SIMM Calculation Currency, as specified for each of the parties to the CSA Initial Margin.

docs.title: Slot: simmException
docs.text: The election for SIMM exception to the regulatory regime clause.

docs.title: Slot: simmExceptionApplicable
docs.text: The Standard Initial Margin model exception approach applicable when specified by the party according to one of the enumerated values.

docs.title: Slot: simmIMExposure
docs.text: Represents Initial Margin (IM) exposure derived from ISDA SIMM calculation.

docs.title: Slot: simmVersion
docs.text: The qualification of the ISDA SIMM version that is specified for all Covered Transactions.

docs.title: Slot: singlePartyOption
docs.text: If the ability to extend the contract is not available to both parties then this component specifies the buyer and seller of the option.

docs.title: Slot: singlePostingParty
docs.text: Where only a single party is explicitly designated to post collateral, the party which is specified as the sole poster of collateral.

docs.title: Slot: singleValuationDate
docs.text: Where single valuation date is specified as being applicable for cash settlement, this element specifies the number of business days after satisfaction of all conditions to settlement when such valuation date occurs. ISDA 2003 Term: Single Valuation Date.

docs.title: Slot: sixtyBusinessDaySettlementCap
docs.text: If this element is specified and set to 'true', for a transaction documented under the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions, has the effect of incorporating the language set forth below into the confirmation. The section references are to the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions. Notwithstanding Section 1.7 or any provisions of Sections 9.9 or 9.10 to the contrary, but without prejudice to Section 9.3 and (where applicable) Sections 9.4, 9.5 and 9.6, if the Termination Date has not occurred on or prior to the date that is 60 Business Days following the Physical Settlement Date, such 60th Business Day shall be deemed to be the Termination Date with respect to this Transaction except in relation to any portion of the Transaction (an 'Affected Portion') in respect of which: (1) a valid notice of Buy-in Price has been delivered that is effective fewer than three Business Days prior to such 60th Business Day, in which case the Termination Date for that Affected Portion shall be the third Business Day following the date on which such notice is effective; or (2) Buyer has purchased but not Delivered Deliverable Obligations validly specified by Seller pursuant to Section 9.10(b), in which case the Termination Date for that Affected Portion shall be the tenth Business Day following the date on which Seller validly specified such Deliverable Obligations to Buyer.

docs.title: Slot: sizeInBytes
docs.text: Indicates the size of the resource in bytes. It could be used by the end user to estimate the download time and storage needs.

docs.title: Slot: source
docs.text: Defines the source of the identifier.

docs.title: Slot: sourcePage
docs.text: A specific page for the source for obtaining a market data point. In FpML, this is specified as a scheme, rateSourcePageScheme, for which no coding Scheme or URI is specified.

docs.title: Slot: sourcePageHeading
docs.text: The heading for the source on a given source page.

docs.title: Slot: sourceProvider
docs.text: An information source for obtaining a market data point. For example Bloomberg, Reuters, Telerate, etc.

docs.title: Slot: sovereignAgencyRating
docs.text: Represents an agency rating based on default risk of the country of the issuer.

docs.title: Slot: sovereignEntity
docs.text: True if sovereign entity (e.g. not separate legal personality from sovereign) or false if non-sovereign entity (e.g. separate legal personality from sovereign).

docs.title: Slot: sovereignRecourse
docs.text: Applies to non-sovereign entity (e.g. separate legal personality from sovereign). True if entity has recourse to sovereign (e.g. debt guaranteed by government). False if entity does not have recourse to sovereign.

docs.title: Slot: specialDividends
docs.text: Specifies the method according to which special dividends are determined.

docs.title: Slot: specialPurposeVehicleType
docs.text: Specifies a subsidiary company that is formed to undertake a specific business purpose of acquisition and financing of specific assets on a potentially limited recourse basis dependent of how it is designed. E.g. asset backed securities, including securitisations.

docs.title: Slot: specificConsentLanguage
docs.text: Specific consent language might be specified by the parties.

docs.title: Slot: specificDate
docs.text: The effective date of the Amendment to Termination Currency when specified as relative to another date (e.g. the annex date).

docs.title: Slot: specification
docs.text: a copy of the input EligbilityCollateralSpecification that was checked against the query

docs.title: Slot: specifiedAdditionalTerminationEvent
docs.text: Specifies any bespoke Additional Termination Event(s) that are set out in the related Specified Condition clause.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedConditionOrAccessCondition
docs.text: Specifies the events elected by the parties that are deemed an Access Condition (for Initial Margin CSA) or a Specified Condition (for Variation Margin and Legacy CSA), which, if triggered, may temporarily or permanently suspend rights to rehypothecate, transfer, or substitute collateral.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedCurrency
docs.text: An obligation and deliverable obligation characteristic. The currency or currencies in which an obligation or deliverable obligation must be payable. ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Currency.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedDates
docs.text: Defines specified dates on which the price will be determined.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedEntities
docs.text: A provision that allows each party to specify its Specified Entities for certain Events of Default and Termination Events.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedEntity
docs.text: The party specific election of Specified Entities for the Event of Default or Termination Event specified.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedEntityClause
docs.text: The Event of Default or Termination event for which Specified Entities terms are being defined.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedEntityTerms
docs.text: The specified entity terms for the Event of Default or Termination Event specified.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedMethodology
docs.text: The methodology according to which sensitivities will be computed, when specified through a normalized election.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedNumber
docs.text: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two. ISDA 2003 Term: Specified Number.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedOrAccessCondition
docs.text: Specifies events that may temporarily or permanently suspend a partys rights to rehypothecate, transfer, or substitute collateral.

docs.title: Slot: specifiedParty
docs.text: Identifies a party designated in the agreement for the purpose of applying particular rights, obligations, or elections.

docs.title: Slot: spinOff
docs.text: Defines the underlier for both the Parent Company and the Child Compagny involved in Spin Off corporate action, as well as the respective price observation for each.

docs.title: Slot: split
docs.text: Specifies instructions to split a trade into multiple branches.

docs.title: Slot: splitTicket
docs.text: Typically applicable to the physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options. If present, means that the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

docs.title: Slot: spread
docs.text: Spread in basis points over the floating rate index.

docs.title: Slot: spreadAdjustment
docs.text: The economic spread applied to the underlying fallback rate to replicate the original risky rate.

docs.title: Slot: spreadCalculationMethod
docs.text: Method by which spread is calculated. For example on an asset swap: 'ParPar' or 'Proceeds' may be the method indicated.

docs.title: Slot: spreadExclusiveCalculatedAMount
docs.text: The amount of the cash flow excluding any spread, for subsequent processing.

docs.title: Slot: spreadExclusiveRate
docs.text: The value of the processed rate without the spread applied, for subsequent compounding, etc.

docs.title: Slot: spreadSchedule
docs.text: The ISDA Spread or a Spread schedule expressed as explicit spreads and dates. In the case of a schedule, the step dates may be subject to adjustment in accordance with any adjustments specified in calculationPeriodDatesAdjustments. The spread is a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. For purposes of determining a calculation period amount, if positive the spread will be added to the floating rate and if negative the spread will be subtracted from the floating rate. A positive 10 basis point (0.1%) spread would be represented as 0.001.

docs.title: Slot: spreadScheduleType
docs.text: An element which purpose is to identify a long or short spread value.

docs.title: Slot: standardDefinitionOfMarketValueUsed
docs.text: Is the standard definition of 'Market Value' used in the GMSLA?

docs.title: Slot: standardElection
docs.text: The Interest Adjustment periodicity when specified through a standardized election.

docs.title: Slot: standardLanguage
docs.text: A boolean attribute to determine if standard language is applicable or not.

docs.title: Slot: standardPublicSources
docs.text: If this element is specified and set to 'true', indicates that ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable.

docs.title: Slot: standardReferenceObligation
docs.text: Indicates if the reference obligation is a Standard Reference Obligation. ISDA 2014 Term: Standard Reference Obligation.

docs.title: Slot: standardSettlementStyle
docs.text: Settlement Style.

docs.title: Slot: standardValue
docs.text: The qualification of the Additional Type of transaction that can require the collection or delivery of initial margin when specified as a standard value.

docs.title: Slot: standardisedException
docs.text: The Standard Initial Margin Model exception when specified by the party according to one of the enumerated values.

docs.title: Slot: startDate
docs.text: The first date of a date range.

docs.title: Slot: startTime
docs.text: The start time of the delivery interval for each block or shape.

docs.title: Slot: state
docs.text: A country subdivision used in postal addresses in some countries. For example, US states, Canadian provinces, Swiss cantons, ...

docs.title: Slot: statedCurrency
docs.text: Specifies a single Termination Currency for the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: statedPartyCurrency
docs.text: Specifies termination Currency.

docs.title: Slot: statedTerminationCurrency
docs.text: Allows for specific Termination Currency(ies) and a fallback Termination Currency to be selected.

docs.title: Slot: stepDate
docs.text: The date on which the associated stepValue becomes effective. This day may be subject to adjustment in accordance with a business day convention.

docs.title: Slot: stepUpProvision
docs.text: As specified by the ISDA Standard Terms Supplement for use with trades on mortgage-backed securities. The presence of the element with value set to 'true' signifies that the provision is applicable. If applicable, the applicable step-up terms are specified as part of that ISDA Standard Terms Supplement. From a usage standpoint, this provision is typically applicable in the case of RMBS and not applicable in case of CMBS trades.

docs.title: Slot: stepValue
docs.text: The non-negative rate or amount which becomes effective on the associated stepDate. A rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: stockSplit
docs.text: Specifies inputs needed to process a Stock Split business event.

docs.title: Slot: strategyFeature
docs.text: Defines a simple strategy feature.

docs.title: Slot: street
docs.text: The set of street and building number information that identifies a postal address within a city.

docs.title: Slot: strike
docs.text: Specifies the strike of the option.

docs.title: Slot: strikeFactor
docs.text: The factor of strike.

docs.title: Slot: strikePrice
docs.text: Defines the strike of an option in the form of a price that could be a cash price, interestRate, or other types.

docs.title: Slot: strikeRate
docs.text: The rate for a cap or floor.

docs.title: Slot: strikeReference
docs.text: Defines the strike of an option in reference to the spread of the underlying swap (typical practice in the case of an option on a credit single name swaps).

docs.title: Slot: strikeSpread
docs.text: Definition of the upper strike in a strike spread.

docs.title: Slot: string
docs.text: Provides extra information as string. In case the extra information is in XML format, a CDATA section must be placed around the source message to prevent its interpretation as XML content.

docs.title: Slot: stubAmount
docs.text: An actual amount to apply for the initial or final stub period may have been agreed between the two parties. If an actual stub amount has been agreed then it would be included in this component.

docs.title: Slot: stubPeriod
docs.text: The stub calculation period amount parameters. This element must only be included if there is an initial or final stub calculation period. Even then, it must only be included if either the stub references a different floating rate tenor to the regular calculation periods, or if the stub is calculated as a linear interpolation of two different floating rate tenors, or if a specific stub rate or stub amount has been negotiated.

docs.title: Slot: stubPeriodType
docs.text: Method to allocate any irregular period remaining after regular periods have been allocated between the effective and termination date. The multiplicity of 2 allows the possibility of expressing the type for both an initial and final stub at the same time.

docs.title: Slot: stubRate
docs.text: An actual rate to apply for the initial or final stub period may have been agreed between the principal parties (in a similar way to how an initial rate may have been agreed for the first regular period). If an actual stub rate has been agreed then it would be included in this component. It will be a per annum rate, expressed as a decimal. A stub rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: style
docs.text: Whether the option has a single exercise (european), multiple exercise dates (bermuda), or a continuous range of exercise (american).

docs.title: Slot: subcomponents
docs.text: Additional hierarchical components of the clause if relevant.

docs.title: Slot: substitutedRegime
docs.text: The specification of Additional regimes for purposes of determining whether a Regulatory Event has occurred.

docs.title: Slot: substitution
docs.text: The conditions under which the Security Provider can substitute posted collateral.

docs.title: Slot: substitutionBeSpokeTerms
docs.text: Where parties describe any substitution terms e.g. for instance the election criteria for an Asset to be eligible as the Substitute Asset to the prior Affected Asset in terms of sector of activity, currency, market capitalisation, liquidity, volatility, or any additional features that parties would agree to take into considerations, etc.

docs.title: Slot: substitutionDateLanguage
docs.text: Substitution Date has the meaning specified in Paragraph4(d)(ii), unless otherwise specified.

docs.title: Slot: substitutionProvisions
docs.text: The provisions for collateral substitutions such as how many and when they are allowed.

docs.title: Slot: substitutionTriggerEvents
docs.text: Where the parties may optionnally explictly specify the list of Events to be considered as a trigger for a Substitution.

docs.title: Slot: suffix
docs.text: Name suffix, such as Jr., III, etc.

docs.title: Slot: summaryAmountType
docs.text: The account level for the billing summary.

docs.title: Slot: summaryTransfer
docs.text: The settlement terms for the billing summary

docs.title: Slot: supportedDefinition
docs.text: The definition version or versions supported by the FRO.

docs.title: Slot: supraNationalType
docs.text: Specifies debt issued by international organisations and multilateral banks.

docs.title: Slot: surname
docs.text: The natural person's surname.

docs.title: Slot: swapStreamReference
docs.text: Reference to the leg, where date adjustments may apply.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomy
docs.text: Defines the taxonomy of an object by combining a taxonomy source (i.e. the rules to classify the object) and a value (i.e. the output of those rules on the object.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomySource
docs.text: Specifies the taxonomy source.

docs.title: Slot: taxonomyValue
docs.text: Specifies the taxonomy value.

docs.title: Slot: telephone
docs.text: The telephone number.

docs.title: Slot: telephoneNumberType
docs.text: The type of telephone number, e.g. work, mobile.

docs.title: Slot: tenorTillMaturity
docs.text: The duration between last fixing date and the payment date of accruals, calculated in accordance with the appropriate DayCountFraction.

docs.title: Slot: terminationCurrency
docs.text: Specification of the currency in which the termination payment is made (including the process by which such currency is determined).

docs.title: Slot: terminationCurrencyAmendment
docs.text: The bespoke provision that might be specified by the parties to the agreement applicable to Termination Currency. Unless specified the definition of Termination Currency has the meaning specified in the Schedule to the ISDA Master Agreement.

docs.title: Slot: terminationCurrencyCondition
docs.text: Specifies the enumerated conditions for selection of the termination currency.

docs.title: Slot: terminationCurrencySpecifiedCondition
docs.text: Specifies alternative conditions for selection of the termination currency.

docs.title: Slot: terminationDate
docs.text: The last day of the terms of the trade. This date may be subject to adjustments in accordance with the business day convention. It can also be specified in relation to another scheduled date (e.g. the last payment date).

docs.title: Slot: terminationProvision
docs.text: Contains optional provisions pertaining to the termination characteristics of a contract.

docs.title: Slot: terminationTime
docs.text: The time and zone of the last day of the terms of the trade. It can also be specified in relation to another time.

docs.title: Slot: terms
docs.text: Content of this bespoke clause.

docs.title: Slot: termsChange
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing a terms change primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: threshold
docs.text: Represents the amount of unsecured risk that a party is willing to tolerate without holding any posted collateral provided by the other party.

docs.title: Slot: thresholdRate
docs.text: A threshold rate. The threshold of 0.10% would be represented as 0.001

docs.title: Slot: time
docs.text: The observation time.

docs.title: Slot: timeRelativeTo
docs.text: The reference time zone or base time from which the relative time is calculated.

docs.title: Slot: timestamp
docs.text: Date and time of the last valuation marked to market, provided by the central counterparty (CCP) or calculated using the current or last available market price of the inputs.

docs.title: Slot: timezone
docs.text: Any relevant time zone where specified.

docs.title: Slot: totalIneligibilityDate
docs.text: Specifies the date from which all credit support provided by a party is treated as ineligible under the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: totalPosition
docs.text: Specifies whether to calculate total position to given date, or only daily position for the given date.

docs.title: Slot: totalRatio
docs.text: Specifies the total actual dividend payout ratio associated with the equity underlier. A ratio of 90% should be expressed at 0.90.

docs.title: Slot: totalVolatilityCap
docs.text: Volatility Cap Amount in accordance with the ISDA 2011 Equity Derivatives Definitions. This means the Volatility Cap Amount election is a number.

docs.title: Slot: trade
docs.text: Represents the Trade that has been effected by a business or life-cycle event.

docs.title: Slot: tradeDate
docs.text: Denotes the trade/execution date.

docs.title: Slot: tradeId
docs.text: The identifier to be assigned to the new trade post change of party.

docs.title: Slot: tradeIdentifier
docs.text: Denotes one or more identifiers associated with the transaction.

docs.title: Slot: tradeLot
docs.text: Specifies the price, quantity and effective date of each trade lot, when the same product may be traded multiple times in different lots with the same counterparty. In a trade increase, a new trade lot is added to the list, with the corresponding effective date. In a trade decrease, the existing trade lot(s) are decreased of the corresponding quantity (and an unwind fee may have to be settled). The multiple cardinality and the ability to increase existing trades is used for Equity Swaps in particular.

docs.title: Slot: tradePortfolio
docs.text: Represents a Portfolio that describes all the positions held at a given time, in various states which can be either traded, settled, etc., with lineage information to the previous state.

docs.title: Slot: tradeTime
docs.text: Denotes the trade time and timezone as agreed by the parties to the trade.

docs.title: Slot: tradeType
docs.text: The trade type, eg repurchase transaction or buy/sell-back.

docs.title: Slot: tranche
docs.text: Denotes the loan tranche that is subject to the derivative transaction. It will typically be referenced as the Bloomberg tranche number. ISDA Standards Terms Supplement term: Bloomberg Tranche Number.

docs.title: Slot: transactedPrice
docs.text: The qualification of the price at which the contract has been transacted, in terms of market fixed rate, initial points, market price and/or quotation style. In FpML, those attributes are positioned as part of the fee leg.

docs.title: Slot: transactionAdditionalTerms
docs.text: Any additional terms which mainly intend to specify the extraordinary events that may affect a trade and the related contractual rights and obligation of the parties when this happens

docs.title: Slot: transfer
docs.text: Specifies instructions describing a transfer primitive event.

docs.title: Slot: transferHistory
docs.text: Represents the updated Trade attributes which can change as the result of a transfer event.

docs.title: Slot: transferIneligibilityDate
docs.text: Specifies the date from which the transfer of credit support by a party is treated as ineligible under the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: transferSettlementTiming
docs.text: Specification of transfer / settlement timing for cash and securities collateral assuming that the notice is provided before the Notification Time (and with a 1LBD lag introduced if the notice is delivered after the Notification Time), and that securities allow for a further Local Business Day for transfer / settlement.

docs.title: Slot: transferSettlementType
docs.text: The qualification as to how the transfer will settle, e.g. a DvP settlement.

docs.title: Slot: transferState
docs.text: Specifies the terms and state of a transfers.

docs.title: Slot: transferStatus
docs.text: Represents the State of the Transfer through its life-cycle.

docs.title: Slot: transferTimingProviso
docs.text: The determination of whether transfer timing language is applicable or not.

docs.title: Slot: transferType
docs.text: Specifies the type of unscheduled transfer.

docs.title: Slot: transferable
docs.text: A deliverable obligation characteristic. An obligation that is transferable to institutional investors without any contractual, statutory or regulatory restrictions. ISDA 2003 Term: Transferable.

docs.title: Slot: treatedForecastRate
docs.text: The value representing the forecast rate after applying rate treatment rules. A value of 1% should be represented as 0.01.

docs.title: Slot: treatedRate
docs.text: The observed rate after any required rate treatment is applied. A treated rate of 5% would be represented as 0.05.

docs.title: Slot: treatment
docs.text: Specifies if there is any treatment to be applied to collateral, such as percentage discount which will impact collateral value.

docs.title: Slot: trigger
docs.text: The trigger level

docs.title: Slot: triggerDates
docs.text: The trigger Dates.

docs.title: Slot: triggerTimeType
docs.text: The valuation time type of knock condition.

docs.title: Slot: triggerType
docs.text: The Triggering condition.

docs.title: Slot: trustSchemeAddendum
docs.text: The qualification of whether Trust Scheme Addendum is applicable (True) or not applicable (False).

docs.title: Slot: typeOfSwapElection
docs.text: Per Part 1 Section 4, 'Dividend Obligations', of the 2018 ISDA CDM Equity Confirmation, Para 4.2 'Dividend Returns'.

docs.title: Slot: uk_EMIR_EligibleCollateral
docs.text: Identifies United Kingdom Eligible Collateral Assets classification categories based on UK Onshored EMIR Uncleared Margin Rules Eligible Collateral asset classes for both initial margin (IM) and variation margin (VM) posted and collected between specified entities. Please note: UK EMIR regulation will detail which eligible collateral assets classes apply to each type of entity pairing (counterparty) and which apply to posting of IM and VM.

docs.title: Slot: umbrellaAgreement
docs.text: Specifies a set of legal entities which are part of a legal agreement beyond the two contracting parties to that agreement.

docs.title: Slot: unadjustedDate
docs.text: A date subject to adjustment. While in FpML this date is required, this cardinality constraint has been relaxed as part of the CDM in order to support the FRA representation, which effective and termination dates are specified in FpML as adjusted dates.

docs.title: Slot: unadjustedEndDate
docs.text: The calculation end date, unadjusted.

docs.title: Slot: unadjustedPaymentDate
docs.text: The unadjusted payment date.

docs.title: Slot: unadjustedStartDate
docs.text: The calculation start date, unadjusted.

docs.title: Slot: unadjustedVarianceCap
docs.text: For use when varianceCap is applicable. Contains the scaling factor of the Variance Cap that can differ on a trade-by-trade basis in the European market. For example, a Variance Cap of 2.5^2 x Variance Strike Price has an unadjustedVarianceCap of 2.5.

docs.title: Slot: underlier
docs.text: The underlier impacted by the corporate action.

docs.title: Slot: unit
docs.text: Qualifies the unit by which the amount is measured. Optional because a measure may be unit-less (e.g. when representing a ratio between amounts in the same unit).

docs.title: Slot: unknownReferenceObligation
docs.text: Used to indicate that the Reference obligation associated with the Credit Default Swap is currently not known. This is not valid for Legal Confirmation purposes, but is valid for earlier stages in the trade life cycle (e.g. Broker Confirmation).

docs.title: Slot: updateDate
docs.text: The date the Floating Rate Option was last updated in the 2006 Definitions or 2021 Floating Rate Matrix. (e.g. 2021/06/11)

docs.title: Slot: upperBarrier
docs.text: All observations above this price level will be excluded from the variance calculation.

docs.title: Slot: upperBound
docs.text: Specifies the upper bound of a period range, e.g. less than to 10Y.

docs.title: Slot: upperStrike
docs.text: Upper strike in a strike spread.

docs.title: Slot: upperStrikeNumberOfOptions
docs.text: Number of options at the upper strike price in a strike spread.

docs.title: Slot: url
docs.text: Indicates where the resource can be found, as a URL that references the information on a web server accessible to the message recipient.

docs.title: Slot: us_CFTC_PR_EligibleCollateral
docs.text: Identifies US Eligible Collateral Assets classification categories based on Uncleared Margin Rules published by the CFTC and the US Prudential Regulator. Note: While the same basic categories exist in the CFTC and US Prudential Regulators’ margin rules, the precise definitions or application of those rules could differ between the two rules.

docs.title: Slot: useOfPostedCollateral
docs.text: Indicates whether the party has the right to reuse, rehypothecate, or otherwise make use of the posted collateral. 'True' if the party has the right,'False' if the party does not have the right.

docs.title: Slot: valuation
docs.text: Specifies inputs needed to process an update of a valuation.

docs.title: Slot: valuationAgent
docs.text: Details of the party calculating the value of collateral to be delivered or returned.

docs.title: Slot: valuationDate
docs.text: Details of the days on which calculations are to be made to determine the Delivery Amount and/or Return Amount.

docs.title: Slot: valuationDateLocation
docs.text: The specified location where the credit exposure will be calculated by the respective parties.

docs.title: Slot: valuationDateTime
docs.text: Indicates the valuation date of the exposure underlying the calculation.

docs.title: Slot: valuationDates
docs.text: The parameters used to generate the 'Equity Valuation Dates' schedule, including the Effective Date and Termination Date for the Swap.

docs.title: Slot: valuationDatesReference
docs.text: A set of href pointers to valuation period dates defined somewhere else in the document.

docs.title: Slot: valuationMethod
docs.text: The ISDA defined methodology for determining the final price of the reference obligation for purposes of cash settlement. (ISDA 2003 Term: Valuation Method). For example, Market, Highest etc.

docs.title: Slot: valuationPostponement
docs.text: Specifies how long to wait to get a quote from a settlement rate option upon a price source disruption.

docs.title: Slot: valuationSource
docs.text: The source for obtaining a valuation. This may come from some information source (e.g. Reuters), from a rate option fixing (e.g. FX fixing for cross-currency settlement), or from a set of reference banks. This is a mandatory attribute as the valuation method relies on one of those sources to be specified.

docs.title: Slot: valuationTerms
docs.text: Contains all non-date valuation information.

docs.title: Slot: valuationTime
docs.text: Specifies the time on which the value of collateral or exposure are calculated in accordance with the agreement.

docs.title: Slot: valuationTimeType
docs.text: The time of day at which the calculation agent values the underlying, for example the official closing time of the exchange.

docs.title: Slot: valuationTiming
docs.text: Denotes when the valuation was sourced during a business day.

docs.title: Slot: valuationTreatment
docs.text: Specification of the valuation treatment for the specified collateral.

docs.title: Slot: value
docs.text: Specifies the value of the measure as a number. Optional because in a measure vector or schedule, this single value may be omitted.

docs.title: Slot: valueDate
docs.text: Adjusted value date of the future value amount.

docs.title: Slot: valueLimit
docs.text: Specifies the value of collateral limit represented as a range.

docs.title: Slot: variableSet
docs.text: Defines a combination of Rating Agency, Rating Value, Threshold amount and Currency code.

docs.title: Slot: varianceCap
docs.text: If present and true, then variance cap is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: varianceCapFloor
docs.text: Contains possible barriers for variance products, both variance-based and underlier price based

docs.title: Slot: varianceReturnTerms
docs.text: Return terms based upon the observed variance of the underlier's price.

docs.title: Slot: varianceStrikePrice
docs.text: Variance Strike Price in accordance with the ISDA 2011 Equity Derivatives Definitions.

docs.title: Slot: variant
docs.text: Allows multiple variants to be defined for a clause. This needs to be an array as some clauses can specify different variants for different parties. At least one variant must be specified for a clause.

docs.title: Slot: varyingLegNotionalCurrency
docs.text: Indicate the Payout legs which nominal amount may vary in regards of FX Fixing dates as determined in the product terms.

docs.title: Slot: varyingNotionalCurrency
docs.text: The currency of the varying notional amount, i.e. the notional amount being determined periodically based on observation of a spot currency exchange rate. The list of valid currencies is not presently positioned as an enumeration as part of the CDM because that scope is limited to the values specified by ISDA and FpML. As a result, implementers have to make reference to the relevant standard, such as the ISO 4217 standard for currency codes.

docs.title: Slot: varyingNotionalFixingDates
docs.text: The dates on which spot currency exchange rates are observed for purposes of determining the varying notional currency amount that will apply to a calculation period.

docs.title: Slot: varyingNotionalInterimExchangePaymentDates
docs.text: The dates on which interim exchanges of notional are paid. Interim exchanges will arise as a result of changes in the spot currency exchange amount or changes in the constant notional schedule (e.g. amortisation).

docs.title: Slot: vegaNotionalAmount
docs.text: Vega Notional represents the approximate gain/loss at maturity for a 1% difference between RVol (realised vol) and KVol (strike vol). It does not necessarily represent the Vega Risk of the trade.

docs.title: Slot: version
docs.text: The the most recent version of the codelist, eg. 9-1

docs.title: Slot: vintage
docs.text: In the case where successive definitions of the legal agreement have been developed, the vintage identification. This is typically (but not necessarily) done by referencing the year, e.g. 2013 in the case of the ISDA 2013 Standard Credit Support Annex.

docs.title: Slot: visibilityIndicator
docs.text: Indicates the choice if the call instruction is visible or not to the other party.

docs.title: Slot: volatilityCapFactor
docs.text: Volatility Cap Amount in accordance with the ISDA 2011 Equity Derivatives Definitions. The Calculated VolCapAmt can be optionally provided.

docs.title: Slot: volatilityCapFloor
docs.text: Contains containing volatility-based barriers

docs.title: Slot: volatilityReturnTerms
docs.text: Return terms based upon the observed volatility of the underlier's price.

docs.title: Slot: volatilityStrikePrice
docs.text: Volatility Strike Price in accordance with the ISDA 2011 Equity Derivatives Definitions.

docs.title: Slot: wacCapInterestProvision
docs.text: As specified by the ISDA Supplement for use with trades on mortgage-backed securities, 'WAC Cap' means a weighted average coupon or weighted average rate cap provision (however defined in the Underlying Instruments) of the Underlying Instruments that limits, increases or decreases the interest rate or interest entitlement, as set out in the Underlying Instruments on the Effective Date without regard to any subsequent amendment The presence of the element with value set to 'true' signifies that the provision is applicable. From a usage standpoint, this provision is typically applicable in the case of CMBS and not applicable in case of RMBS trades.

docs.title: Slot: warehouseIdentity
docs.text: The identity of the warehouse, if any, that is executing that workflow step.

docs.title: Slot: weatherUnit
docs.text: Provides an enumerated values for a weather unit, generally used in the context of defining quantities for commodities.

docs.title: Slot: webPage
docs.text: The web page. This attribute is not specified as part of the FpML ContactInformation complex type.

docs.title: Slot: weekOfMonth
docs.text: Specifies the week of the month if used.

docs.title: Slot: weeklyRollConvention
docs.text: The day of the week on which a weekly reset date occurs. This element must be included if the reset frequency is defined as weekly and not otherwise.

docs.title: Slot: weight
docs.text: Specifies the degree of importance of the observation.

docs.title: Slot: weightedRates
docs.text: The weighted value of each observation.

docs.title: Slot: weights
docs.text: The corresponding weight for each date.

docs.title: Slot: whoMaySubstitute
docs.text: Designates which Counterparty to the transaction who has the right to trigger a substitution or to provide related determination e.g. for instance to qualify the effectiveness of an Event which may be a trigger for substitution, determine the replacement Share to substitute, etc. ; cardinality of this object is 2, in case parties jointly have this role.

docs.title: Slot: whoToDetermine
docs.text: _Designates which Counterparty to the transaction is granted with the particular role ; cardinality of this object is 2, in case parties are both having the same role e.g. jointly CalculationAgent, jointly Determining Party, etc. _

docs.title: Slot: withholdingTaxRate
docs.text: Specifies the withholding tax rate if a withholding tax is applicable.

docs.title: Slot: workflowState
docs.text: The event workflow information, i.e. the workflow status, the associated comment and the partyCustomisedWorkflow which purpose is to provide the ability to associate custom workflow information to the CDM.

docs.title: Slot: workflowStatus
docs.text: The workflow status indicator, e.g. Accepted, Rejected, ...

docs.title: Slot: writedown
docs.text: A credit event. Results from the fact that the underlier writes down its outstanding principal amount.

docs.title: Slot: writedownReimbursement
docs.text: An Additional Fixed Payment. Corresponds to the payment by or on behalf of the issuer of an amount in respect to the reference obligation in reduction of the prior writedowns. ISDA 2003 Term: Writedown Reimbursement.

docs.title: Slot: writeoffLimit
docs.text: Specifies the level below which the interest will be written off; if omitted write-off is not applicable.

docs.title: Slot: yearFraction
docs.text: The fraction of a year that this calculation represents, according to the day count fraction method.

docs.title: Slot: zeroEvent
docs.text: Indicates whether a trigger applies for the Threshold or Minimum Transfer Amount to fall to zero. If 'True' then such a trigger exists.
